articles.title: Looking Into The Past: The Impact of Context on Detecting Deceptive Statements
articles.abstract: Deception detection typically considers messages in isolation. Previous works in claim verification and role detection have displayed that additional information such as gameplay history is crucial to successful predictions. In this work, we demonstrate the value of preceding gameplay dialogue when applied to deceptive message detection within the hidden role game of Avalon. The findings show that LLMs can see improvement across a number of metrics, including accuracy by up to 31\% with the addition of gameplay context for the target message.
articles.titleCn: 回顾过去：语境对识别虚假陈述的影响
articles.abstractCn: 欺骗检测通常孤立地考虑信息。先前在声明验证和角色检测方面的研究已经表明，游戏历史等额外信息对于成功的预测至关重要。在这项工作中，我们展示了在Avalon隐藏角色游戏中，先前游戏对话在欺骗信息检测中的价值。研究结果表明，通过为目标信息添加游戏上下文，LLM在多个指标上的性能得到了提升，包括准确率提高了高达31%。

articles.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions. A central design question is whether to retain only observed trajectories and outcomes or also the rules, summaries, and skills inferred from them. Retaining these abstractions allows agents to reuse strategies without repeatedly deriving them from raw trajectories. However, errors in stored abstractions can propagate to subsequent decisions through retrieval and reuse. They can also shape execution trajectories, which then become the basis for new abstractions that reproduce the original errors. We term this feedback mechanism error reproduction: errors are regenerated through a cycle of abstraction, execution, and re-abstraction, extending their persistence beyond direct reuse of the original faulty knowledge. We propose Anti-Persistence, a memory design that accumulates trajectories and outcomes while reconstructing task-specific guidance on demand. An adaptive selector uses prior outcomes to decide whether and how to synthesize guidance, which is discarded after execution. This prevents its direct reuse as a stored object, although indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible. Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs. These results support separating experience accumulation from abstraction persistence in memorybased self-improvement.
articles.titleCn: 更多内存，更糟的代理：LLM代理中的错误重现与反持久性
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理可以通过不更新模型参数来提升多任务性能，方法是将其自身执行的经验存储在外部内存中，并重用以指导后续决策。一个核心设计问题是：是仅保留观察到的轨迹和结果，还是也保留从这些数据中推断出的规则、摘要和技能。保留这些抽象信息允许代理重用策略，而无需从原始轨迹中反复推导。然而，存储的抽象信息中的错误可能通过检索和重用传播到后续决策中。它们还可以塑造执行轨迹，这些轨迹随后成为新抽象的基础，从而重复产生原始错误。我们将这种反馈机制称为错误再生：错误通过抽象、执行和再抽象的循环再生，使其持久性超越了直接重用原始错误知识。我们提出了Anti-Persistence，这是一种内存设计，它在按需重建特定任务指导的同时积累轨迹和结果。一个自适应选择器使用先验结果来决定是否以及如何合成指导，该指导在执行后会被丢弃。这防止了其作为存储对象被直接重用，尽管通过保留的轨迹仍然可能存在间接反馈。在不同的基准测试和骨干网络中，Anti-Persistence实现了最高的整体保留外成功率和最低的平均LLM调用成本，在所评估的内存设计中表现最佳。这些结果支持在基于内存的自我改进中，将经验积累与抽象持久性分离。

articles.title: Steering intonational tunes in text-to-speech synthesis
articles.abstract: Text-to-speech systems built on residual vector quantization often generate audio in two stages: a transformer backbone emits the first level of each frame's token stack, and a smaller depth model generates the rest autoregressively. We ask which components of such a model are responsible for prosodic intonation, more precisely for generating the English nuclear tune (for instance, the falling pitch melody that distinguishes an assertion from a question's rising melody), and whether interventions on those components can be used to control intonation. Prompt-based control mostly fails; only a final question mark is a reliable lever. Interchange interventions in CSM and S2 locate the tune: the backbone's hidden state carries it to the waveform through the depth model, and the first level of the stack carries little or none of it. Steering the backbone state with a difference-of-means vector computed on new material generated with a final period or question mark moves the tune, but the push toward an assertion degrades the voice. Steering vectors computed instead from the backbone states associated with human imitations of theoretically-specified tunes, whose text carries no punctuation, and applied inside the generation loop, move most recordings to the other condition in both systems (even when fitted without the speaker being steered), at a small cost in predicted naturalness. These imitation-derived vectors are aligned with the one obtained from the two punctuated conditions far beyond a shuffled-label null, so the backbone state of a punctuated prompt already represents intonation. The steered recordings broadly become falling or rising, according to the intent, but the edge tone moves more coherently than the pitch accent, and the target tune cannot be selected precisely beyond this broad tendency.
articles.comment: 39 pages, 25 figures, 12 tables (13 pages without appendices)
articles.titleCn: 在文本到语音合成中引导韵律调式
articles.abstractCn: 基于残差矢量量化的文本到语音系统通常分两阶段生成音频：Transformer主干网络发出每个帧标记堆栈的第一级，而一个较小深度的模型则自回归地生成其余部分。我们探究此类模型中哪些组件负责韵律重音，更精确地说，负责生成英语核心曲调（例如，区分陈述句与疑问句的下降音调旋律与上升音调旋律），以及是否可以对这些组件进行干预来控制重音。基于提示的控制大多失败；只有句末的问号才是可靠的调节手段。在CSM和S2中的互换干预定位了曲调：主干网络的隐藏状态通过深度模型传递到波形，而堆栈的第一级携带很少或几乎没有曲调信息。使用最终句号或问号生成的新材料计算的均值差向量来引导主干状态，可以移动曲调，但会朝着陈述句的方向推动而使语音质量下降。相反，从理论上指定了曲调的人类模仿所关联的主干状态计算的引导向量，应用于生成循环内部，将大多数录音转移到两个系统中的另一条件（即使在不引导说话人时也如此），在预测自然度上仅付出微小代价。这些模仿派生的向量与从两个带标点符号的条件中获得的向量在远超打乱标签的空值之外对齐，因此带标点符号的提示的主干状态已经代表了重音。被引导的录音大致根据意图变为下降或上升，但边缘音调比重音移动得更连贯，而且除了这种大致趋势之外，无法精确选择目标曲调。

articles.title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. Across reasoning, math, code benchmarks on three model families DStill improves acceptance length by up to 28% and speedup by up to 25% over one-step DFlash, achieving up to 6.45x speedup over auto-regressive decoding.
articles.titleCn: DStill：用于块扩散推测解码中加速单步草图的轨迹一致性蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 块扩散推测解码通过并行草拟多个标记来加速大型语言模型的推理。然而，在离散扩散中，单步草拟受限于标记分解误差：每个标记都是从相同的掩码块中预测的，而没有根据该步骤中其他位置选择的标记进行条件化。这可能导致不一致的草拟并减少接受长度。迭代细化通过将后续预测基于先前确认的标记来缓解这一限制，但额外的遍历增加了草拟成本。为了解决草拟保真度和推理延迟之间的权衡，我们引入了DStill，一个两阶段框架，它将目标条件化草拟器自身的多步细化蒸馏为单步草拟。我们首先训练草拟器来完成部分揭示的块，然后使用其细化轨迹来训练学生，以单次遍历预测最终完成。使用一个从部分掩码输入逐渐过渡的课程，我们成功地将多步细化能力转移到了单步中。在推理、数学、代码三个模型家族的基准测试中，DStill比单步DFlash的接受长度提高了高达28%，速度提升高达25%，实现了比自回归解码高达6.45倍的速度提升。

articles.title: SHAM-Bench: A Span-level Hallucination Benchmark Across Multiple Tasks
articles.abstract: Span-level hallucination detection pinpoints unsupported content in LLM outputs, enabling actionable feedback and targeted mitigation. Existing evaluations for span-level hallucination detection methods are fragmented across tasks, annotation formats, and metrics, and most span-level datasets cover only a single NLG domain, making it difficult to assess whether a detection method actually generalizes across tasks and domains. In this paper, we introduce SHAM-Bench (Span-level Hallucination Benchmark Across Multiple Tasks), a unified benchmark for span-level hallucination detection spanning six NLG tasks, aggregated from existing human-annotated datasets totaling 6,461 examples under a common schema and evaluation protocol. Using SHAM-Bench, we evaluate existing hallucination detection methods and find that fine-tuned detectors often perform well in-domain but degrade under distribution shift, whereas prompt-based methods with reasoning are more robust across tasks. Our analysis further shows that subtle unsupported content remains difficult to detect and span-level evaluation is still challenged by ambiguous span boundaries and noisy labels. We release the dataset, evaluation code, and a public leaderboard to support future research on broadly generalizable hallucination detection.
articles.titleCn: SHAM-Bench：跨多任务的多层次幻觉基准
articles.abstractCn: 片段级幻觉检测能够识别LLM输出中的不兼容内容，从而提供可操作的反馈和有针对性的缓解措施。现有的片段级幻觉检测方法评估分散在不同的任务、标注格式和指标中，并且大多数片段级数据集仅涵盖单个自然语言生成（NLG）领域，这使得难以评估检测方法是否真正跨任务和领域泛化。在本文中，我们介绍了SHAM-Bench（跨多任务的片段级幻觉基准），这是一个涵盖六个NLG任务的统一基准，它整合了现有的人类标注数据集，共计6,461个示例，采用统一的模式和评估协议。使用SHAM-Bench，我们评估了现有的幻觉检测方法，发现微调检测器在领域内表现良好，但在分布偏移下性能下降，而基于推理的提示方法在跨任务中更为稳健。我们的分析进一步表明，细微的不兼容内容仍然难以检测，片段级评估仍然受到模糊片段边界和噪声标签的挑战。我们发布了数据集、评估代码和一个公共排行榜，以支持未来对广泛泛化幻觉检测的研究。

articles.title: Explore More, Validate Less: Efficient Reflective Prompt Optimization
articles.abstract: Reflective prompt optimization improves instructions using task feedback, but coupling candidate generation with full-validation-based selection can make search costly and sequential. We propose a two-stage framework that decouples reflective candidate-pool construction from validation allocation. During construction, we sample multiple parents and reuse each parent's training responses across parallel reflection branches. Each revision is screened against its parent on a small training minibatch, allowing locally improved candidates to support further revisions without full validation. After construction, an exploration policy selects candidates from the frozen pool under a fixed full-validation budget, and the prompt with the highest measured validation score is returned. This separation allows candidate-pool size and validation budget to be set independently. We evaluate random selection and learned score prediction with similarity-based exploration on five benchmarks using Qwen3.5-9B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. With 100 retained candidates and 20 full validations, our framework improves over the initial solver by up to 11.22 percentage points. Learned selection improves over the initial solver in all ten comparisons, although neither selection policy consistently outperforms the other. These results support separating reflective search from budgeted validation while leaving room for stronger candidate-selection policies.
articles.titleCn: 探索更多，验证更少：高效反射提示优化
articles.abstractCn: 基于任务反馈的反思式提示优化能够改进指令，但将候选生成与全验证选择相结合会使搜索成本高昂且顺序化。我们提出了一种两阶段框架，将反思式候选池构建与验证分配解耦。在构建阶段，我们采样多个父节点，并在并行反思分支中重用每个父节点的训练响应。每个修订版本会在一个小型训练数据子集中与父节点进行筛选，允许局部改进的候选支持进一步修订，而无需进行全验证。构建完成后，探索策略在固定的全验证预算下从冻结的候选池中选择候选，并返回测量验证分数最高的提示。这种分离允许独立设置候选池大小和验证预算。我们使用Qwen3.5-9B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在五个基准测试上评估了随机选择和基于相似性的探索策略与学习分数预测。在保留100个候选和进行20次全验证的情况下，我们的框架相较于初始求解器提高了最多11.22个百分点。学习选择在所有十个比较中都优于初始求解器，尽管两种选择策略并未始终胜出。这些结果表明，将反思式搜索与预算验证分离是有益的，同时为更强大的候选选择策略留下了空间。

articles.title: On the LLM Verification for Argument Graph Generation
articles.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can formalize natural-language argumentation end-to-end, turning plain text into structured graphs by classifying components, connecting them with relations, and enriching the resulting graphs into formal models. Quality assurance for those graphs is almost always another LLMs: a reviewer, judge, or critic agent. On the other side, in adjacent neuro-symbolic fields, such generated output is often verified symbolically by external checks and solvers. In this work, we argue that in argument graph verification, the allocation should be similar, and based on what each instrument can guarantee. We propose layered verification: starting from deterministic checks, moving to solver-based and LLM reviews, and utilizing debate only under uncertainty, leaving human judgment for what no other instrument can decide. We ground our principle with a study on human-annotated graphs with injected structural defects. An LLM reviewer detects them at near-ceiling recall, including cycles in the support relation, but it objects to almost one in a ten correct graphs, even though it should not, happens to be inconsistent in verdict on identical inputs and is significantly slower than the equivalent exact check. It shows that while LLM reviewer does not lack the ability to detect structural defects, it is worth having a deterministic verification gates.
articles.comment: Accepted for GaLM workshop at CIKM 2026
articles.titleCn: 关于论证图生成的LLM验证
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体LLM系统可以端到端地形式化自然语言论证，通过分类组件、用关系连接它们，并将生成的图丰富为形式化模型。这些图的品质保证几乎总是另一个LLM：一个审阅者、裁判或批评者智能体。另一方面，在相邻的神经符号领域，这种生成的输出通常通过外部检查和解算器进行符号化验证。在这项工作中，我们主张在论证图验证中，分配应该相似，并基于每种工具能保证的内容。我们提出了分层验证：从确定性检查开始，过渡到基于解算器和LLM的审阅，仅在不确定性情况下利用辩论，并将人类判断留给其他工具无法决定的事项。我们通过一项关于注入结构缺陷的人标注图的研究来验证我们的原则。LLM审阅器能以接近上限的召回率检测到这些缺陷，包括支持关系中的循环，但它几乎反对每十个正确图中的一个，尽管它本不该这样做，只是因为对相同输入的裁决不一致，并且比等效的精确检查慢得多。这表明，虽然LLM审阅器并不缺乏检测结构缺陷的能力，但拥有确定性验证关卡是值得的。

articles.title: Global Security Blind Spots: Translation as a Safety Bypass in Low-Resource Languages
articles.abstract: Large language models are deployed globally, yet safety alignment and evaluation remain concentrated in English: harmful requests refused in English can elicit unsafe completions when translated into low-resource languages. We evaluate ten widely deployed LLMs across 79 languages (English plus 78 low-resource) under a translation-bypass threat model, using a metric conditioned on English safety, which separates translation bypass from unsafety already present in English. English safety does not transfer reliably: conditioned on safe English completions, mean bypass rates range from 21.9% to 44.4%. Bypass risk concentrates in a subset of language families, a pattern broadly shared across models. The shared ordering is confounded with translation degeneracy, but its variation across models is significant and survives every control we apply. We also show that per-model bypass rates do not identify a stable ranking: nine of ten models change rank across three conditioning schemes that estimate the same quantity, with no change to any underlying response.
articles.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec)
articles.titleCn: 全球安全盲点：低资源语言的翻译作为安全绕过
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在全球范围内部署，但安全对齐和评估仍集中在英语上：在英语中拒绝的有害请求在被翻译成低资源语言时可能引发不安全回复。我们在翻译绕过威胁模型下，使用基于英语安全的指标，评估了十种广泛部署的大型语言模型，涵盖79种语言（英语加上78种低资源语言），该指标能够区分翻译绕过与英语中已存在的不安全性。英语安全并不能可靠地迁移：在安全的英语回复条件下，平均绕过率范围在21.9%到44.4%之间。绕过风险集中在部分语言家族中，这一模式在多种模型中普遍存在。共享的排序与翻译退化相互混淆，但其跨模型的变化显著且不受我们施加的任何控制措施的影响。我们还表明，每种模型的绕过率并不能识别出稳定的排名：在三种估计相同数量的条件下，十种模型中有九种在排名上发生变化，而底层回复没有任何改变。

articles.title: Evaluating Context Compaction on the Questions That Come Later
articles.abstract: Language-model agents compact their context for the question at hand, but the compacted context must also serve questions that come later. We evaluate compaction on these later questions, using four corpora that annotate the evidence of several questions per text and recorded agent trajectories, and compare every method with random deletion at the same budget. On MultiRC, keeping the sentences that gpt-6-luna (through the OpenAI Decisions API) judges necessary for the current question raises its accuracy on that question by 11.4 points at 25% of the tokens. On the later questions, however, no method that selects sentences for the current question does detectably better than deleting sentences at random. Deleting words instead of sentences does better: LLMLingua-2, which ignores the question, beats random sentence deletion at the same token count by 12.5 points on the later MultiRC questions. It keeps about twice random deletion's share of the evidence's content words, and at equal content-word retention its gain shrinks to 7.3 points (exploratory). On FEVER, label accuracy can overstate what the kept text supports: the gain of sentence selection is no longer detected when answers are scored against the kept evidence, and the 21.0-point gain of LLMLingua-2 is not shown to rest on the kept text. The ranking also depends on the setting: on Evidence Inference sentence selection beats LLMLingua-2 at a nominal 25% budget, and on $τ$-bench trajectories, whose later tool calls need exact identifiers, it beats random deletion while LLMLingua-2 shows no detected gain. Scores on the question a compaction was made for do not reliably show how it serves later ones.
articles.titleCn: 评估后续问题的上下文压缩效果
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理会压缩当前问题的上下文，但压缩后的上下文也必须服务于后续问题。我们通过四个标注了每篇文本中多个问题证据并记录代理轨迹的语料库，评估压缩对后续问题的效果，并将每种方法与随机删除在相同预算下的表现进行比较。在MultiRC上，保留gpt-6-luna（通过OpenAI Decisions API）认为当前问题必要的句子，在25%的token数量下将该问题的准确率提高了11.4分。但在后续问题上，没有任何选择当前问题所需句子的方法比随机删除表现更好。删除单词而非句子效果更好：LLMLingua-2忽略问题，在相同token数量下，其在后续MultiRC问题上的表现比随机句子删除高出12.5分。它保留了大约是随机删除两倍的证据中的内容词，而在内容词保留量相同的情况下，其优势缩小到7.3分（探索性）。在FEVER上，标签准确率可能高估保留文本所支持的内容：当答案根据保留的证据评分时，句子选择的优势不再明显，且LLMLingua-2的21.0分优势并未体现在保留文本上。排名也取决于设置：在Evidence Inference中，句子选择在名义25%预算下优于LLMLingua-2，而在需要精确标识符的τ-bench轨迹中，它优于随机删除，而LLMLingua-2未显示出明显优势。针对压缩问题进行压缩的得分并不能可靠地反映其对后续问题的服务效果。

articles.title: RealControlBench: A Benchmark for Interpretability-Informed Fine-Grained Control of LLMs and Agents
articles.abstract: Existing steering benchmarks are built around simplified, isolated generation tasks and evaluate a single behavioral attribute under controlled settings that do not reflect the diversity and complexity of practical deployment. As a result, performance on these benchmarks provides only a limited picture of how steering methods perform in the real world. We therefore introduce RealControlBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating fine-grained steering of LLMs and LLM agents across diverse behavioral targets and interaction settings. RealControlBench extends steering evaluation beyond isolated generations to complex, execution-grounded, multi-turn agent interactions, covering five complementary dimensions: instruction-following control, agentic tool-use decision control, reasoning-performance steering, reasoning-length control, and trajectory-conditioned safety awareness. Rather than measuring steering success alone, the benchmark jointly evaluates target controllability and capability preservation, including instruction following, reasoning performance, and downstream agent utility and safety. It further examines whether steering effects remain specific and robust across prompt variations, domains, and model architectures. Our evaluation shows that existing steering methods remain unreliable across realistic control objectives: they often fail to consistently induce the intended behavior and can substantially degrade the model's underlying task performance. These results suggest that strong steering effects in controlled settings do not necessarily translate into reliable control in more realistic evaluations. By providing a unified, model-agnostic steering evaluation framework, RealControlBench aims to support the development of steering methods that are not only effective but also precise, robust, and useful in realistic AI deployments.
articles.titleCn: RealControlBench：面向可解释性引导的LLMs和智能体细粒度控制的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 现有的转向基准围绕简化的、孤立的生成任务构建，在受控环境下评估单一行为属性，这些环境无法反映实际部署的多样性和复杂性。因此，在这些基准上的表现只能有限地反映转向方法在现实世界中的表现。为此，我们引入了RealControlBench，一个用于评估LLM和LLM智能体在多样化行为目标和交互设置下进行细粒度转向的综合性基准。RealControlBench将转向评估从孤立的生成扩展到复杂、基于执行的、多轮智能体交互，涵盖五个互补维度：指令遵循控制、智能体工具使用决策控制、推理性能转向、推理长度控制和轨迹条件下的安全意识。该基准不仅衡量转向成功，还联合评估目标可控性和能力保留，包括指令遵循、推理性能以及下游智能体效用和安全。它进一步考察转向效果是否在提示变化、领域和模型架构之间保持特定和稳健。我们的评估表明，现有的转向方法在现实控制目标上仍然不可靠：它们往往无法一致地诱导预期行为，并可能显著降低模型的底层任务性能。这些结果表明，受控环境下的强转向效果并不一定转化为更现实评估中的可靠控制。通过提供一个统一的、模型无关的转向评估框架，RealControlBench旨在支持开发不仅有效，而且精确、稳健且在现实AI部署中有用的转向方法。

articles.title: TEX: Test-Time Scaling Testing Agents via Execution-based Cross-Validation
articles.abstract: Test-case generation is critical but remains challenging for language models. Existing test-time scaling methods either isolate candidates or aggregate traces, which do not scale to long-horizon tasks. We present TEX, a collaborative test-time scaling framework based on execution-driven cross-validation. TEX parallelizes agents to generate tests and patches, cross-executing each test against every patch to form a $K \times K$ feedback matrix. Agents use their matrix slices for refinement, enabling objective validation without verbose trace sharing. On SWT-Bench Verified, TEX achieves 86.4%, establishing a new state-of-the-art and improving +9.0% over single-agent baselines. Moreover, even random selection from TEX outputs (84.4%) surpasses the previous SOTA (84.0%), showing collaborative execution feedback improves solution quality, not just best-case samples. Our results highlight execution-grounded feedback as an effective scaling mechanism for long-horizon agentic tasks.
articles.titleCn: 基于执行的交叉验证在测试时进行代理的缩放测试
articles.abstractCn: 测试用例生成对于语言模型至关重要，但仍然是一个挑战。现有的测试时扩展方法要么隔离候选方案，要么聚合执行轨迹，这些方法无法扩展到长时程任务。我们提出了TEX，一个基于执行驱动交叉验证的协作式测试时扩展框架。TEX并行化代理来生成测试用例和补丁，交叉执行每个测试用例针对每个补丁，形成$K \times K$的反馈矩阵。代理使用其矩阵切片进行优化，实现无需冗长轨迹共享的客观验证。在SWT-Bench Verified上，TEX达到了86.4%，创下了新的SOTA成绩，比单代理基线提高了+9.0%。此外，从TEX输出中进行随机选择（84.4%）也超过了之前的SOTA（84.0%），表明协作式执行反馈不仅能提升最佳案例样本，还能提高解决方案的整体质量。我们的结果表明，基于执行的反馈是长时程代理任务的有效扩展机制。

articles.title: When Does Hate Transfer? A Large-Scale Study of Cross-Lingual Hate Speech Detection
articles.abstract: Effective detection of hate content is essential for maintaining healthy online communities, yet performance can vary substantially across languages. This work investigates a core practical question: Can training data from one language support hate-speech detection in another language with comparable performance? To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale study across 14 languages. \change{We observe consistent patterns in which certain language pairs transfer more effectively than others. Among the factors we measure, linguistic similarity is the strongest predictor of these patterns, with temporal overlap and dataset-size difference playing smaller roles. These measurable factors do not fully explain the observed patterns; a complementary qualitative analysis suggests that shared cultural cues and communicative norms may be associated with some of the remaining cases, particularly within several clusters. We present this cultural interpretation as a hypothesis from qualitative inspection rather than a measured cause.}{} Our analysis includes low-resource languages, offering practical insights into when cross-lingual transfer can support them and where its limitations emerge. These findings inform the design of more reliable multilingual hate-detection systems.
articles.titleCn: 仇恨何时转移？一项大规模跨语言仇恨言论检测研究
articles.abstractCn: 有效检测仇恨内容对于维护健康的在线社区至关重要，但不同语言的表现差异可能很大。本研究探讨了一个核心的实践问题：一种语言的训练数据能否支持另一种语言的仇恨言论检测并达到相当的性能？为了回答这个问题，我们在14种语言中进行了大规模研究。我们观察到某些语言对之间的迁移效果比其他语言对更有效。在我们测量的因素中，语言相似性是这些模式的最强预测因素，时间重叠和数据集大小差异的作用较小。这些可测量的因素并不能完全解释观察到的模式；补充的定性分析表明，共享的文化线索和交际规范可能与部分剩余案例相关，特别是在几个聚类中。我们将这种文化解释作为定性检查的假设，而不是一个测量的原因。我们的分析包括低资源语言，为跨语言迁移何时能支持它们以及其局限性何在提供了实践见解。这些发现为设计更可靠的多语言仇恨检测系统提供了信息。

articles.title: FLINT: Fixed-budget Late Interaction
articles.abstract: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. However, retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders, limiting their scalability. We introduce FLINT (Fixed-budget Late INTeraction), an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. Unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries, FLINT applies pooling symmetrically to both sides, limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. FLINT achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on BEIR and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries, including BrowseComp+, CRUMB, and TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025. We demonstrate that FLINT's effectiveness-efficiency benefits extend across encoder architectures, testing it on two separate backbones (BERT and ModernBERT). On long-query corpora, FLINT delivers 1.5-2.8 times faster end-to-end retrieval than ConstBERT, the closest baseline. FLINT also reduces index size by 5.3-9.3 times relative to token-level late-interaction models such as ColBERTv2.
articles.titleCn: FLINT：固定预算后期交互
articles.abstractCn: 多向量检索模型如ColBERT通常通过在词元级别匹配查询和文档来超越规模相当的单一向量模型。然而，与单一向量双向编码器相比，为每个词元保留一个向量会大幅增加存储需求并减慢检索速度，限制了其可扩展性。我们引入了FLINT（固定预算后期交互），这是一种使用基于注意力的池化技术来用固定数量的嵌入向量表示每个查询和文档的架构。与仅池化文档表示而保留词元级别查询的架构不同，FLINT对称地池化双方，从而限制了文档存储和检索过程中所需的向量比较次数。FLINT在BEIR上实现了与最接近基线相当的性能，并在具有更长、更复杂查询的多个基准测试（包括BrowseComp+、CRUMB和TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025）上表现更优。我们证明FLINT的有效性-效率优势可扩展到不同的编码器架构，我们在两个独立的骨干网络（BERT和ModernBERT）上进行了测试。在长查询语料库上，FLINT比最接近的基线ConstBERT实现了1.5-2.8倍的端到端检索速度提升。FLINT相对于ColBERTv2等词元级别后期交互模型，索引大小减少了5.3-9.3倍。

articles.title: African Languages AI Safety Readiness Report
articles.abstract: With the widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) across languages and domains, AI safety has emerged as a critical global concern. However, due to resource constraints, research and development efforts tend to prioritize a limited number of high-resource languages, leaving many others, especially those spoken in Africa, underrepresented. While existing research on language "resource-ness" has largely examined whether sufficient resources are available to develop language technologies, the question of whether languages are adequately represented in AI safety research has received attention only more recently. This report examines the readiness of African languages for inclusion in AI safety discussions, drawing on existing literature and data. It considers four factors: the availability of AI-relevant resources, including text data; national AI policy support; performance on established text benchmarks; and speaker population. Based on these factors, languages are grouped into four readiness categories: fully ready, mostly ready, emerging, and foundational support needed. This classification is intended to inform the inclusion of African languages in AI safety benchmarks, highlight varying levels of preparedness, and guide strategic investment in data development, policy, and community engagement for underrepresented languages.
articles.titleCn: 非洲语言人工智能安全准备报告
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在多种语言和领域的广泛采用，人工智能安全已成为一个重要的全球性问题。然而，由于资源限制，研究和开发工作往往优先考虑少数几种资源丰富的语言，导致许多其他语言，尤其是非洲地区的语言，代表性不足。虽然现有的关于语言“资源性”的研究主要考察是否拥有足够的资源来开发语言技术，但关于语言是否在人工智能安全研究中得到充分代表的问题，直到最近才受到关注。本报告基于现有文献和数据，考察了非洲语言纳入人工智能安全讨论的准备情况，并考虑了四个因素：人工智能相关资源（包括文本数据）的可用性；国家人工智能政策支持；在既定文本基准上的表现；以及使用者人口。根据这些因素，语言被分为四个准备情况类别：完全准备就绪、基本准备就绪、正在兴起和需要基础支持。这种分类旨在为非洲语言纳入人工智能安全基准提供参考，突出不同层次的准备情况，并为代表性不足的语言在数据开发、政策制定和社区参与方面提供战略投资指导。

articles.title: Auditing Safety Preference Supervision with Recorded Derivations
articles.abstract: Preference labels align model training, but the judgments behind them are difficult to inspect or verify. In this paper, we examine how preference construction can be checked when intermediate decisions are recorded, and which of them remain uncertain. We present Symbolic Preference Labeling, a method in which a pretrained language model classifies predefined attributes of prompts and responses. Explicit rules assign response verdicts, and a fixed verdict ranking determines the preference label. Each preference label has a recorded derivation: the response verdicts and preference label can be recomputed from the stored attribute assignments, rules, and verdict ranking without rerunning the language model. On 200 prompts annotated by human raters, the language model produces valid structured outputs for 192 prompts. All eight parsing failures occur in the subset of self-harm prompts marked as harmful. Using 465 preference pairs, we train one policy model with direct preference optimization across five training seeds. Mean measured benign refusal is 40.82 percent on 1,319 benign prompts that resemble unsafe ones, and mean measured toxic refusal is 84.98 percent on 655 toxic prompts. This study distinguishes the reproducibility of preference labels from attribute correctness. The recorded derivations make preference construction open to inspection, while attribute correctness and semantic safety require separate validation.
articles.titleCn: 审计安全偏好监督与记录的推导过程
articles.abstractCn: 偏好标签使模型训练保持一致，但标签背后的判断难以检查或验证。在本文中，我们研究了当中间决策被记录时，如何检查偏好构建过程，以及哪些决策仍然存在不确定性。我们提出了符号偏好标签方法，该方法中预训练的语言模型对提示和响应的预定义属性进行分类。显式规则分配响应判定，固定的判定排序决定偏好标签。每个偏好标签都有一个记录的推导过程：响应判定和偏好标签可以从存储的属性分配、规则和判定排序中重新计算，而无需重新运行语言模型。在由人类评分员标注的200个提示中，语言模型对192个提示生成了有效的结构化输出。所有八个解析失败都发生在被标记为有害的自我伤害提示子集中。使用465对偏好，我们在五个训练种子上通过直接偏好优化训练了一个策略模型。在1,319个类似于不安全提示的良性提示中，平均测量的良性拒绝率为40.82%，在655个毒性提示中，平均测量的毒性拒绝率为84.98%。这项研究区分了偏好标签的可重复性与属性正确性。记录的推导过程使偏好构建过程可供检查，而属性正确性和语义安全性需要单独验证。

articles.title: TxnQA: Benchmarking Analytical Reasoning and Evidence Grounding over Transaction Event Sequences
articles.abstract: Analyzing merchant transaction histories requires dynamic temporal filtering, entity resolution, and aggregation over irregular event streams--operations poorly captured by static tabular or time-series forecasting benchmarks. We introduce TxnQA, an analytical QA benchmark comprising 27 task families (81 templates) alongside a 5-scenario fraud-risk reasoning suite that evaluates both verdicts and supporting evidence over synthetic, privacy-mitigated transaction data. Ground-truth answers are computed programmatically, and model performance is decomposed into format-following rate (FFR), conditional content accuracy (CA), and end-to-end correctness (E2E). Evaluating prompted proprietary baselines and six LoRA-adapted open-weight models shows that adaptation reliably enforces output schemas but leaves arithmetic bottlenecks: Gemma-4-31B-IT and Qwen3-8B attain E2E scores of 0.867 and 0.816, whereas evaluated MoE checkpoints reach only 0.632-0.713. Furthermore, on the 500-instance fraud suite, verdict accuracy frequently exceeds 80%, yet joint accuracy (requiring exact evidence attribution) collapses to at most ~23%. These findings identify schema compliance, semantic calculation, and evidence attribution as three distinct bottlenecks in transaction-sequence QA.
articles.titleCn: TxnQA：在交易事件序列上对分析推理和证据基础进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 分析商户交易历史需要动态时间过滤、实体解析以及在不规则事件流上的聚合——这些操作难以通过静态表格或时间序列预测基准来充分捕捉。我们引入了TxnQA，一个包含27个任务家族（81个模板）的分析型问答基准，以及一个包含5种场景的欺诈风险推理套件，该套件在经过隐私保护的合成交易数据上评估判断结果和支撑证据。真实答案通过程序计算得出，模型性能被分解为格式遵循率（FFR）、条件内容准确率（CA）和端到端正确率（E2E）。评估提示专有基线和六个LoRA适配的开权重量化模型表明，适配能够可靠地强制输出模式，但留下了算术瓶颈：Gemma-4-31B-IT和Qwen3-8B达到E2E得分0.867和0.816，而评估的MoE检查点得分仅为0.632-0.713。此外，在500个实例的欺诈套件上，判断准确率经常超过80%，但联合准确率（需要精确的证据归因）降至最多约23%。这些发现将模式合规性、语义计算和证据归因识别为交易序列问答中的三个不同瓶颈。

articles.title: Target-Aware Curation of Hallucination Stress Tests for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Hallucination stress tests can yield similar average scores across language models even when different prompts elicit hallucinations in each model. We develop a procedure that iteratively edits source-grounded seed prompts to expose hallucinations in a target model. An LLM editor revises each prompt in response to the target's answer and a judge's category-specific score and explanation. In the main setting, the target also receives feedback on its previous response. Experiments cover 500 seeds from seven datasets and ten topics, with intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations evaluated across open-weight and closed-source models. Editing substantially increases judge-rated severity over the seeds. In the baseline configuration, retained responses fall in the judge's strong-hallucination bin in 77.2% of runs targeting extrinsic hallucination and 74.2% targeting intrinsic hallucination. Later editing rounds account for more than half of the mean score increase. Among 219 prompts that pass model-assisted source-validity checks, 89 elicit responses containing unsupported claims. Across five models, 200 curated prompts yield similar average severity scores, although pairwise Spearman correlations between prompt-level scores are only $ρ=0.0387$ to $0.1897$. Curated prompts can be reused across models, but their diagnostic value depends on source validity and the failures they expose in each model.
articles.titleCn: 针对幻觉的测试集对大型语言模型的定向筛选
articles.abstractCn: 幻觉压力测试可以在不同提示引发各语言模型幻觉的情况下，产生相似的均值分数。我们开发了一种迭代编辑源锚种子提示的流程，以在目标模型中暴露幻觉。大型语言模型编辑器根据目标模型的回答和裁判的类别特定评分及解释来修订每个提示。在主要设置中，目标模型还会收到对其先前回答的反馈。实验涵盖来自七个数据集和十个主题的500个种子，并在开放权重和闭源模型中评估了内在和外在幻觉。编辑显著增加了裁判评定的种子严重程度。在基准配置中，针对外在幻觉的77.2%运行和针对内在幻觉的74.2%运行中，保留的回答落入裁判的强幻觉类别。后期编辑轮次贡献了均值分数增加超过一半。在219个通过模型辅助源效性检查的提示中，89个引发了包含未支持主张的回答。在五个模型中，200个精选提示产生了相似的均值严重程度分数，尽管提示级别分数之间的配对斯皮尔曼相关性仅为$ρ=0.0387$至$0.1897$。精选提示可以在不同模型中重复使用，但它们的诊断价值取决于源效性和它们在各个模型中暴露的缺陷。

articles.title: Diagnostic Analysis for Large Language Model Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reasoning structures (e.g., chains and graphs) are increasingly used for probabilistic inference, factuality verification, and uncertainty estimation, but their structural reliability is rarely evaluated directly. We test whether this reliability holds through a proposed two-stage diagnostic evaluation in open-ended multi-hop QA. Stage 1 tests different capabilities required to construct reasoning graphs, showing that graph reliability varies with topology, prompt design, and model family. Stage 2 uses uncertainty estimation as a downstream test case. Generated-edge experiments show that graph-based computation is sensitive to upstream graph errors, with performance dropping relative to the gold-graph setting. Gold-graph experiments further show that graph structure provides little benefit when used only as prompt context, but improves the separation of correct from incorrect answers by confidence score and enables node-level diagnostics.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型推理的诊断分析
articles.abstractCn: 推理结构（例如链和图）越来越多地用于概率推理、事实性验证和不确定性估计，但它们的结构可靠性很少被直接评估。我们通过在开放式多跳问答中提出的两阶段诊断评估来检验这种可靠性是否成立。第一阶段测试构建推理图所需的不同能力，表明图可靠性随拓扑结构、提示设计和模型系列的变化而变化。第二阶段将不确定性估计作为下游测试用例。生成的边实验表明，基于图的计算对上游图的错误很敏感，相对于金图设置，性能有所下降。金图实验进一步表明，当仅作为提示上下文使用时，图结构几乎没有好处，但通过置信度分数提高了正确答案与错误答案的区分度，并实现了节点级诊断。

articles.title: Predicting Linear Relational Decodability Without the Relation
articles.abstract: Linear relational embeddings (LREs) approximate a language model's subject-to-object mapping with an affine function. Their faithfulness varies enormously across relations, from near zero for person_father to the ceiling for country_capital_city. We investigate the factors that contribute to this variation and demonstrate that it can be significantly predicted from a readout that is not aware of the underlying relation. To do so, we propose a novel form of the Jacobian lens, the entity lens. Whereas the Jacobian lens is estimated across all tokens and concepts, the entity lens EL_t is trained to predict what the model will output for an entity of type t under the neutral prompt "{} is known for"; e.g., we train ELs for countries and persons. After estimating an entity lens, we measure how highly it ranks the model's answer for a relation without using any relation-specific information in estimation and prediction. Across 28 relations of the LRE dataset on Olmo-3-7B this relation-agnostic score correlates with LRE faithfulness at ρ= 0.7355 (p < .01). This suggests that linear decodability is largely a property of what a subject's representation already carries, rather than of the relation being decoded. Moving the unit of analysis from the relation to the individual fact, we conclude that new relation datasets and analysis methods are needed to address several problems in existing datasets, most prominently semantically weak first tokens (e.g., most predicted universities' first token is "University") and reference competition (e.g., the LLM confuses obscure actor names with competing non-actor entities that have the same last name). Our full pipeline is available at https://github.com/jonasrohw/entity-lens
articles.titleCn: 在不涉及关系的情况下预测线性关系解码可预测性
articles.abstractCn: 线性关系嵌入（LREs）通过仿射函数近似语言模型的主体到客体的映射。它们在不同关系中的忠实度差异巨大，从“人-父亲”关系接近零到“国家-首都城市”关系达到顶峰。我们研究了导致这种差异的因素，并证明它可以从一个对底层关系不知情的读数中显著预测。为此，我们提出了一种新的雅可比透镜形式——实体透镜。雅可比透镜在所有标记和概念上进行估计，而实体透镜EL_t被训练来预测模型在“{}被熟知于”的中性提示下，对于一个类型为t的实体将输出什么，例如，我们为国家和人训练了ELs。在估计出实体透镜后，我们测量它在不使用任何关系特定信息的情况下，对模型关系答案的排名有多高。在Olmo-3-7B上的LRE数据集的28种关系中，这种关系无关分数与LRE的忠实度相关，相关系数为ρ=0.7355（p<.01）。这表明线性解码能力在很大程度上是主体表示本身所携带的属性，而不是解码关系本身的属性。将分析单位从关系转移到单个事实，我们得出结论，需要新的关系数据集和分析方法来解决现有数据集中的一些问题，最突出的是语义薄弱的第一个标记（例如，大多数预测的大学第一个标记是“大学”）和引用竞争（例如，LLM将模糊的演员名字与具有相同姓氏的竞争非演员实体混淆）。我们的完整流程可在https://github.com/jonasrohw/entity-lens获取。

articles.title: CEFR-oriented Russian Text Simplification Using Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: We present a study on controlled automatic simplification of Russian texts using preference-based optimization algorithms with a focus on adapting texts to the A1, A2 and B1 proficiency levels. We fine-tune YandexGPT using Rejection Sampling and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) methods to improve control over the complexity of the generated text. We compare several training configurations that differ in dataset composition, text type and the strategy used to construct preference pairs for DPO. For automatic evaluation we train a regression model based on ruRoBERTa-large to predict continuous complexity scores corresponding to CEFR levels. We also consider semantic similarity, lexical coverage and quantitative readability metrics. Human evaluation assesses simplicity, fluency and adequacy. Our best model achieves 87.15\% target level accuracy, an MAE of 0.35 CEFR levels and a target interval MAE of 0.11. Manual assessment shows that 75% of the evaluated simplifications match the target morphological and syntactic level, and fluency and adequacy scores are especially high for A2 and B1. Although A1 remains the most challenging level, the model significantly reduces the proportion of vocabulary and grammatical constructions beyond the target level while generally preserving meaning. Our model is freely available on $\href{https://huggingface.co/kmustakova/RuSimplifier_DPO}{HuggingFace}$.
articles.titleCn: 面向CEFR的俄语文本简化方法：强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出一项关于使用基于偏好的优化算法对俄语文本进行可控自动简化的研究，重点在于将文本适配到A1、A2和B1水平。我们采用拒绝采样和直接偏好优化（DPO）方法对YandexGPT进行微调，以提升生成文本复杂性的控制能力。我们比较了几个不同的训练配置，这些配置在数据集构成、文本类型以及用于构建DPO偏好对策略上存在差异。为了自动评估，我们基于ruRoBERTa-large训练了一个回归模型，以预测对应CEFR水平的连续复杂性分数。我们还考虑了语义相似度、词汇覆盖率和定量可读性指标。人工评估则评估了简洁性、流畅性和适当性。我们的最佳模型达到了87.15%的目标水平准确率，均方误差（MAE）为0.35个CEFR水平，目标区间均方误差（MAE）为0.11。手动评估显示，75%的评估简化文本符合目标形态和句法水平，A2和B1的流畅性和适当性评分尤其高。尽管A1仍然是最具挑战性的水平，但模型显著降低了超出目标水平的词汇和语法结构的比例，同时总体上保留了意义。我们的模型可在HuggingFace上免费获取：https://huggingface.co/kmustakova/RuSimplifier_DPO。

articles.title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
articles.abstract: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. The planner is instruction-tuned on 208,928 samples from 32 public medical benchmarks, covering single- and multi-tool interactions across single and multiple rounds. We separately evaluate tool orchestration, response synthesis, and end-to-end execution on held-out samples. MMedAgent-Plus achieves tool-call accuracies of 91.0%, 98.1%, and 80.7% in single-tool multi-round, multi-tool multi-round, and multi-tool single-round settings, respectively. Given correct tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus achieves scores of 14.4-14.8 out of 15 for faithfulness, completeness, and conciseness across 600 evaluation samples. In end-to-end execution without pre-supplied tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus correctly invokes the required specialist in 90.6% of 350 evaluation cases spanning seven tasks. Its final-answer accuracy reaches 0.98, matching the dedicated leading specialist and exceeding the strongest baseline (0.28).
articles.titleCn: MMedAgent-Plus：跨模态、任务和流程扩展多模态医疗代理
articles.abstractCn: 医疗工作流程通常需要多个相互依赖的分析，但现有的专业和通用AI模型并未设计用于协调它们。我们介绍了MMedAgent-Plus，一个多模态医疗工具使用代理，它结合了一个视觉语言规划器与18个领先的专业模型，涵盖12项任务和8种模态。通过统一的工具接口，规划器选择专家，按顺序执行它们，并根据它们的输出生成综合响应。规划器在32个公共医疗基准的208,928个样本上进行指令微调，覆盖了单工具和多工具在单轮和多轮中的交互。我们分别对工具编排、响应合成和端到端执行在保留样本上进行了评估。MMedAgent-Plus在单工具多轮、多工具多轮和多工具单轮设置中分别达到了91.0%、98.1%和80.7%的工具调用准确率。在给定正确工具输出的情况下，MMedAgent-Plus在600个评估样本中对忠实度、完整性和简洁性分别达到了14.4-14.8分（满分15分）。在无需预先提供工具输出的端到端执行中，MMedAgent-Plus在涵盖七项任务的350个评估案例中正确调用了所需专家的比例达到90.6%。其最终答案准确率达到了0.98，与专用领先专家相当，并超过了最强的基线（0.28）。

articles.title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
articles.abstract: Cooperative language-model agents can improve without weight updates by revising reusable skills, but only if a shared team reward is traced to the responsible agent and skill. Existing methods credit the skills present in each trajectory, yet presence is not responsibility: a harmful skill active in successful runs still earns positive credit. We present \textbf{GRSE}, \textbf{G}roup-\textbf{R}elative \textbf{S}kill \textbf{E}volution, which assigns behavioral credit by comparison: inspired by GRPO, it executes each question several times under the same skill libraries and contrasts the executions to credit agent--skill pairs, with structured diagnosis of failures. On HotpotQA and LoCoMo with two open-weight actors, GRSE outperforms MASkills, the closest prior method, on HotpotQA and every LoCoMo category except open-domain, with the largest gains on multi-hop questions ($+6.7$ and $+3.2$ F1). Its gains rest on better-grounded retrieval rather than answers given without evidence, and its learned skills transfer between the multi-hop tasks. GRSE is robust to corrupted libraries: starting from planted harmful skills, it credits every planted skill with the correct sign and recovers the score of a clean library ($+6.3$ points), whereas MASkills misattributes two and falls below its starting point.
articles.titleCn: 哪个代理的技能应该改变？进化多智能体团队的组相对信用分配
articles.abstractCn: 协作式语言模型代理可以通过修订可重用技能来提升性能，而无需更新权重，但前提是必须将共享团队奖励追溯到负责的代理和技能。现有方法将每个轨迹中存在的技能进行归因，然而存在并不代表负责：一个在成功运行中起作用的有害技能仍然会获得正向归因。我们提出了\textbf{GRSE}，即\textbf{G}roup-\textbf{R}elative \textbf{S}kill \textbf{E}volution（相对小组技能进化），该方法通过比较来分配行为归因：受GRPO启发，它在同一技能库下多次执行每个问题，并将执行结果进行对比，以归因于代理-技能对，同时提供结构化的失败诊断。在HotpotQA和LoCoMo数据集上，使用两个开放权重代理时，GRSE在HotpotQA和除开放域外的所有LoCoMo类别上都优于MASkills（现有最接近的方法），在多跳问题上的提升最为显著（F1提升6.7和3.2）。其性能提升基于更可靠的检索，而非无证据的答案，并且其学习的技能可以在多跳任务间迁移。GRSE对损坏的技能库具有鲁棒性：从植入的有害技能开始，它能正确归因所有植入技能的符号，并恢复干净库的得分（提升6.3分），而MASkills则出现了错误归因，得分低于初始水平。

articles.title: Profile-DP: Differential Privacy for User-Controlled Profile Release in Personalized LLM Inference
articles.abstract: Personalized large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on profile-conditioned inference, pairing public requests with rich, user-specific facts. This paradigm exposes the user profile itself, together with the user's explicit sharing preferences. We introduce Profile-DP, a policy-aware local differential privacy framework designed specifically for user-profile release in personalized LLM inference. Profile-DP provably bounds the release of user-withheld facts while treating public instructions, profile schemas, and authorized facts as public side information. By generating a privatized profile that composes with the public instruction prior to answer generation, our framework decouples formal privacy guarantees from downstream model behavior. We develop two finite-domain mechanisms satisfying Profile-DP: DP-SLOT independently perturbs protected attributes, while DP-BLOCK uses public semantic decisions to coordinate their release and jointly sample related attributes. A positive, public compatibility prior connects these attributes while preserving a profile-level privacy bound. On PEEP, DP-BLOCK leads the utility composite among DP methods at all 13 structured budgets and is closest to the ideal privacy--utility point in 18 of 26 format--budget settings under our composite weighting. Direct measurements reveal complementary strengths: DP-BLOCK discloses less, while DP-SLOT retains more authorized facts. These results make policy-aware profile release a practical basis for studying privacy and personalization.
articles.titleCn: 用户控制的个性化LLM推理中的用户资料发布差分隐私
articles.abstractCn: 个性化大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地依赖于基于用户画像的条件推理，将公开请求与丰富的用户特定信息相匹配。这种范式不仅暴露了用户画像本身，还包括用户的明确分享偏好。我们引入了Profile-DP，这是一个针对个性化LLM推理中用户画像发布的策略感知本地差分隐私框架。Profile-DP能够证明地限制用户隐藏信息的发布，同时将公开指令、画像模式和授权信息视为公开侧信息。通过在生成答案之前生成一个经过隐私保护的画像，该框架将正式的隐私保证与下游模型行为解耦。我们开发了两种满足Profile-DP的有限域机制：DP-SLOT独立地对受保护属性进行扰动，而DP-BLOCK则利用公开语义决策来协调其发布，并联合采样相关属性。一个正的、公开的兼容先验将这些属性联系起来，同时保持画像级别的隐私界限。在PEEP上，DP-BLOCK在所有13种结构化预算中在DP方法中效用最高，并且在26种格式预算设置中的18种情况下，在我们的复合加权下最接近理想的隐私-效用点。直接测量揭示了互补的优势：DP-BLOCK泄露更少，而DP-SLOT保留了更多授权信息。这些结果使策略感知的画像发布成为研究隐私和个性化实用基础。

articles.title: LoWAgent: A Low-Resource Multilingual Benchmark for Web Agents
articles.abstract: Web agents are typically evaluated on English-language interfaces, leaving their ability to operate across the world's multilingual websites largely unexplored. This gap is especially significant for low-resource languages, where standardized resources for evaluating web agents remain limited. To address this gap, we introduce Low-Resource Web Agent Benchmark (LoWAgent), a benchmark for evaluating web agents across different low-resource languages (LRLs) in comparison to the default, English. LoWAgent evaluates web agents across English and four LRLs: Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, and Amharic. The benchmark comprises of six fully localized websites, instantiated across five languages to yield 3,000 task instances. We evaluate three closed-source and five open-source models across all five languages on all six websites. Our findings show that both closed-source and open-source models experience performance degradation for LRLs compared to English, with substantially greater performance drops observed among the open-source model agents. We further evaluate the robustness of the models on realistic interface disruptions, such as cookie notices and advertisement pop-ups, and find that these further degrade agentic performance. Finally, we show that post-training on a small subset of LoWAgent traces can significantly improve low-resource language agentic task performance, demonstrating the usefulness of our benchmark.
articles.titleCn: LoWAgent：一个低资源多语言网络智能体基准
articles.abstractCn: 网络代理通常在英文界面上进行评估，导致其跨全球多语种网站操作的能力在很大程度上未被探索。这一差距对于低资源语言尤其显著，因为针对评估网络代理的标准资源仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们引入了低资源网络代理基准（LoWAgent），这是一个用于评估不同低资源语言（LRLs）中的网络代理与默认英文对比的基准。LoWAgent评估网络代理在英文和四种LRLs（印地语、孟加拉语、乌尔都语和阿姆哈拉语）中的表现。该基准包含六个完全本地化的网站，在五种语言中实例化，以产生3000个任务实例。我们在所有五种语言和所有六个网站上评估了三种闭源模型和五种开源模型。我们的研究发现，与英文相比，闭源和开源模型在LRLs上的性能均有所下降，其中开源模型代理的性能下降幅度更大。我们进一步评估了模型在真实界面干扰（如饼干通知和广告弹窗）下的鲁棒性，发现这些干扰进一步降低了代理性能。最后，我们表明，在LoWAgent轨迹的小子集上进行后训练可以显著提高低资源语言代理任务的性能，证明了我们基准的有效性。

articles.title: The Culture Within: Towards Mechanistic Understanding of Cultural Reasoning in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate across culturally diverse settings, yet existing evaluations largely measure cultural behavior at the output level. We introduce CultureLens, a reference-grounded benchmark and mechanistic study of how LLMs use cultural information. CultureLens contains 9,261 scenarios across 75 countries and systematically varies country, value, true-norm, and contradictory-norm evidence. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-3-12B, and Qwen-3.5-27B, stating a contradictory norm lowers aligned answers by 32-47 percentage points, even when the model answers correctly from the country alone. Mechanistically, models default to Anglophone norms when no country is given. The failure under a contradictory norm is not one of missing knowledge, as blocking the norm inside the model restores the correct answer in most cases. Models accept a stated norm according to how it is presented and not whether it is true, which leaves them most exposed to errors in retrieved content. Supervised fine-tuning with contradictory-norm examples raises aligned answers under a contradictory norm to 85-93%, including on unseen countries, at a small cost under a true norm.
articles.titleCn: 内在文化：迈向对大型语言模型中文化推理的机制性理解
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于文化多样性环境中，但现有的评估主要在输出层面衡量文化行为。我们介绍了CultureLens，这是一个基于参考的基准和机制研究，探讨LLMs如何使用文化信息。CultureLens包含跨越75个国家的9,261个场景，系统地变化国家、价值观、真实规范和矛盾规范证据。在Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-3-12B和Qwen-3.5-27B上，陈述矛盾规范会降低32-47个百分点的对齐答案，即使模型仅从国家层面回答正确。机制上，当未给出国家时，模型默认采用英语规范。在矛盾规范下的失败并非知识缺失，因为阻止模型内部的规范可以大多数情况下恢复正确答案。模型根据陈述规范的方式接受规范，而非是否真实，这使得它们最容易受到检索内容错误的影响。使用矛盾规范示例进行监督微调，可以将矛盾规范下的对齐答案提高到85-93%，包括在未见过国家的情况下，且在真实规范下成本较小。

articles.title: Preference-Aware Pareto Steering for Multi-Task Speech LLMs
articles.abstract: Speech large language models (LLMs) perform multiple tasks, including automatic speech recognition (ASR), timestamp prediction (TS), and speech translation (ST). Joint training of speech LLMs creates task trade-offs, yet standard training with fixed loss weights does not generally control the resulting trade-off according to deployment preferences. To address this, we propose Endpoint-Anchored Preference-Aware Sampling Uniformly along the Pareto Front (EA-SURF), an a priori method that adapts scalarization weights so that the resulting task trade-off reflects the desired preference. EA-SURF retains the standard weighted-loss training pipeline, tracking the current model's performance relative to each task-specific reference and adapting the scalarization weights as training proceeds. We theoretically show that EA-SURF can match a desired preference, with the update becoming stationary at the target under checkable regularity conditions. Across six three-objective speech LLM requests, EA-SURF empirically converges toward the requested targets and increases endpoint-inclusive normalized hypervolume by 17.8% over fixed loss weighting.
articles.titleCn: 任务偏好感知的帕累托引导多任务语音大语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 语音大型语言模型（LLMs）执行多种任务，包括自动语音识别（ASR）、时间戳预测（TS）和语音翻译（ST）。语音LLMs的联合训练会产生任务权衡，但标准的固定损失权重训练通常无法根据部署偏好来控制产生的权衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了端点锚定偏好感知沿帕累托前沿均匀采样（EA-SURF），这是一种先验方法，通过调整标量化权重，使产生的任务权衡反映所需的偏好。EA-SURF保留了标准的加权损失训练流程，跟踪当前模型相对于每个特定任务的参考的性能，并在训练过程中调整标量化权重。我们理论上证明了EA-SURF可以在满足可验证的规律条件下匹配所需的偏好，并在目标点达到稳定。在六个三目标语音LLM请求中，EA-SURF经验上收敛到请求的目标，并比固定损失加权使端点包含的归一化超体积增加了17.8%。

articles.title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
articles.abstract: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably in isolation. This degradation cannot be fully explained by the accumulation of independent errors. Across both open-weight models and the frontier model Claude Opus 5, our findings instead point to an implicit thinking budget underlying this effect. In particular, under composition, models use substantially fewer tokens per task than in isolation, even when the full sequence remains well within the context window. Tasks that require longer solution traces in isolation are consequently more $\textit{fragile}$ under composition, i.e., models make more errors on prompts containing these tasks. In isolation, non-fragile tasks receive more reasoning than they need and waste compute. However, by grouping tasks according to their fragility, the implicit budgeting can be manipulated to reduce token usage by $43$\% across a range of math and linguistic tasks while also preserving accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 任务在组合下的脆弱性：语言模型中的隐式预算
articles.abstractCn: 现代语言模型越来越多地被要求在单个提示中处理多项任务。这样做需要正确解决每个任务，并将生成的答案整合到一个连贯的回应中。在本文中，我们识别出这一过程中一个基本限制：当任务组合时，即使模型能够可靠地独立解决每个构成任务，它们也会犯更多错误。这种退化不能完全用独立错误的累积来解释。在开放权重模型和前沿模型Claude Opus 5中，我们的发现反而指向了这一效应背后存在的隐性思考预算。具体来说，在组合情况下，模型每个任务的用词量显著少于独立情况，即使整个序列仍然在上下文窗口内。因此，那些在独立情况下需要更长的解决方案轨迹的任务在组合情况下更为$\textit{脆弱}$，即模型在这些包含这些任务的提示上犯更多错误。在独立情况下，非脆弱任务会得到超出所需的推理，从而浪费计算资源。然而，通过根据任务的脆弱性进行分组，可以操纵隐性预算以在一系列数学和语言任务中减少用词量高达43%，同时保持准确性。

articles.title: SITO: Sifting a Commercial Text-Safety API for Missed Harm and False Flags in English, Ukrainian and Surzhyk
articles.abstract: Platforms that host young users screen messages with commercial text-safety APIs, but independent evidence on how often such systems miss harm or flag harmless text is scarce, especially outside English, and the documentation of the one studied here leaves its false-positive rate unquantified. We evaluated one such API, Tuteliq Detect as deployed under the release identifier tuteliq-detect-v5.20261011 (not the separately published v6 model), on six harm categories: authorised push-payment fraud, money-mule recruitment, social engineering, romance scams, gambling harm and bullying. We built SITO (Synthetic Independent Text-safety benchmark with Overflagging tests; sito is Ukrainian for 'sieve'), 2,332 synthetic cases in English, Ukrainian and mixed Ukrainian, with each harmful case matched by hard harmless ones: same-topic messages, minimal-edit contrasts, warnings and retrospective accounts. On English text the system flagged 84.9-94.1% of harmful cases and 0-4.3% of harmless ones per category. It missed third-party reports of ongoing harm far more often than perpetrators' messages (63.6% against 95.1% recall, all languages), when sent without the settings the API offers for reports of harm. Ukrainian and mixed-language input was detected at least as often as English, recall was lower on text from a held-out generator family, so headline recall may be optimistic, and 3.2% of cases received a different decision in repeated runs. A platform should measure false positives on its own traffic and check how bystander reports are handled. The datasets, generation prompts and code are released.
articles.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10883
articles.titleCn: SITO：筛选商业文本安全API，以发现英语、乌克兰语和Surzhyk中的遗漏危害和错误标记
articles.abstractCn: 为年轻用户提供服务的平台使用商业文本安全API进行消息筛查，但关于此类系统错报有害内容或标记无害内容的频率，独立证据非常缺乏，尤其是在英语之外的语言中，而本研究中研究的系统文档未量化其误报率。我们对一款名为Tuteliq Detect的API（部署标识符为tuteliq-detect-v5.20261011，非单独发布的v6模型）在六个危害类别上进行了评估：授权推送支付欺诈、钱袋招募、社会工程、浪漫诈骗、赌博危害和欺凌。我们构建了SITO（合成独立文本安全基准，含过度标记测试；sito在乌克兰语中意为“筛子”），包含2332个英语、乌克兰语和混合乌克兰语的合成案例，每个有害案例均与硬性无害案例匹配：同主题消息、最小编辑对比、警告和回顾性描述。在英语文本上，系统按类别标记了84.9-94.1%的有害案例和0-4.3%的无害案例。当未使用API提供的危害报告设置时，系统错报第三方正在进行的危害远多于作案者消息（63.6%对95.1%的召回率，所有语言），乌克兰语和混合语言输入的检测频率至少与英语相当，从保留的生成器家族文本召回率较低，因此头条召回率可能过于乐观，且3.2%的案例在重复运行中获得了不同结果。平台应测量自身流量中的误报情况，并检查旁观者报告的处理方式。数据集、生成提示和代码已公开。

articles.title: GRID: Modeling Health Influencer Discourse as Argument Networks for Credibility Assessment
articles.abstract: Health-related discussions on social media are increasingly shaped by influencers who offer diverse, and often competing perspectives on the same issue. Yet, such content is typically evaluated in isolation, without considering the broader discourse in which it appears. We introduce GRID (Grounded Reasoning over Interconnected Discourse), a framework for evaluating influencer content through collective inference over the surrounding discourse. GRID represents each video as an argumentation graph connecting claims to its central message, or takeaway, links related claims and takeaways across videos, grounds claims in scientific evidence, and jointly infers credibility over the resulting network. We evaluate GRID on an end-to-end health-related content validation task using 569 influencer videos grounded in expert assessments. Our results show that accounting for the broader discourse improves influencer content validation. Finally, we use GRID-inferred credibility to demonstrate how argumentative strategies and moral framing differ between low- and high-credibility content.
articles.titleCn: 网格：将健康影响者话语建模为论证网络以进行可信度评估
articles.abstractCn: 社交媒体上的健康相关讨论正越来越多地受到意见领袖的影响，他们在同一问题上提供了多样化和常常相互竞争的观点。然而，这类内容通常被孤立地评估，而没有考虑其出现的更广泛的讨论背景。我们介绍了GRID（Grounded Reasoning over Interconnected Discourse，基于互联话语的扎根推理）框架，这是一个通过围绕话语的集体推理来评估意见领袖内容的框架。GRID将每个视频表示为一个论证图，将主张与其核心信息或要点连接起来，跨视频链接相关的主张和要点，将主张扎根于科学证据，并在生成的网络中共同推理可信度。我们在一个包含569个基于专家评估的意见领袖视频的端到端健康相关内容验证任务上评估了GRID。我们的结果表明，考虑更广泛的讨论可以提高意见领袖内容的验证效果。最后，我们使用GRID推断的可信度来展示低可信度和高可信度内容在论证策略和道德框架上的差异。

articles.title: ICLHerd: Herding-Based Data Selection for LLMs with In-Context Learning as a Proxy
articles.abstract: Data selection plays a central role in modern large language model training, as the quality of training data strongly influences downstream performance. A common approach is to curate a development set that encodes the desired skills (e.g., reasoning or multilinguality) and select data that are similar to them. Existing methods compute similarity using cosine distance over either the model's hidden states or gradients. However, we observe that this max-similarity strategy induces a mode-seeking bias: the selected data clusters tightly around the development samples. To address this, we propose ICLHerd, a data selection framework that leverages the von Mises-Fisher kernel to balance mode-seeking with mode-averaging. We further introduce in-context learning as a validation proxy, enabling efficient hyperparameter search over the balance trade-off. Results show that ICLHerd outperforms existing LLM data selection algorithms, highlighting the importance of balancing mode-seeking and mode-averaging.
articles.titleCn: ICLHerd：基于放牧的数据选择方法，用于具有情境学习作为代理的LLMs
articles.abstractCn: 数据选择在现代大型语言模型训练中扮演着核心角色，因为训练数据的质量对下游性能有显著影响。一种常见的方法是构建一个编码所需技能（例如推理或多语言能力）的开发集，并选择与开发样本相似的数据。现有方法通过计算模型隐藏状态或梯度上的余弦距离来度量相似性。然而，我们观察到这种最大相似性策略会导致模式寻求偏差：选中的数据紧密地聚集在开发样本周围。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ICLHerd，一个利用冯·米塞斯-费希尔核来平衡模式寻求与模式平均的数据选择框架。我们进一步引入情境学习作为验证代理，从而能够高效地搜索平衡权衡的超参数。结果表明，ICLHerd优于现有的LLM数据选择算法，突显了平衡模式寻求与模式平均的重要性。

articles.title: Joint Constraint Aggregation for Qualifier-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented QA
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented QA can fail even when the correct answer is in the retrieved evidence. This can happen when a competing answer satisfies some, but not all, of the question's requirements and is mentioned frequently in the retrieved documents, which can make it appear to be the best-supported answer. To test whether this retrieval skew actually affects the decision, we manipulate it directly: increasing the prevalence of passages that favor the competing answer makes the model more likely to select it. This points to a decision problem that candidate-level support alone cannot resolve. We therefore introduce Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares candidates against the same question-derived requirements using the retrieved evidence. Across three evaluation settings and three instruction-tuned backbones, JCA improves overall accuracy, and its advantage grows when retrieval favors a competing answer. Together, these results suggest that when partial matches and retrieval prominence pull models toward a competing answer, comparing candidates against the question's full requirements can make selection more reliable.
articles.titleCn: 针对限定词敏感的检索增强问答的联合约束聚合
articles.abstractCn: 即使正确答案包含在检索到的证据中，检索增强型问答也可能失败。这种情况可能发生在竞争性答案满足问题部分而非全部要求，并且在检索到的文档中频繁出现，从而使其看起来像是得到最佳支持的答案时发生。为了测试这种检索偏差是否确实影响决策，我们直接对其进行操控：增加支持竞争性答案的段落的出现频率，使模型更有可能选择该答案。这指向了一个仅靠候选级支持无法解决的问题。因此，我们引入了联合约束聚合（JCA），它使用检索到的证据，将候选答案与基于问题派生要求的相同要求进行比较。在三个评估设置和三个指令微调的骨干网络中，JCA提高了整体准确率，并且当检索偏向竞争性答案时，其优势会增长。这些结果共同表明，当部分匹配和检索突出将模型引向竞争性答案时，将候选答案与问题的全部要求进行比较可以使选择更加可靠。

articles.title: Beyond Two Tracks: Speaker-Anchored Full-Duplex Dialogue Recovery
articles.abstract: Spoken interaction is moving from alternating turns to full-duplex conversation, where an agent listens while speaking. Learning this coordination requires natural dialogue with persistent speaker-resolved tracks, a data requirement that remains difficult to satisfy at scale. Generative recovery offers a route from ordinary recordings, but recovering two voices is not enough: their track assignments can drift as the conversation unfolds. We address this missing link with speaker-anchored routing before diffusion: a 1.84M-parameter module matches the separator's coarse streams to fixed enrollment identities and orders them before a frozen generator reconstructs the speech, without retraining the generator or altering the reconstructed audio. On 25-minute remote conversations, routing cuts wrong-track time from 43.9% to 4.1%, below the 6.2% of matched-enrollment waveform re-identification, with its largest advantage when one participant holds the floor (17.8% versus 28.6%), and raises fixed-track activity F1 from 0.46 to 0.84 while per-chunk reconstruction quality is unchanged. The same router transfers to unseen face-to-face and telephone recordings, and a margin-gated verification step brings their wrong-track time to 0.9-1.7% while embedding 20-36% of the output, where full re-identification embeds all of it. Recovered voices thus become the participant-consistent tracks that full-duplex dialogue modeling needs. Audio examples: https://elpsykongloo.github.io/beyond-two-tracks/
articles.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Audio examples: https://elpsykongloo.github.io/beyond-two-tracks/
articles.titleCn: 超越双轨：基于说话人锚定的全双工对话恢复
articles.abstractCn: 语音交互正从交替发言模式转变为全双工对话模式，即代理在说话时同时倾听。学习这种协调性需要持续具有发言者解析轨迹的自然对话，而这一数据需求在规模化上仍然难以满足。生成式恢复提供了一条从普通录音中获取数据的途径，但仅恢复两个声音是不够的：随着对话的展开，它们的轨迹分配可能会漂移。我们通过在扩散前进行基于发言者的路由来解决这个问题：一个包含184万个参数的模块将分隔符的粗略流匹配到固定的注册身份，并在冻结的生成器重建语音之前对它们进行排序，而无需重新训练生成器或改变重建的音频。在25分钟的远程对话中，路由将错误轨迹时间从43.9%降低到4.1%，低于匹配注册波形重新识别的6.2%（其最大优势出现在发言者主导时，从17.8%降至28.6%），同时将固定轨迹活动F1从0.46提高到0.84，而每个片段的重建质量保持不变。相同的路由器可以迁移到未见过的面对面和电话录音中，一个带边距门控的验证步骤将它们的错误轨迹时间降低到0.9-1.7%，同时嵌入20-36%的输出，而完整重新识别则嵌入全部内容。因此，恢复的声音成为全双工对话建模所需的参与者一致轨迹。音频示例：https://elpsykongloo.github.io/beyond-two-tracks/

articles.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
articles.abstract: Recent Omni LLMs (OLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in joint audio-visual reasoning, yet cross-modal hallucinations remain a major challenge. Existing mitigation methods mainly operate at the output level, overlooking the entanglement of grounding evidence and learned priors within fused representations. To address this issue, we propose Omni-Woodpecker (OWP), a training-free framework that shifts hallucination mitigation from output-level manipulation to conflict-conditioned representation rebalancing. Specifically, OWP first identifies cross-modal conflicts from complementary modality-specific views. It then employs orthogonal decomposition to separate grounding evidence from competing priors within the hidden states. Finally, OWP adaptively rebalances fused representations by suppressing misleading priors and restoring ignored evidence before decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and strong cross-architecture generalization of OWP. Using Qwen2.5-Omni-7B as the backbone, OWP improves performance by 12.9 and 8.6 points on CMM and AVHBench, respectively, while consistently achieving gains of 0.67-2.25 points across four general OLLM reasoning benchmarks. Furthermore, OWP generalizes effectively to VideoLLaMA2-AV, improving performance by 4.6 and 3.9 points on the same benchmarks. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZiiJianLiu/Omni-Woodpecker
articles.titleCn: 全向啄木鸟：通过证据先验重平衡校正全向大语言模型幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 近期，Omni LLMs（OLLMs）在联合音视频推理方面展现出卓越的能力，但跨模态幻觉仍然是一个主要挑战。现有的缓解方法主要在输出层面进行操作，忽视了融合表征中 grounding evidence 和 learned priors 的纠缠关系。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 Omni-Woodpecker（OWP），这是一个无需训练的框架，将幻觉缓解从输出层面的操控转变为冲突条件下的表征再平衡。具体而言，OWP 首先从互补的模态特定视图中识别跨模态冲突。然后，它采用正交分解方法，将 grounding evidence 从竞争性 priors 中分离出来，存在于隐藏状态中。最后，在解码前，OWP 通过抑制误导性 priors 并恢复被忽略的证据，自适应地再平衡融合表征。大量实验验证了 OWP 的有效性和强大的跨架构泛化能力。以 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 作为主干网络，OWP 在 CMM 和 AVHBench 上分别提升了 12.9 和 8.6 个百分点，同时在四个通用 OLLM 推理基准测试中始终实现了 0.67-2.25 个百分点的增益。此外，OWP 能有效泛化到 VideoLLaMA2-AV，在相同基准测试上提升了 4.6 和 3.9 个百分点。代码已公开发布在 https://github.com/ZiiJianLiu/Omni-Woodpecker。

articles.title: SciFigBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Method Figure Understanding
articles.abstract: Scientific method figures often provide researchers with a clear visual entry point into a paper's methodology and core contributions, yet their dense layouts and complex information flows are difficult for Vision Language Models (VLMs) to interpret. Existing benchmarks predominantly focus on coarse-grained tasks, such as context-based retrieval or holistic comprehension, overlooking the fine-grained content and inter-module relations within complex methodological diagrams. To address these overlooked aspects, we introduce Scientific Figure Benchmark (SciFigBench), a benchmark for evaluating core capabilities required for scientific method figure understanding. Specifically, it targets three capabilities: dense content perception, visual relation comprehension, and information-flow tracing. For this purpose, we curate 4,352 scientific method figures from real-world research papers and construct 40,670 QA pairs to operationalize these capabilities as measurable question-answering tasks. All annotations are generated by dedicated pipelines and then manually verified. We further propose SciFigCue, a training-free visual prompting module that externalizes arrow-induced dependencies as visual relational evidence for method-figure reasoning. Experiments across open-source and proprietary VLMs show that even strong models remain substantially limited in visual relation comprehension, while SciFigCue improves performance across several tasks without parameter updates. The code and related resources are available at https://github.com/LeNcyer/SciFigBench.
articles.comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Code and benchmark resources: https://github.com/LeNcyer/SciFigBench
articles.titleCn: SciFigBench：科学方法图理解基准
articles.abstractCn: 科学方法图通常为研究人员提供了一个清晰的视觉入口，帮助他们进入论文的方法论和核心贡献，然而其密集的布局和复杂的信息流对于视觉语言模型（VLMs）来说难以理解。现有的基准测试主要关注粗粒度任务，例如基于上下文的检索或整体理解，而忽略了复杂方法学图中的细粒度内容和模块间关系。为了解决这些被忽视的方面，我们引入了科学方法图基准测试（SciFigBench），这是一个用于评估科学方法图理解所需核心能力的基准测试。具体而言，它针对三种能力：密集内容感知、视觉关系理解和信息流追踪。为此，我们从真实研究论文中收集了4,352个科学方法图，并构建了40,670个问答对，将这些能力转化为可测量的问答任务。所有标注均由专用流程生成，然后进行人工验证。我们进一步提出了SciFigCue，这是一个无需训练的视觉提示模块，它将箭头引起的依赖关系作为视觉关系证据，用于方法图推理。跨开源和专有VLMs的实验表明，即使是强大的模型在视觉关系理解方面仍然存在显著限制，而SciFigCue在不更新参数的情况下提高了多个任务的性能。代码和相关资源可在https://github.com/LeNcyer/SciFigBench获取。

articles.title: ClockMark: Adaptive and Host-Dependent Watermarking for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) watermarking operates on the next-token distribution that evolves during generation. In streaming generation, each sampled token becomes part of the text and affects subsequent distributions. Embedding therefore proceeds with a changing host, unlike classical watermarking, which adapts embedding to an existing host signal. To accommodate this difference, we formulate a novel embedding framework for LLM watermarking based on two principles. We first argue that embedding should be adaptive, retaining the state of previous sampling decisions to better guide subsequent choices. We further argue that embedding should be host-dependent, using the current LLM distribution to constrain both token selection and state updates. Guided by these principles and the two requirements of distribution preservation and robustness to text editing, we propose ClockMark. It combines adaptive and host-dependent embedding with message spreading, embedding the full payload in each watermarked token. Theoretically, we prove that ClockMark preserves the original LLM sequence distribution, thereby maintaining generation quality. Empirically, extensive experiments against 12 baselines demonstrate improved robustness to text editing, with gains of up to 16.08 percentage points in bit accuracy over the strongest tested baseline.
articles.titleCn: ClockMark：面向大型语言模型的适应性与主机依赖型水印技术
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）水印技术作用于生成过程中不断演变的下一个词分布。在流式生成中，每个采样的词都会成为文本的一部分并影响后续分布。因此，嵌入过程是在一个变化的宿主上进行的，这与经典水印技术不同，后者会根据现有的宿主信号来调整嵌入。为了适应这种差异，我们基于两个原则提出了一个适用于LLM水印的新型嵌入框架。我们首先论证嵌入应该是自适应的，保留先前采样决策的状态以更好地指导后续选择。我们进一步论证嵌入应该是宿主相关的，利用当前的LLM分布来约束词选择和状态更新。在这些原则以及分布保持和文本编辑鲁棒性这两个要求的指导下，我们提出了ClockMark。它结合了自适应和宿主相关的嵌入与信息扩散，将完整有效载荷嵌入到每个水印词中。理论上，我们证明了ClockMark能够保持原始LLM序列分布，从而维持生成质量。实验上，针对12个基线的广泛实验表明，它在文本编辑鲁棒性方面有所提升，相较于最强的测试基线，比特精度提高了高达16.08个百分点。

articles.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
articles.titleCn: OpenVLHarness：多模态记忆的视觉智能代理工具现实应用
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉推理方面取得了快速进展，但许多任务需要仅通过内部推理难以获得的证据：我们对22个基准的受控研究表明，仅增加基础模型的推理预算只能带来有限的提升。这类任务需要基于感知、外部知识和通过异构工具获取的数值测量，其输出必须对模型可解释，并在推理步骤中得以保留。我们引入了OpenVLHarness，这是一个围绕能力层和持久多模态记忆组织起来的多模态推理框架。能力层结合了任务级的工具接口与证据渲染，提供对异构后端的统一访问，并将它们的输出转换为模型可读取的观察结果。持久多模态记忆将相应的图像、结构化数据和网页引用在整个查询过程中保留为可寻址的实体。编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序，实现结合多个工具结果的计算。这些机制共同支持一个迭代过程，用于获取、检查和组合多模态证据。在22个基准测试和8个公开及专有骨干网络上评估，OpenVLHarness相较于匹配的无工具基线平均得分提升9.7-12.6分，包括使用Qwen3-VL-8B提升11.2分，Kimi K3提升9.7分，GPT-6 Astra提升9.9分。使用中等推理强度的GPT-6 Luna时，OpenVLHarness在最大推理强度下比基础模型Codex和Visual Sketchpad分别高出7.7-8.5分，同时模型代币成本最多仅为它们的37%。

articles.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
articles.abstract: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.
articles.titleCn: 它真的能起作用吗？合成功能型CAD机构
articles.abstractCn: 虽然大语言模型代理能够生成视觉上合理的CAD装配体，但这些设计往往无法实现其预期的物理功能。我们研究功能CAD设计，这是一个代理能够解释未指定请求，在物理模拟中构建并迭代修改满足功能需求的机械的设置。验证这些需求并不简单：不同的候选机械可能通过完全不同的组件、控制和操作序列来实现相同的功能。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了FunCAD-Harness框架，该框架将抽象需求转化为针对特定候选机的物理测试，并利用模拟反馈来指导设计修订。为了系统地评估这一能力，我们引入了FunCADBench基准，该基准涵盖了46个具有相互依赖和多步骤操作的机械家族。跨多个前沿大语言模型代理的实验表明，FunCAD-Harness能够揭示视觉检查无法发现的微妙机械故障，显著提高了功能成功率，优于标准的模拟增强基线。最终，我们的工作标志着CAD代理能够将人类意图转化为工作机械的一步。

articles.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.
articles.comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 12 tables, including references and appendices
articles.titleCn: WeAct：动态权重切换作为智能体行为
articles.abstractCn: 长时程智能体必须从交错轨迹中学习异构能力。更新共享参数以学习新能力可能会降低先前获得的能力，导致灾难性遗忘。随着轨迹的展开，不同阶段可能需要不同的能力，然而传统的联合训练和静态适配器合并在整个执行过程中保持固定的参数配置。我们引入了WeAct（权重级别的内部动作），它在一个冻结的主干上训练独立的能力特定LoRA适配器，并将适配器选择添加到智能体的动作空间中。这些内部动作使用模型的原生工具调用接口，在共享上下文中按需组合能力。在八个深度研究基准测试中，使用WeAct的Qwen3-32B相对于完全微调的对应模型平均准确率提高了6.2%，尽管计算资源使用更少，并且相对于最强的静态LoRA合并方法提高了27.5%。WeAct还支持模块化持续适应，通过添加新的代码计算适配器来扩展智能体的能力，并更新现有的写作适配器以提高报告质量。这两次更新都保持主干和其他适配器不变，支持智能体的模块化持续适应。

articles.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.
articles.titleCn: LatComm：用于大型语言模型之间潜在通信的可重复上下文压缩
articles.abstractCn: 将多个大型语言模型（LLM）组合起来的系统通常使用一个上下文来处理许多问题。当上下文作为文本在模型之间传递时，接收模型需要为每个问题重新处理其所有标记。为了避免这种成本，需要一种紧凑、跨问题可重用且可被不同LLM读取的上下文表示。现有的压缩和潜在通信方法各自只提供这些特性中的一部分。我们引入了LatComm，一种提供所有三种特性的潜在通信接口，通过将编码与读取分离来实现：上下文在不包含问题的情况下被编码一次，接收者则根据每个问题选择要读取的内容。一个冻结的上下文编码器LLM将上下文压缩成一个固定大小的数据包并发送给另一个冻结的接收器LLM，该接收器通过交叉注意力机制读取数据包，其门控值由其提示计算得出。在12个多项选择题问答数据集上，LatComm将单向量基线的平均准确率提高了10.2个百分点。在QuALITY数据集上，它将接收器的输入减少了57倍，并将文章问题的回答速度提高了3倍。

articles.title: Discrete Neural Interlingua for Ontology-Agnostic EHR Modeling
articles.abstract: EHR foundation models promise scalable clinical prediction across health systems, yet their deployment is constrained by a tokenization bottleneck. The same clinical concept can appear as different ontology codes, local identifiers, synonyms, or free-text descriptions, which standard EHR tokenizers treat as unrelated symbols. A model trained on MIMIC-III with a closed-vocabulary tokenizer can use only 13% of eICU events. We introduce MEDIATOR, a discrete ontology-agnostic tokenizer that maps any clinical concept expressed as text into a shared vector-quantized codebook, turning EHR harmonization into open-vocabulary tokenization without manual mappings or a fixed vocabulary. Trained with synonym supervision and guided by enriched concept descriptions, code co-occurrence, and relation graphs, MEDIATOR collapses equivalent expressions while organizing distinct concepts in a medically meaningful discrete space. Used as the token interface of an EHR Transformer, MEDIATOR improves mean AUPRC over the strongest prior tokenizer by 4.0 points (8% relative) on 20 MIMIC-III tasks and by 8.6 points (29% relative) in zero-shot transfer to 14 eICU tasks, where it uses all events. The transfer gain combines coverage and representation, as MEDIATOR remains the best tokenizer under identical inputs (+1.0 and +1.9 points on operational and subcohort-mortality tasks). Same-encoder controls show that the text encoder drives in-domain accuracy, while the learned objectives of MEDIATOR drive transfer robustness and entity-linking quality. MEDIATOR also enables transferable attribution across hospitals.
articles.titleCn: 面向本体无关的EHR建模的离散神经中间语言
articles.abstractCn: EHR基础模型承诺实现跨医疗系统的可扩展临床预测，但其部署受到标记化瓶颈的限制。相同的临床概念可能以不同的本体代码、本地标识符、同义词或自由文本描述形式出现，而标准EHR标记化器将这些视为无关的符号。在MIMIC-III上使用封闭词汇标记化器训练的模型只能使用13%的eICU事件。我们引入了MEDIATOR，这是一种离散的本体无关标记化器，它将任何以文本形式表达的临床概念映射到一个共享的向量量化码本中，将EHR标准化转化为开放词汇标记化，无需手动映射或固定词汇。通过同义词监督、丰富的概念描述、代码共现和关系图指导进行训练，MEDIATOR能够合并等价表达，同时将不同概念组织在一个具有医学意义的离散空间中。作为EHR Transformer的标记接口，MEDIATOR在20个MIMIC-III任务上比最强的先前标记化器平均AUPRC提高了4.0分（相对提升8%），并在零样本迁移到14个eICU任务中提高了8.6分（相对提升29%），其中它使用了所有事件。迁移增益结合了覆盖范围和表示能力，因为MEDIATOR在相同输入下仍然是最佳标记化器（在运营和亚组死亡率任务上分别提高了+1.0和+1.9分）。相同编码器的控制实验表明，文本编码器驱动了领域内准确性，而MEDIATOR的学习目标驱动了迁移鲁棒性和实体链接质量。MEDIATOR还支持跨医院的迁移性归因。

articles.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
articles.abstract: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval.
