In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.
articles.titleCn: 混合架构中的竞争学习
articles.abstractCn: 许多现代语言模型采用了结合线性时序递归和softmax注意力的混合架构。现代递归层通过将上下文信息压缩到固定大小的状态来提供高度表达的混合机制，同时确保高吞吐量，但在上下文信息检索方面表现不如softmax注意力。本文揭示了一种竞争学习现象，即不同类型的混合器竞争学习同一函数，当一个层学习到函数时，它会抑制其他层对应的学习信号。层归因分析表明，在典型数据分布下，现代递归比softmax注意力更快地学习检索函数，导致注意力在大多数情况下无法学习检索。在训练中途停止递归的权重更新有助于注意力学习检索。基于这些结果，我们提出了一种分阶段训练程序，用于在自然语言上预训练混合架构。在参数高达1B的模型上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在语言建模损失、常识推理以及不同上下文长度范围内的各种检索相关任务上均取得了显著改进。

articles.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
articles.abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
articles.titleCn: 野外环境中的智能体世界模型：计算机使用智能体环境合成
articles.abstractCn: 智能体学习正从学习人类数据转向通过与世界交互进行学习。然而，在现实世界的计算机系统中直接扩展这种学习具有挑战性，并可能引入显著的安全风险。因此，我们提出了在野外环境中的智能体世界模型（WildAWM），这是一个可扩展的流程，用于合成可控的环境和任务，以训练通用计算机使用智能体（CUAs）。而现有方法通常专注于单一智能体交互界面，我们构建了可执行环境，联合支持图形用户界面、模型上下文协议服务和命令行界面，允许智能体灵活地结合视觉交互、工具使用和代码执行。WildAWM完全由开源模型驱动，证明高质量计算机使用环境可以在没有专有前沿模型的情况下生成。除了环境之外，我们通过引入基于执行的质检门，解决了任务合成中的三个反复出现的挑战：确保可解性、维持足够难度以及生成可靠的验证器，这些质检门结合了异构智能体运行、跨判断一致性检查和对判断鲁棒性的反事实探测。由此产生的流程合成了341个长时程环境-任务对，这些任务可能需要超过100个智能体步骤才能解决，即使对于前沿模型也仍然具有挑战性，GPT-6-Astra仅解决了其中的60%。我们在这些合成世界中专门训练了两个不同规模的Qwen模型。两个模型在涵盖网络、爪和计算机使用智能体的8个分布外基准测试中都取得了显著提升，证明了WildAWM合成世界中的学习可以广泛泛化到未见的计算机使用任务。代码公开可在https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM。

articles.title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
articles.abstract: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.
articles.titleCn: KEEP-Bench：评估上下文压缩中的证据保留
articles.abstractCn: 上下文压缩提升了长文本处理的效率，但可能因信息瓶颈问题导致忠实性问题。现有评估依赖问答指标，但读者仍能从不可靠的压缩中正确回答，因此这些指标低估了此类损失。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了KEEP-Bench，这是一个诊断基准，通过4,102个案例直接评估压缩忠实性，涵盖三个要求保留证据以支持合理参考答案、明确限定词和少数观点的挑战性场景。实验表明，即使采用定制提示，最强模型仍不可靠：尽管上下文窗口超过10万token，输入平均仅3,100token，最佳开源模型（31B）仅在66.8%的案例中保留所有所需证据，最佳专有模型也仅达61.6%。性能在不同证据结构间差异显著，因此基于有限结构的结论可能存在偏差。我们进一步引入了证据保留回报（EPR）指标，将证据召回与推理FLOPs关联，发现其峰值出现在中等规模（4B-8B），此时召回率仍较低。额外输出预算主要惠及已较强的模型，并扩大了能力差距，但这些模型的更强保留能力以高昂的计算成本为代价。这些发现强调了未来研究应关注在较小的计算预算下探究信息保留能力强的压缩器，而非依赖大输出预算或模型规模扩展。

articles.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
articles.abstract: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.
articles.titleCn: RefCraft：通过网页开发对视觉参考条件化智能生成进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 除了基本的工具使用和编码技能外，将视觉参考有效融入自主生成对于将AI代理应用于现实世界的生产力任务同样至关重要。我们通过网页开发来研究这一关键能力，这是一个实用且易于评估的设置，其中现有的基准仍然很大程度上是理想化的：它们通常专注于重建视觉目标或仅从文本指令生成网页，而忽略了从视觉示例进行开发更为常见的流程。具体而言，我们引入了RefCraft，这是一个包含300个现实的多模态网页开发任务的基准，这些任务结合了自然语言指令以及一个到五个参考网页的截图。代理必须在渲染、视觉检查和迭代优化其输出的过程中，选择性地解释和利用这些参考。我们使用独立可验证的关键点和补充的程序化及视觉语言模型（VLM）裁判来评估这些开放式的成果。在九个前沿（M）LLM中，最强的系统总体得分仅为100分中的52.12分，这表明在现实网页开发设置中，基于视觉参考的自主生成对于当前模型仍然是一个重大挑战。

articles.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
articles.abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
articles.titleCn: MemT-1.0：迈向内存原生进化
articles.abstractCn: 内存原生进化要求将内存作为基础模型的本征能力，使其能够持续积累和利用信息。为此，我们引入了MemT-1.0，这是一种将内存内化为模型计算一部分的内存基础模型新架构。基于Metis，MemT-1.0采用带稳定token级内存更新机制的Gated DeltaNet-2。我们进一步引入了Mixture-of-Storage来扩展原生内存容量。经过精心设计的骨干准备后，我们开发了一个由持续预训练和后训练组成的两阶段训练流程，并依托340亿token的训练数据和高效的训练与推理基础设施。我们发布了一个包含MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash的模型家族，并对内存和通用能力进行了全面评估。结果表明，它们在平均上优于参数化内存基线，并保持与检索增强方法的竞争力，同时基本保留了通用能力。在128K token的历史长度下，MemT-1.0-Nano相较于完整上下文KV缓存实现了约1.86倍的端到端推理速度提升和66倍的持久存储减少。通过内化检索到的程序性经验，MemT-1.0提升了代理任务的成功率，为内存原生进化迈出了实际的一步。

articles.title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
articles.abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.
articles.titleCn: SpecMRL：在参数化频谱中重新设计套娃表征学习
articles.abstractCn: 嵌套前缀联合优化的Matryoshka表征学习（MRL）旨在支持灵活的表征尺寸，但该设计缺乏显式约束来确保前导部分提供合适的紧凑编码。为此，我们提出了SpecMRL，通过重组特征空间以实现更有效的前缀读取。具体而言，我们通过基于特征重要性的参数导出频谱基扩展MRL，SpecMRL除遵循标准MRL外，前缀读取在学习的频谱空间中执行。在MTEB上的实验表明，SpecMRL在所有评估的降维尺寸下均优于MRL，在更激进的压缩下增益更大。这些结果表明，学习的频谱基能更好地优先考虑信息量大的方向，从而实现更有效的表征压缩。值得注意的是，SpecMRL扩展了MRL的性能前沿，仅用一半的嵌入维度就超越了全维度的MRL。

articles.title: AfriBED: a Speech Recognition Bias Evaluation Dataset for Low Resource African Languages
articles.abstract: Despite advancements in automatic speech recognition systems (ASR), current systems exhibit speaker-attribute bias, i.e., their speech recognition performance is biased against certain speakers based on their demographic attributes such as gender, accents, and speaker type. However, accurately assessing speaker attribute bias in a given ASR system requires the availability of a bias evaluation dataset with comparable speech across subgroups of a speaker attribute. In this paper, we introduce African speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED), a novel speech recognition bias evaluation dataset for two low resource African languages, Bemba and Nyanja, to detect and estimate gender and speaker-type bias for ASR systems. The dataset comprises 9 hours of speech with 3928 utterances recorded by 80 speakers for Bemba, while the Nyanja set includes 6260 utterances with approximately 18 hours of speech recorded by 127 speakers. The results of our baseline experiments demonstrate that the datasets are useful for examining gender and speaker-type attribute bias in the target languages.
articles.comment: accepted at 2026 IEEE Spoken language Technology Workshop Demo Track
articles.titleCn: AfriBED：一种用于低资源非洲语言语音识别偏差评估的数据集
articles.abstractCn: 尽管自动语音识别系统（ASR）取得了进步，但当前系统仍存在说话人属性偏差，即其语音识别性能会根据说话人的性别、口音和说话人类型等人口统计属性而对某些说话人产生偏差。然而，要准确评估给定ASR系统中的说话人属性偏差，需要使用包含可比语音的偏差评估数据集，该数据集应覆盖说话人属性子群体。在本文中，我们介绍了非洲语音偏差评估数据集（AfriBED），这是一个用于两种低资源非洲语言——班巴语和尼亚尼亚语的新型语音识别偏差评估数据集，旨在检测和评估ASR系统中的性别和说话人类型偏差。该数据集包含9小时的语音，其中班巴语部分由80位说话人录制的3928个话语组成，而尼亚尼亚语部分则包含约18小时的语音，由127位说话人录制的6260个话语组成。我们的基线实验结果表明，这些数据集对于检查目标语言中的性别和说话人类型属性偏差是有用的。

articles.title: ASTOR: Benchmarking and Improving Autoformulation for Soft-Constraint Optimization with a Formal Grammar
articles.abstract: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.
articles.titleCn: ASTOR：基于形式文法对软约束优化自动公式化的基准测试与改进
articles.abstractCn: 现实中的决策问题包含两种性质不同的约束：必须满足的约束，称为硬约束，以及可以违反的偏好，称为软约束。由于这些问题通常以自然语言形式提出给决策者，大型语言模型为协助解决这些问题提供了自然工具。这催生了自动建模，其重点在于使用大型语言模型将决策问题的自然语言描述翻译成可执行的数学优化模型。然而，尽管许多实际问题需要明确建模这些约束，但这项研究往往忽略了消费者、管理人员和规划者提出的软约束。我们介绍了ASTOR，这是一个推理时框架，它将自然语言决策问题映射到语法引导的抽象语法树（AST），然后再将生成的表示确定性编译成可执行优化代码。我们还介绍了SoftOR，这是一个统一的自然语言问题基准，专注于软约束建模。在SoftOR上，ASTOR在可比的单请求和多智能体大型语言模型方法中实现了最高的综合准确率，同时在仅包含硬约束的标准自动建模基准上保持竞争力。代码和数据可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md获取。

articles.title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
articles.abstract: As AI systems begin to resolve open research problems, reliable verification becomes increasingly important. Formal mathematics provides a trusted framework for mathematical reasoning, enabling agents to produce machine-checkable proofs while conducting mathematical exploration. Existing formal mathematics benchmarks often focus on known results or a small set of prominent open problems, which can become difficult to evaluate reliably once solutions are discovered and widely disseminated. Existing evaluation protocols are also not always aligned with how modern coding agents operate. We therefore introduce ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), spanning entry-level open research problems across a broad range of mathematical subfields. We expect these less prominent open problems, which tend to attract less attention and may remain unsolved for longer, to be better suited for held-out evaluation of end-to-end open problem resolution in Lean. We adopt a standard coding-agent evaluation setting, placing each problem and its logical negation into a Lean project in a Docker container. We also build Leanimum-agent on mini-SWE-agent to provide a unified harness for fair comparisons across models. Our evaluation finds that even the best-performing model resolves only ~40% of the problems, leaving substantial room for improvement on formalized open research problems.
articles.titleCn: ReuF2F：在形式化本科研究问题上对编程代理进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 随着人工智能系统开始解决开放研究问题，可靠的验证变得日益重要。形式数学为数学推理提供了一个值得信赖的框架，使代理能够在进行数学探索的同时生成机器可验证的证明。现有的形式数学基准通常关注已知结果或一小部分突出的开放问题，一旦解决方案被发现并广泛传播，就难以进行可靠的评估。现有的评估协议也并不总是与现代编码代理的操作方式相一致。因此，我们引入了ReuF2F，这是一个基于Lean 4的基准，包含来自本科生研究经验（REU）的244个形式化的开放问题，涵盖了数学各个子领域入门级的开放研究问题。我们预计这些不太引人注目的开放问题，由于吸引的注意力较少且可能更长时间未解决，将更适合用于Lean端到端开放问题解决的保留评估。我们采用标准的编码代理评估设置，将每个问题及其逻辑否定放入Docker容器中的Lean项目中。我们还基于mini-SWE-agent构建了Leanimum-agent，以提供统一的测试框架，以便在模型之间进行公平的比较。我们的评估发现，即使是表现最好的模型也只能解决约40%的问题，为形式化开放研究问题留下了巨大的改进空间。

articles.title: Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability
articles.abstract: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.
articles.titleCn: 安全中期训练：将大型语言模型安全能力内化为基础能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全对齐主要在训练后进行，而近期研究也开始将安全数据纳入预训练。然而，当后续训练不再包含安全数据时，安全性能可能会下降，并且安全性的提升往往以牺牲通用能力为代价。这种矛盾表明，安全和通用推理不应被视为独立的训练目标。相反，我们应将安全视为一种可以通过与通用任务共享的推理结构来学习的LLM能力。两者都要求模型理解意图或任务目标、应用相关知识，并进行对潜在后果的推理。我们引入了安全中训练（safety mid-training）的概念，这是一个介于预训练和训练后之间的阶段，通过共享的推理结构联合发展安全性和通用推理。给定安全性和效用提示，基础模型生成结构化文档和推理轨迹，然后用于中训练。与Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B基础模型相比，安全中训练将平均攻击成功率（ASR）降低了72%至81%，同时提升了通用能力。这些优势在后续的训练后阶段仍然存在。在仅进行通用指令微调（SFT）后，中训练模型在很大程度上保留了其安全性，实现了比基线模型更低的ASR，且未牺牲通用能力。它们在仅进行通用推理预训练优化（GRPO）且无安全奖励的情况下也保留了安全性，而后续的强化学习从这些中训练模型初始化时，达到了更好的安全-效用前沿。综合这些结果，表明在共享的中训练阶段学习安全性和通用推理可以减少安全-效用的权衡，并使安全性对后续训练更加鲁棒。

articles.title: Teacher Supervision, Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models
articles.abstract: Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher's bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher's coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce's choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher's probabilities ends at the teacher's decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code in ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 教师监督、固定表示和校准：候选评分决策模型的精确风险计算
articles.abstractCn: 候选评分决策模型会返回一组答案的概率分布。对其中一种系统Jev的公开文档以及其开源对应系统JevAny的描述，描述了三个训练成分，这些成分决定了这些概率所估计的内容：来自更大模型的软目标、冻结的预训练主干网络和温度校准。我们在高斯代理模型中分析了每个成分，在这些模型中，有限样本风险可以精确计算。在教师目标上训练的学生会继承教师的偏差，更多的学生数据无法消除这种偏差，与教师的协议也无法揭示这种偏差。固定的表示形式只能将风险降低到显式的样本量阈值以下。在probit模型中，精确的重新校准映射是温度缩放，只有当教师的系数方向正确时，它才能消除所有多余的风险，否则会留下校准诊断无法检测到的残余风险。根据卢斯的择优公理，候选评分在事件的各种细化中是一致的，当且仅当它们通过log-sum-exp进行聚合。在消费者金融保护局提供的231,521起信用卡投诉数据中，决策是投诉是否以金钱救济结束，一个在逻辑教师概率上训练的学生最终会达到教师的决策成本，而一个在结果上训练的学生会降低8%，一个30B模型在重新校准后仍然比教师差，该模型偏离一致性条件17.5分贝。预训练表示减少了所需的标记数据量，校准修正了概率的尺度，但它们都无法纠正有偏见的教师，因此必须将概率与实际结果进行核对。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Reusability of LLM Pipelines: Financial Extraction, Multilingual Reasoning, and Semantic Screening
articles.abstract: Financial institutions increasingly deploy large language models (LLMs) in multilingual markets, raising a practical question: can pipelines developed and validated in English be reused across languages, or must they be rebuilt per locale? We test cross-lingual reusability along three dimensions--accuracy, reasoning-effort transfer, and behavioural stability--through three complementary tasks. Task 1 (cheque extraction) and Task 2 (Mintaka QA with pinned evidence across nine languages and nine model-effort configurations) test whether accuracy and effort settings transfer; Task 3 (FinanceBench pilot, 50 items over SEC 10-K filings in four languages) validates whether these patterns generalise to financial content. Accuracy reusability is broadly confirmed: Gemini 3.5 Flash achieves 95.2-97.6% extraction accuracy across prompt languages, and FinanceBench per-language means span 5.8pp (77.1-82.9%), though the language-difficulty ranking reverses between domains (Hindi is worst on Mintaka, best on FinanceBench at 82.9%). Effort reusability is domain-dependent: higher reasoning effort yields marginal gains on general-knowledge QA but up to 8pp on financial content, and effort configurations that help in English help proportionally in other languages. Behavioural reusability holds: citation-set overlap with English averages 77-79% Jaccard, with no single language consistently worse. Together, these results support qualified reuse of English-built pipelines, but per-domain, per-language validation remains necessary--neither semantic similarity nor self-reported confidence reliably predicts cross-lingual accuracy.
articles.comment: 15 pages Accepted into ICAIF 2026 AI4F Workshop
articles.titleCn: 跨语言LLM管道的可重用性：金融提取、多语言推理和语义筛选
articles.abstractCn: 金融机构在多语言市场日益广泛地部署大型语言模型（LLM），这引发了一个实际问题：在英语中开发和验证的管道能否跨语言复用，还是必须为每个地区重新构建？我们通过三个互补任务，从准确性、推理努力迁移和行为稳定性三个维度测试跨语言复用性。任务1（支票提取）和任务2（Mintaka问答，涵盖九种语言和九种模型努力配置，锚定证据）测试准确性和努力设置是否迁移；任务3（FinanceBench试点，涵盖四种语言的SEC 10-K文件中的50个项目）验证这些模式是否适用于金融内容。准确性复用性得到广泛证实：Gemini 3.5 Flash在提示语言之间实现95.2-97.6%的提取准确性，FinanceBench每语言均值跨度为5.8个百分点（77.1-82.9%），但语言难度排名在不同领域反转（印地语在Mintaka表现最差，在FinanceBench表现最佳，达82.9%）。努力复用性具有领域依赖性：更高的推理努力在一般知识问答上收益有限，但在金融内容上提升高达8个百分点，且在英语中有效的努力配置在其他语言中也按比例有效。行为复用性成立：引文集与英语的重叠率平均为77-79%的雅可比系数，没有单一语言始终表现较差。综合这些结果，支持对英语构建的管道进行有条件的复用，但每个领域、每语言的验证仍然是必要的——语义相似性或自我报告的置信度都不能可靠地预测跨语言准确性。

articles.title: RESIN: Multi-Chain Reasoning with Entity-Structured Indexing
articles.abstract: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.
articles.titleCn: 树脂：基于实体结构索引的多链推理
articles.abstractCn: 多链推理是一项具有挑战性的任务，不仅因为多链证据是分散的，还因为推理的不同部分可能需要不同且相互作用的支撑链。扁平检索可能会向模型注入松散相关的文本，而早期选择单一推理路径可能会丢弃只有在考虑其他事实后才有用的证据。我们引入了RESIN（基于实体结构索引的推理），它利用结构来定位证据，同时将原始来源作为推理的基础。RESIN将问题分解为专注的单跳需求，为每个跳检索少量基于来源的单位，并将仅此相关证据放置在紧凑的推理缓冲区中。该缓冲区在最终组合之前保留替代支撑，使中间决策明确化，而不会强制采用脆弱的路径。在完整的HolisQA基准测试中，RESIN在所有问题上的上下文召回率达到82.92%，答案相关率达到76.70%，在五个领域中的报告CR和AR均高于已发表的基线，在四个领域中的F1分数也高于已发表的基线。消融实验表明，类型证据多样性和按跳分解都是必不可少的，得出明确结论：精确的证据组织和延迟承诺使多链推理有效且可审计。我们的代码可在https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN获取。

articles.title: Game of Phones: Harnessing Game Theory and LLMs in 'Bot Wars' to Counteract Phone Scams
articles.abstract: Phone scams impose substantial and growing costs on individuals and financial systems worldwide, yet existing countermeasures impose no resource cost on perpetrators. Strategic scam-baiting, in which automated agents engage scammers to deplete their operational capacity, offers a proactive alternative but requires dynamic strategy adaptation that static systems cannot provide. We introduce a game-theoretic framework enabling LLMs to learn effective counter-strategies through in-context experience without fine-tuning. The framework models scammer-baiter interactions as a two-player game with empirically grounded strategies and utility functions, using Nash equilibrium as a formal benchmark for evaluating learned behaviour. Across 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, adaptive strategy selection achieves 28.9-79.7% closer alignment to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines. The code and an annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores are released at https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/ .
articles.comment: Accepted at the 2026 Joint European Conference on Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD 2026)
articles.titleCn: 《手机游戏：利用博弈论和大型语言模型在“机器人战争”中对抗电话诈骗》
articles.abstractCn: 电话诈骗给全球个人和金融系统带来了巨大且不断增长的负担，然而现有的反制措施对诈骗者没有任何资源成本。战略性的诈骗诱捕，即通过自动化代理与诈骗者互动以耗尽其运营能力，提供了一种主动的替代方案，但这需要动态策略调整，而静态系统无法提供。我们引入了一个博弈论框架，使大型语言模型能够通过情境经验学习有效的反制策略，而无需微调。该框架将诈骗者诱捕者的互动建模为具有实证基础策略和效用函数的双人博弈，并使用纳什均衡作为评估学习行为的正式基准。在300次模拟对话和三种大型语言模型架构中，自适应策略选择比非自适应基线更接近纳什均衡28.9-79.7%。代码和标注数据集已发布在https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_。

articles.title: Monsoon: Scalable Spontaneous Speech Collection for Low-Resource ASR in 50 Languages
articles.abstract: For most languages, automatic speech recognition (ASR) is limited less by model architecture than by a lack of accurately transcribed spontaneous speech. We present Monsoon, a framework for collecting such data at scale. It elicits unscripted conversations between paired contributors, screens recordings with automated classifiers, corrects transcripts over five levels of human review, and selects segments for lexical and acoustic coverage. It has collected speech in 50 languages; we analyse seven 3,500-hour corpora. At equal volume, its quality stages reduce semantic word error rate (WER) by 10-39% relative to a conventional protocol. Compared with an architecture-matched baseline trained on public corpora, Whisper fine-tuned on Monsoon performs comparably on the baseline's own test sets and reduces semantic WER by 20-44 points on conversational benchmarks. The gains transfer to a second architecture and grow with data volume. We release the framework, its quality-control models, and the fine-tuned models.
articles.titleCn: 季风：面向低资源语音识别的50种语言可扩展自发语音采集
articles.abstractCn: 对于大多数语言而言，自动语音识别（ASR）的限制更多地在于缺乏准确转录的自发语音，而非模型架构。我们提出了Monsoon框架，用于大规模收集此类数据。该框架通过配对贡献者之间的非脚本对话来激发自发对话，使用自动分类器筛选录音，通过五级人工审核修正转录文本，并选择用于词汇和声学覆盖的片段。它已收集50种语言的语音；我们分析了七个3,500小时的语料库。在同等数据量的情况下，其质量阶段相较于传统协议将语义词错误率（WER）降低了10-39%。与在公开语料库上训练的架构匹配基线相比，在Monsoon上微调的Whisper在基线自己的测试集上表现相当，并在对话基准测试中将语义WER降低了20-44点。这些收益可以迁移到第二种架构，并且随着数据量的增加而增长。我们发布了该框架、其质量控制模型以及微调后的模型。

articles.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
articles.abstract: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
articles.titleCn: HarnessPro：基于帕累托优化的递归 harness 自我改进，以实现性能成本权衡
articles.abstractCn: 利用开发在构建强大的AI代理中起着至关重要的作用。近期方法通过递归自我改进（RSI）来改进利用，但它们的性能提升往往伴随着更高的执行成本。我们介绍了HarnessPro，这是一种无需标签的方法，用于进化利用以提升任务性能并降低执行成本。在这种设置下，候选利用通过使用LLM生成的测试进行评估，而无需访问真实解或官方测试。专业代理诊断执行轨迹，根据不同的性能成本优先级规划更新，并将其实现为候选利用。HarnessPro不是返回单个利用，而是使用归一化加权平方距离选择，为不同的部署预算提供成本聚焦（轻量级）、平衡（中等）和性能聚焦（重量级）的利用。选定的利用进入下一次迭代，执行反馈指导进一步的更新。我们的实验涵盖了Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro和ProgramBench，使用GPT-5.5与Codex以及GLM-5.2与Claude Code。在这些使用GPT-5.5与Codex的基准测试中，HarnessPro的重量级模式相对于RHO实现了平均通过率提升2.0个百分点和平均每任务成本降低26.1%。这一优势在使用GLM-5.2与Claude Code时也同样成立。代码可在https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro获取。

articles.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
articles.abstract: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.
articles.titleCn: TokenGate：通过学习式标记剪枝，使大型语言模型适应快速且内存高效的预填充
articles.abstractCn: 专家级人类读者通过略读来快速浏览大量输入（例如代码仓库和长篇文档），仅仔细阅读重要内容。另一方面，语言模型会通过每一层模型处理所有输入token，导致长上下文输入的处理成本显著增加。我们引入了TokenGate，这是一个小型即插即用的组件，用于扩展现有训练好的模型，以实现长上下文输入的端到端可学习的token剪枝，从而实现快速且内存高效的预填充。为了克服token剪枝中非可微分的top-K算子，我们引入了token门控注意力机制，该机制受专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）的启发，使用token重要性分数重新加权注意力logits。在多种任务中，TokenGate在transformer预填充方面实现了1.4-11.3倍的更快时间到第一个token（TTFT）和1.5-3.4倍的更低峰值内存，且准确率没有下降。与token剪枝的最佳先前方法相比，TokenGate实现了高达6.4倍的更快预填充和2倍的更低峰值内存。TokenGate原生扩展了标准transformer（例如Qwen3）和混合注意力模型（例如Qwen3.5），只需简单的轻量级适配，类似于标准参数高效的微调。我们在以下地址提供了我们的代码：https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate。

articles.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
articles.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.
articles.titleCn: recAMPLIFY：递归蛋白质语言模型的规模化预训练
articles.abstractCn: 蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）是蛋白质注释和突变效应预测的强大工具，但其进展很大程度上依赖于模型规模和数据扩展，导致成本高昂且易产生记忆效应。测试时扩展提供了一条替代路径，但为自回归大型语言模型开发的方法不能直接迁移：掩码编码器缺乏生成循环，而氨基酸无法用推理语言进行表达。相反，我们针对掩码pLMs调整了递归预训练方法，其中权重绑定的Transformer核心在可调节的循环次数内优化残基对齐的隐藏状态。我们将这一方法实例化为recAMPLIFY，一个拥有1.55亿个独特参数的pLM，其训练数据与AMPLIFY-350M相同。尽管参数数量减少了56%，它仍提升了CASP接触恢复效果，并在四分之三的监督任务中表现更优，特别是在使折叠精度提高了22.5%。由于recAMPLIFY的最佳深度因任务和实验不同而异，我们随后引入了门控混合递归（GMR）框架，该框架从递归过程中访问的隐藏状态的概率加权混合中解码每个蛋白质。GMR采用学习到的残差门控，在标量、低秩或逐维度分辨率上控制每个循环提议的更新有多少被接受到状态中。这将停止和门控统一为单一的自适应计算目标，同时在不使用门控的情况下恢复了PonderNet风格的停止机制。建立在recAMPLIFY之上，GMR进一步将预期层深度降低了高达37%，尽管精度权衡因任务而异。机制分析表明，残差门控在训练深度之外控制了递归稳定性，停止深度则反映了生物学特性。

articles.title: EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition
articles.abstract: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.
articles.titleCn: EpiLens：轻量级RAG用于流行病学知识获取
articles.abstractCn: 为应对未来的疫情爆发，研究人员需要了解已进行的研究及其使用的数据。手动绘制大量文献图耗时费力，而仅使用大型语言模型可能存在错误陈述或混淆来源的情况。我们提出了EpiLens，一个轻量级、开源的检索增强生成工具包，它将固定的检索模板和输出模式应用于语料库中的每篇论文，并将输出链接到原始段落。我们从多病原体参数研究的来源构建了一个包含2297篇论文的语料库，并评估了EpiLens的论文分类工作流程对214篇人工标注论文的效果。在没有特定任务训练数据的情况下，分类器在四个任务上的表现与测试的监督学习和零样本基线相当或更优。研究早期的提取表格引用了327项估计的已发表来源。我们将每项估计链接到引用的文档或由综述包含的语料库研究。然后，我们使用分类器的标签来比较与不同参数和病原体相关的论文。EpiLens将更多与再生数相关的论文标记为基于模型（54%对22%，而人工标注为62%对24%）。这一差距与经常使用传播模型来估计再生数的情况一致，并且在五种病原体中的每一种中均持续存在。除了参数之间的对比外，与潜伏期估计相关的论文中基于模型的份额因病原体而异：SARS-CoV-2为55%，而mpox为6%。

articles.title: Fluent but Fallible: Benchmarking Hallucination and Factual Reliability in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language processing and artificial intelligence applications through their capabilities in reasoning, text generation and knowledge retrieval. However, LLMs are still vulnerable to two important challenges: hallucination, generating factually incorrect or fabricated content, and response deviation, meaning systematic deviations from ground-truth responses. These limitations raise serious concerns regarding reliability and trustworthiness in academic and research environments. This study offers a thorough comparative analysis using a variety of metrics of ten advanced LLMs ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude~3.5~Sonnet, LLaMA~3, Mistral, Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek~V3, Falcon, and Gemma based on a benchmark consisting of 70 carefully designed academic prompts across four complexity levels: Basic, Explanation, Advanced, and Tricky, evaluated in February 2025 on specific model versions. Each response was independently evaluated by three reviewers using five metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Response Deviation Index, and Hallucination Index. Perplexity and DeepSeek~V3 achieved the highest overall accuracy, while Gemini demonstrated strong recall and a well-balanced performance profile across all five metrics. LLaMA~3 showed strong resistance against hallucinations through a conservative method of generation. Advanced-level prompts proved most challenging across all models, while Tricky prompts were handled more reliably owing to their binary true/false structure. Falcon achieved perfect precision and zero hallucinations, but at the cost of the lowest recall and the highest response deviation. The results show a fundamental trade-off between response completeness and factual reliability, intensified by prompt complexity.
articles.titleCn: 流利但易错：大型语言模型中幻觉与事实可靠性基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）凭借其推理、文本生成和知识检索能力，显著推动了自然语言处理和人工智能应用的发展。然而，LLMs仍面临两大重要挑战：幻觉，即生成与事实不符或虚构的内容，以及响应偏差，指系统性地偏离真实响应。这些局限性在学术和科研环境中引发了关于可靠性和可信度的严重担忧。本研究基于包含四个复杂度级别（基础、解释、高级和刁钻）的70个精心设计的学术提示基准，对十种先进LLMs——ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude~3.5~Sonnet、LLaMA~3、Mistral、Grok、Perplexity、DeepSeek~V3、Falcon和Gemma——进行了全面的比较分析，并于2025年2月在特定模型版本上评估。每个响应由三位评审员独立使用五个指标（准确率、精确率、召回率、响应偏差指数和幻觉指数）进行评估。Perplexity和DeepSeek~V3在整体准确率上表现最高，而Gemini在召回率上表现突出，并在所有五个指标上展现出均衡的性能。LLaMA~3通过保守的生成方法表现出对幻觉的强抵抗力。高级提示对所有模型而言最具挑战性，而刁钻提示由于其二元真/假结构得到了更可靠的处理。Falcon实现了完美精确率和零幻觉，但代价是最低的召回率和最高的响应偏差。结果表明，响应完整性与事实可靠性之间存在根本性的权衡，且这种权衡随着提示复杂度的增加而加剧。

articles.title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
articles.abstract: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.
articles.titleCn: 重复拷贝：从前缀匹配到位置哈希
articles.abstractCn: 前沿大型语言模型几乎可以完美复制随机文本，但它们常常在长串重复字符块中溢出或截断。在重复字符串中，匹配局部内容不再可靠地确定复制应继续的位置或何时停止。然而，我们证明一个具有$O(\log\log N)$位精度和$O(\log N/\log\log N)$宽度的两层Transformer可以复制任意长度的字符串，并在任意重复情况下正确终止。我们使用具有小素数周期的RoPE风格注意力值和输出旋转（VO-旋转）来对分隔符锚点距离进行模运算编码。根据中国剩余定理，这些周期性编码共同区分所有所需距离，允许单一检索规则选择下一个源标记或终止标记。相比之下，我们证明在顺序有限精度softmax累积下复制存在宽度无关的不可能性结果。该结果适用于仅包含最终变为常数的加性注意力偏置的位置输入的Transformer，包括NoPE和ALiBi的递归实现。一旦相同标记的连续重复超过饱和阈值，后续重复将使logits保持不变。如果该阈值与$N$呈次线性增长，这些模型将无法同时完成长串全相同复制并正确终止，这与前沿LLM的终止错误模式相似。在合成复制实验中，基线Transformer模型在训练范围内甚至对长重复字符串也表现不佳。而训练后的VO模型则能在训练长度之外以近乎完美的精度泛化，直至长度约等于所选素数周期的乘积（$\approx 5005$）。

articles.title: HoloCosm: Beyond Single-Metric Benchmark Compression Across Multiple Metrics
articles.abstract: Benchmark compression reduces evaluation cost by selecting a small set of samples. Existing methods typically guide selection using a single metric, although benchmarks often assess models along multiple dimensions. We find that model rankings are often weakly correlated across metrics, indicating that different metrics capture distinct aspects of model performance. Samples selected for one metric do not reliably preserve scores and rankings on others when used for compressed evaluation. At 80\% compression, each of the five single-metric baselines yields higher reconstruction error than equal-size random sampling in over 70\% of cross-metric comparisons. To address this challenge, we present HoloCosm, which jointly minimizes normalized score-reconstruction error across source models and metrics while constraining ranking distortion. We evaluate HoloCosm across multiple compression rates on 15 language, multimodal, VLA, and agent benchmark configurations with 85 component metrics. With 80\% compression, HoloCosm outperforms Random, the strongest baseline overall: average NMAE drops by 35.3\% to 0.236, worst-component NMAE drops by 39.5\% to 0.330, and average Spearman correlation rises from 0.884 to 0.915. In addition, HoloCosm remains competitive with existing baselines in single-metric evaluation. We will release our code and experimental results.
articles.titleCn: HoloCosm：超越单一指标基准的多指标压缩
articles.abstractCn: 基准压缩通过选择一小部分样本来降低评估成本。现有方法通常使用单一指标来指导选择，尽管基准测试通常在多个维度上评估模型。我们发现模型在不同指标上的排名往往弱相关，这表明不同的指标捕捉了模型性能的不同方面。为压缩评估选择的样本并不能可靠地保留在其他指标上的得分和排名。在80%压缩率下，五个单一指标基线在超过70%的跨指标比较中产生的重建误差高于同等规模的随机采样。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了HoloCosm，它联合最小化源模型和指标上的归一化得分-重建误差，同时约束排名失真。我们在15种语言、多模态、VLA和智能体基准配置上，使用85个组件指标，在多个压缩率下评估了HoloCosm。在80%压缩率下，HoloCosm优于总体最强的基线Random：平均NMAE降低了35.3%至0.236，最差组件NMAE降低了39.5%至0.330，平均Spearman相关系数从0.884提升至0.915。此外，HoloCosm在单一指标评估中仍与现有基线具有竞争力。我们将发布我们的代码和实验结果。

articles.title: Hierarchical Token Merging with Recursive Autoencoders for Unsupervised Grammar Induction
articles.abstract: Hierarchical abstraction is a fundamental principle across many data modalities, enabling complex sequences to be represented compositionally at multiple levels. Learning such hierarchies directly from data, without explicit structural supervision, remains a central challenge in representation learning. We investigate whether meaningful hierarchical structure can emerge from compression alone. While autoencoders learn compressed representations through reconstruction, this objective does not necessarily favour meaningful compositional structure. We study this challenge through unsupervised grammar induction, where the underlying hierarchy can be evaluated explicitly. We introduce a hierarchical token-merging autoencoder that recursively combines adjacent tokens into increasingly abstract representations, compressing entire sequences through a variational information bottleneck. The model jointly learns representations and hierarchical structure by marginalising over possible binary trees using dynamic programming. To address training instability, we combine independently trained models through unsupervised consensus and distillation. Experiments on a synthetic, ambiguous grammar demonstrate the emergence of meaningful hierarchical structure without structural supervision. The resulting model achieves 93% grammatical parse-validity and 93% exact reconstruction on held-out sequences, compared with 42% parse-validity for the strongest trivial baseline. These findings establish a proof of concept for hierarchical token merging as a mechanism for unsupervised structure discovery and abstraction learning.
articles.titleCn: 基于递归自编码器的层级标记合并用于无监督语法归纳
articles.abstractCn: 分层抽象是跨多种数据模态的基本原则，它使得复杂序列能够在多个层级上通过组合的方式进行表示。从数据中直接学习这种层次结构，而不依赖显式的结构监督，仍然是表征学习中的一个核心挑战。我们研究了仅通过压缩是否能够涌现出有意义的层次结构。虽然自编码器通过重建学习压缩表示，但这一目标并不一定有利于有意义的组合结构。我们通过无监督语法归纳来研究这一挑战，其中潜在层次结构可以被明确评估。我们引入了一种分层标记合并自编码器，该自编码器递归地将相邻标记组合成越来越抽象的表示，通过变分信息瓶颈压缩整个序列。该模型通过动态规划对可能的二叉树进行边缘化，联合学习表示和层次结构。为了解决训练不稳定性问题，我们通过无监督共识和蒸馏组合独立训练的模型。在合成、模糊语法的实验中，证明了在没有结构监督的情况下能够涌现出有意义的层次结构。所得模型在保留序列上实现了93%的语法解析有效性和93%的精确重建，而最强的平凡基线仅为42%的解析有效性。这些发现为分层标记合并作为无监督结构发现和抽象学习机制的原理验证提供了依据。

articles.title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding
articles.abstract: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.
articles.titleCn: 基于变分解码的并行语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 自回归语言模型在每次前向传递中只生成一个token。这导致推理延迟很高，尤其是在模型为了提升质量而扩展规模时。在本文中，我们引入了并行语言模型（PLMs），通过通过潜在辅助变量路由依赖关系，在单次前向传递中生成相互一致的token。PLMs使用一个变分界限进行训练，该界限简化为自回归损失加上并行解码损失。实证结果表明，PLMs比自回归和离散扩散基线位于更快更好的帕累托前沿。预训练的PLMs在参数规模为80M到3B的模型上实现了接近自回归的预训练损失，加速比遵循模型大小的幂律。在后续训练中，我们的1.3B模型在数学、编程和指令遵循基准测试中与同等训练的自回归模型相当或超越，推理速度提升了2.3-5.7倍。总而言之，我们证明了并行生成可以从单一训练目标以自回归质量进行训练。我们将代码开源在https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm。

articles.title: Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing
articles.abstract: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.
articles.titleCn: 内部评分标准奖励偏差：通过潜在维度恢复和平衡来缓解评分标准操纵
articles.abstractCn: 评分标准破解限制了基于评分标准的强化学习中的性能和训练鲁棒性。通过将评分标准分解为子维度，我们揭示了评分标准内部奖励分歧：随着总评分标准的增加，某些子维度得分系统性地下降，表明模型为了优化聚合目标而牺牲了特定的质量方面。从子维度角度来看，我们观察到两种现象：(1) 维度不平衡，导致策略倾向于高度覆盖的维度；(2) 维度缺失，导致奖励与真实质量之间存在系统性差距。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了公平竞争维度聚合（FRDA），该技术让各代在各自的维度内竞争以缓解评分标准不平衡，以及残差语义维度补全（RSDC），该技术挖掘整体偏好信号中隐含的评价维度以补全评分标准覆盖。在聊天、科学和医疗领域的实验表明，FRDA通过更稳定的改进缓解了评分标准破解，而RSDC优于单一奖励训练和朴素多奖励聚合，产生了普遍更高质量的响应。

articles.title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
articles.abstract: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.
articles.comment: Preliminary version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI)
articles.titleCn: 哪种模型适用于哪种角色？面向大语言模型代理工作流的成本效益帕累托推荐
articles.abstractCn: LLM 代理工作流越来越多地采用不同的模型来承担专门角色。用户可能在任务质量和部署成本之间有不同的权衡，有时还会考虑延迟。找到良好的分配会产生额外的搜索成本，因为需要评估多个候选者。我们引入了成本耦合吉特斯（CC-Gittins），这是一种多目标扩展，基于单目标成本感知吉特斯搜索，用于帕累托推荐。它利用了评估成本和部署成本之间的耦合关系：部署成本较高的分配，其评估成本也较高。搜索在寻求更高质量和更低部署成本之间交替进行，并重用每次评估的结果来指导两种搜索。在每个批次之后，CC-Gittins根据质量部署成本的不确定性调整估计，推荐非支配的分配。我们在具有两个到五个角色和最多1,681个候选分配的八个工作流质量成本矩阵上评估了CC-Gittins。我们还以延迟作为第三个目标评估了该方法。在八个基准测试中，CC-Gittins在约10%的穷举评估成本下，恢复了大量真实的帕累托前沿，并且在30%时通过很少的误报恢复了大部分前沿。

articles.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
articles.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.
articles.titleCn: SpatialScout：视觉语言模型智能体能否主动探索和绘制3D场景？
articles.abstractCn: 空间智能要求智能体主动获取视觉证据并将观察结果整合为三维世界的统一表征。然而，空间问答任务尚未提供充分证据证明模型能否通过自主探索构建精确的度量地图。我们提出了SpatialScout，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体在主动物体级三维地图构建上的基准。SpatialScout包含80个多样化的室内场景，涵盖3,140个目标物体。给定物体清单、RGB观测图像、相机校准参数和相机姿态，智能体需控制相机探索每个场景，并在共享坐标系中估计物体中心。该任务要求在有限的交互预算下协调视点选择、跨视点关联、几何估计和地图修正。评估通过物体尺度重叠分数联合衡量定位精度和目标覆盖率，该分数会惩罚预测缺失的情况。前沿VLM的实验揭示了显著局限性：评估中最强的模型Claude Opus 5.5，平均重叠分数为41.71%，47.23%的目标未超过交并比（IoU）阈值0.5，仅有3.25%超过0.9。这些结果表明，在恢复粗略物体布局与构建完整精确的度量地图之间存在巨大差距。SpatialScout为开发通过主动感知构建可靠三维空间表征的智能体提供了定量测试平台。代码可在https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout获取。

articles.title: The Development of Sycophancy in Language Models: Tracing Vulnerabilities from Pretraining to Post-Training
articles.abstract: Language models can change a committed answer to accommodate a user's opinion or pushback without new evidence. However, when this behaviour develops during training and what a released model inherits from earlier stages remain unclear. We follow 741 checkpoints of 30 open model lineages, from early pretraining to released models. We plant initial verdicts on moral scenarios and measure how far a model follows a user's stated opinion or abandons its verdict under pressure. In most lineages the behaviour is present before post-training, and its average strength changes in either direction, at different stages across lineages. A clearer pattern emerges at the level of individual questions. Beyond responses without pressure, pretraining behaviour predicts little of which questions a released model yields on. That pattern forms during post-training: on routes with supervised fine-tuning, the fine-tuning checkpoint predicts part of it and the preference-optimization checkpoint most of it. A sibling trained from the same base along another route predicts far less: for Tülu-3 8B, its own preference-stage checkpoint removes 85% of the remaining prediction error, a sibling 19%. Internal states add predictive information without changing this ranking. Similar average scores conceal different vulnerabilities, and training history matters for auditing a released model.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型谄媚行为的发展：从预训练到微调阶段漏洞追踪
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型可以在没有新证据的情况下，根据用户的观点或反驳来改变已确认的答案。然而，这种行为在训练过程中是如何产生的，以及已发布的模型继承了早期阶段哪些内容，目前尚不清楚。我们追踪了30条开放模型谱系的741个检查点，从早期预训练到发布模型。我们在道德场景中植入初始判断，并测量模型在多大程度上遵循用户明确表达的观点，或在压力下放弃其判断。在大多数谱系中，这种行为在后训练之前就已经存在，并且其平均强度在不同谱系的不同阶段呈现正向或负向变化。在单个问题的层面上，一个更清晰的模式出现了。除了没有压力的回应外，预训练行为对已发布模型会给出哪些问题的答案预测影响甚微。这种模式是在后训练过程中形成的：在带有监督微调的路径上，微调检查点预测了其中一部分，而偏好优化检查点预测了大部分。而沿另一路径使用相同基础模型训练的兄弟模型则预测能力较弱：对于Tülu-3 8B，其自身的偏好阶段检查点消除了85%的剩余预测误差，而兄弟模型仅消除19%。内部状态增加了预测信息，但并未改变这种排名。相似的平均分数掩盖了不同的脆弱性，训练历史对审计已发布的模型至关重要。

articles.title: From Outcomes to Components: A Counterfactual Evaluation Framework for LLM-Proposed Repairs
articles.abstract: An LLM-generated repair action specifies which records to change and by how much. A failed action may still contain a useful target set or numerical update, depending on how the two are paired. We evaluate this problem in traffic networks and databases, where aggregate observations obscure the records that need correction. We examine the pairings by executing each combination from the same initial state, using a reference action that restores the affected records. In 76 of 114 traffic actions, the gain from correcting both parts exceeds the sum of the gains from correcting each part alone. Six of these actions become worse after either correction alone, but improve when both parts are corrected. In database repair, replacing only the proposed update with the reference update worsens 17 of 108 model actions, all of which select unaffected records. We also test whether parts of two proposals can be reused. On held-out observations, selecting among the proposals and their recombined target-update pairs recovers 61.6% of the reference action's loss reduction, compared with 58.0% from selecting between the proposals alone.
articles.titleCn: 从结果到组件：用于LLM提出修复的反事实评估框架
articles.abstractCn: 一个由大型语言模型生成的维修操作会指定要更改哪些记录以及更改的程度。一个失败的行动可能仍然包含有用的目标集或数值更新，这取决于两者是如何配对的。我们在交通网络和数据库中评估这个问题，其中总体的观察结果会掩盖需要修正的记录。我们通过从相同的初始状态执行每种组合来检查配对情况，并使用一个参考操作来恢复受影响的记录。在114个交通行动中的76个，修正两个部分的收益超过了单独修正每个部分的收益之和。其中这6个行动在单独修正任何一个部分后会变得更差，但在同时修正两个部分时会得到改善。在数据库维修中，仅用参考更新替换提议更新会使108个模型行动中的17个变得更差，所有这些行动都选择了未受影响的记录。我们还测试了两个提议的部分是否可以重复使用。在保留的观察结果中，从提议及其重新组合的目标-更新对中选择，可以恢复参考行动损失减少的61.6%，而仅从提议中选择则只能恢复58.0%。

articles.title: When the harness decides success: state that cannot be re-observed
articles.abstract: Agent harnesses decide what a language model sees across turns: they drop old turns, summarize them, or replay the model's own earlier reasoning. We ask when these choices change whether an agent succeeds, not only what it costs, and report three findings. First, in a pre-registered synthetic probe, truncating the context window costs a low-cost reasoning model nothing in success when a needed fact can be looked up again (it looks the fact up instead), but drops its success to chance when the fact cannot be re-observed: the two penalties differ by 92.5 percentage points (90% CI [89.5, 95.5]). A pre-registered replication on one model from a second provider showed the same contrast. Once the fact was lost, that model chose no answer rather than guessing. Second, on ARC-AGI-3, where the benchmark's Standard harness trails its Provider Adapter harness by a wide margin, we decompose that gap one component at a time, for one model on four games. Summarizing old turns instead of dropping them, while keeping the Standard harness's invitation to take notes, recovers 86% of a 63-point gap without replaying the model's reasoning. The same harness without the invitation recovers 43%, and adding the provider's native replay of the model's reasoning recovers the remaining 57%. These are point estimates from one counted run per configuration and game, and the replay share depends on a single run. Third, in the benchmark's published runs and in ours, the Adapter's advantage in the probability of clearing a level it has reached is larger at deep levels than at early ones. This largely restates where runs stopped and does not separate a growing advantage from a constant one.
articles.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Pre-registered; code, pre-registration and cost ledger at https://github.com/raimondasl/persistgym
articles.titleCn: 当 harness 判定成功：一个无法重新观察的状态
articles.abstractCn: 智能体调度器决定语言模型在多轮对话中看到的内容：它们会丢弃旧轮次、总结旧轮次或重放模型早期的推理。我们探究这些选择何时影响智能体的成功，而不仅仅是其成本，并报告了三个发现。首先，在一个预先注册的合成探测任务中，当所需事实可以再次查询时，截断上下文窗口对低成本推理模型的成功率没有影响（它会重新查询该事实），但当事实无法重新观察到时，成功率会降至随机水平：这两种惩罚相差92.5个百分点（90%置信区间[89.5, 95.5]）。对第二个提供者的一个模型进行的预先注册复现实验显示了同样的对比。一旦事实丢失，该模型会选择不回答而不是猜测。其次，在ARC-AGI-3上，基准测试的标准调度器与其提供者适配器调度器之间存在巨大差距，我们逐个组件地分解这一差距，针对一个模型在四个游戏中进行。通过总结旧轮次而不是丢弃它们，同时保留标准调度器的记笔记提示，在不重放模型推理的情况下，可以弥补63分差距中的86%。同样的调度器在没有记笔记提示的情况下只能弥补43%，而添加提供者的原生模型推理重放则弥补了剩余的57%。这些是从每个配置和游戏中的一次计数运行中得到的点估计，重放部分取决于单次运行。第三，在基准测试的已发布运行和我们的运行中，适配器在清除已达到的关卡的概率上的优势在深层次比在早期层次更大。这主要重述了运行停止的位置，并不能区分增长的优势与恒定的优势。

articles.title: Conducting Reliable Keyword Estimation with Unreliable ASR in Police Audio Data
articles.abstract: Extracting insights from large audio data sets using human transcription is expensive and time-consuming. Off-the-shelf Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems offer an easy-to-use scalable alternative, but systematic transcription errors, especially in domain-specific settings, can bias downstream analyses and lead to unreliable conclusions. We investigate whether imperfect ASR transcripts can still be used to obtain statistically valid keyword frequency estimates by combining model outputs with a small set of human-labeled examples, following Prediction Powered Inference and Design-based Supervised Learning frameworks. We evaluate this approach on police radio communications from Baltimore and Chicago, a domain in which keyword distributions could provide valuable insights into police activity, but off-the-shelf ASR systems exhibit systematic errors on operationally important terminology. Using bootstrap-based confidence interval coverage as our evaluation metric, we find that our approach substantially increases the number of domain-specific keywords that can be analyzed with statistically valid confidence intervals, from 43.0% using ASR alone and 27.2% using only a small set of human-labeled transcriptions to 56.2% in the Baltimore dataset, with similar improvements observed in Chicago data. Our results demonstrate that post-hoc error correction can improve statistical validity of downstream analyses even for poor-quality transcriptions, offering an avenue for better leveraging off-the-shelf ASR models for large-scale speech analysis.
articles.titleCn: 在警方音频数据中利用不可靠的语音识别进行可靠的关键词估计
articles.abstractCn: 利用人工转录从大型音频数据集中提取洞察是昂贵且费时的。现成的自动语音识别（ASR）系统提供了易于使用且可扩展的替代方案，但系统性的转录错误，尤其是在特定领域环境中，会偏移下游分析并导致不可靠的结论。我们研究了在不完美的ASR转录中，通过结合模型输出与少量人工标记示例，是否仍能获得统计上有效的关键词频率估计，遵循预测驱动推理和基于设计的监督学习框架。我们在巴尔的摩和芝加哥的警察无线电通讯数据集上评估了这种方法，这是一个关键词分布可提供宝贵见解的领域，但现成的ASR系统在操作上重要的术语上存在系统性错误。使用基于自举的置信区间覆盖率作为评估指标，我们发现我们的方法显著增加了可使用统计上有效置信区间分析的专业领域关键词数量，从仅使用ASR的43.0%和仅使用少量人工标记转录的27.2%增加到巴尔的摩数据集的56.2%，芝加哥数据也观察到类似的改进。我们的结果表明，事后错误校正可以提高下游分析的统计有效性，即使对于质量较差的转录也是如此，为更好地利用现成的ASR模型进行大规模语音分析提供了途径。

articles.title: BERT Is Already a Denoiser: Cheaply Unlocking Iterative Generation in Masked Language Models
articles.abstract: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT are typically used for representation learning despite their denoising pretraining. We test whether this capability supports conditional generation without diffusion training. Our decoder repeatedly predicts masked tokens and commits high-confidence predictions using a cosine schedule. It requires no diffusion timestep or reverse-diffusion objective. Frozen BERT already exhibits substantial denoising capability, reconstructing 61.0%, 37.5%, and 24.4% of masked tokens at 15%, 45%, and 60% corruption, respectively, although generation deteriorates sharply as visible context disappears. This capability alone does not yield task-directed generation: frozen BERT reaches only 11.0% on ARC-Easy and 4.2% on MMLU. Ordinary MLM adaptation, however, rapidly converts the same architecture into a usable generator. Full adaptation reaches 28.2% and 24.6%, respectively, while parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces unmatched outputs. On open-ended conditional generation, full MLM adaptation reaches BLEU/ROUGE-L of 0.163/0.583 on QQP and 0.107/0.327 on Quasar-T, placing it in the same broad performance range as published BERT models trained through diffusion without explicit diffusion training. Finally, applying the same generative interface to stronger masked representations substantially improves performance: RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy and 33.8% on MMLU. These results separate three components of masked iterative generation: pretraining supplies the representation and denoising operator, task adaptation determines what the model generates, and an iterative commitment rule supplies the decoding process. Explicit diffusion training is therefore not necessary to obtain effective iterative conditional generation from pretrained MLMs in the settings studied here.
articles.titleCn: BERT已经是一个去噪器：以低成本解锁掩码语言模型中的迭代生成
articles.abstractCn: 尽管掩码语言模型（MLMs）如BERT在去噪预训练后通常用于表征学习，我们测试了这种能力是否支持无扩散训练的条件生成。我们的解码器反复预测掩码词元，并使用余弦调度提交高置信度预测。它无需扩散时间步长或反向扩散目标。冻结的BERT已经表现出显著的去噪能力，在15%、45%和60%的污染程度下分别重建了61.0%、37.5%和24.4%的掩码词元，尽管随着可见上下文的消失，生成效果急剧恶化。仅凭这种能力并不能实现任务导向的生成：冻结的BERT在ARC-Easy上仅达到11.0%，在MMLU上仅达到4.2%。然而，普通的MLM适应可以迅速将相同架构转换为可用生成器。完全适应分别达到了28.2%和24.6%，而参数高效的适应显著减少了不匹配输出。在开放式条件生成中，完全MLM适应在QQP上达到了BLEU/ROUGE-L为0.163/0.583，在Quasar-T上达到了0.107/0.327，将其置于与通过扩散训练且无明确扩散训练的已发布BERT模型相同的广泛性能范围内。最后，将相同的生成接口应用于更强的掩码表征显著提高了性能：RoBERTa-large在ARC-Easy上达到了44.2%，在MMLU上达到了33.8%。这些结果将掩码迭代生成的三个组成部分区分开来：预训练提供了表征和去噪算子，任务适应决定了模型生成的内容，迭代承诺规则提供了解码过程。因此，在所研究的情况下，无需明确的扩散训练即可从预训练的MLMs中获得有效的迭代条件生成。

articles.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Cost-Aware Metric for Evaluating Iterative LLM Jailbreaks
articles.abstract: Attack success rate (ASR) evaluates jailbreaks against large language models without accounting for repeated calls to the victim model. Yet each additional call gives the deployed system another opportunity to detect the attack and intervene. We introduce $\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}}$, which penalizes additional victim-model calls while retaining binary success judgments. Our evaluation considers GCG~\cite{zou2023universal}, PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking} with a step budget, and a single-step PAP~\cite{zeng2024johnny} baseline on JailBreakBench across three model families. GCG's scores decrease by 7.0--8.7 percentage points after discounting, while PAP's remain unchanged. While for PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}, we see a wider discounting range between 3.4-12 percentage points, showing that the "step" quantity differs per iterative strategy. Reporting both metrics makes the discount due to repeated victim-model interaction explicit. Code is available \hyperlink{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/beyond_asr}{here}.
articles.titleCn: 超越攻击成功率：评估迭代大型语言模型越狱的成本感知指标
articles.abstractCn: 攻击成功率（ASR）在评估针对大型语言模型的越狱攻击时，并未考虑对受害者模型进行重复调用。然而，每次额外的调用都为部署的系统提供了检测攻击和干预的另一个机会。我们引入了$\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}}$，在保留二元成功判断的同时，对额外的受害者模型调用进行惩罚。我们的评估考虑了在JailBreakBench上针对三个模型家族的GCG~\cite{zou2023universal}、具有步数预算的PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}以及单步PAP~\cite{zeng2024johnny}基线。在折扣后，GCG的得分下降了7.0--8.7个百分点，而PAP的得分保持不变。对于PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}，我们观察到3.4-12个百分点的更广泛的折扣范围，表明每个迭代策略的“步数”量不同。报告这两种指标使重复受害者模型交互导致的折扣变得明确。代码可在\hyperlink{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/beyond_asr}{此处}获取。

articles.title: Teaching AI Agent to Play Poker Strategically Through Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: A poker agent can make a legal move and still make a strategically poor one. We ask whether compact AI agents can exhibit strategic behavior under hidden information and whether preference optimization can improve beyond static and zero-shot policies. We first evaluate a static baseline and three frozen language models: SmallThinker, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 whose performance varies substantially between exact-game and six-player evaluation. We therefore propose Strategic Preference Optimization with KL-anchored Equilibrium (SPOKE), combining teacher-relative value penalties, policy anchoring, risk constraints, and structured rationale supervision, and compare it with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and GSPO. Across three runs of a SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B policy, SPOKE achieves the lowest mean exploitability in Kuhn (0.213) and Leduc (1.081) and the highest six-max top-1 agreement (0.775), while maintaining teacher KL comparable to SFT (0.522 vs 0.523). These results provide preliminary evidence that strategic preference optimization can improve strategic quality while preserving teacher-consistent behavior.
articles.titleCn: 通过偏好优化教授人工智能代理策略性玩扑克
articles.abstractCn: 一名扑克代理可以做出合法的举动，但仍然可能做出策略性较差的选择。我们探讨了紧凑型AI代理在信息隐藏情况下是否能够展现策略行为，以及偏好优化是否能在静态和零样本策略之外得到改进。我们首先评估了一个静态基线和三个冻结的语言模型：SmallThinker、Qwen3和Gemma-3，这些模型在精确游戏和六人评估中的表现差异显著。因此，我们提出了结合教师相对价值惩罚、策略锚定、风险约束和结构化推理监督的策略偏好优化与KL锚定均衡（SPOKE），并将其与SFT、DPO、GRPO和GSPO进行比较。在SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B策略的三次运行中，SPOKE在Kuhn（0.213）和Leduc（1.081）中实现了最低的平均可利用性，并在六人游戏中获得了最高的Top-1协议（0.775），同时保持了与SFT相当的教师KL（0.522 vs 0.523）。这些结果初步表明，策略偏好优化能够在保持教师一致行为的同时提升策略质量。

articles.title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting
articles.abstract: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.
articles.titleCn: 重锚点：重用被拒绝的验证者状态进行扩散草稿
articles.abstractCn: 块扩散草稿员通过单次前向传递生成多个草稿标记来加速推测解码。然而，每次传递仅从单个目标生成的锚点生成固定长度的块，限制了草稿的扩展范围。与此同时，目标验证即使在首次拒绝后的位置也会计算隐藏状态，但这些状态通常被丢弃而不是重用。我们提出了ReAnchor，这是一种无需训练的方法，它使用丢弃的验证器状态在偏移位置重新锚定预训练的草稿员，以生成并行草稿块。这些块不仅提高了原始块内的预测准确性，还扩展了其端点之外的覆盖范围。在采样温度T=0时，ReAnchor在Gemma 4-12B上实现了最大的平均增益，在八个基准测试中提高了19.4%的接受长度和17.9%的解码速度。在四个目标模型和八个基准测试上平均分配，它使用预训练的DFlash草稿员提高了15.2%的接受长度和13.4%的解码速度。

articles.title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.
articles.titleCn: 一种多教师策略蒸馏的费希尔几何视角
articles.abstractCn: 将专业基础模型整合为一个通用的综合模型是后训练阶段的核心目标。目前常用两种方法：模型合并，该方法速度快但被视为启发式方法；以及多教师策略蒸馏，该方法能匹配分布但需要大量滚动计算，并存在跨任务梯度冲突问题。我们证明这两种方法是同一目标在不同阶数下的体现。在共享的同源专家子集内，多教师策略蒸馏目标在二阶上精确等于Fisher合并目标。因此其最小化器是Fisher合并，这是一种经典模型合并方法，通过专家模型的闭式组合给出，因此合并作为闭式蒸馏阶段，在二阶上是最优的。基于这一识别，我们提出了残差控制分支合并（RGBM）这一两阶段整合流程。具体而言，全参数Fisher合并对于基础模型而言难以实现，因此第一阶段将合并限制在任务向量子空间。通过扩展合并的切空间分析，我们证明混合任务向量的相同系数也混合隐式奖励，这使得在无标签提示上的残差程序可以求解它们。该程序最小化每个领域的最差残差，并报告其能量归一化值作为领域残差频谱。第二阶段让该频谱决定可添加的内容：RGBM将归一化残差低的领域被动化，仅对频谱间隙以上的领域训练孤立分支，并使用校准收缩写回允许的更新。在两个开源整合套件上，仅第一阶段的合并就匹配或优于完全训练的多教师蒸馏，而RGBM通过零额外联合训练步骤进一步改进了该方法，而所有未门控的写回，包括从合并继续的联合蒸馏，都低于该方法。

articles.title: RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing
articles.abstract: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.
articles.titleCn: RouterWorld：基于延迟感知LLM路由的对话式AI扩展
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的对话式AI系统需要能够在规模上平衡答案质量和响应延迟的路由机制。然而，现有的LLM路由基准假设对所有候选模型结果具有完全的可观测性，对延迟作为首要指标重视不足，并且将评估分散在不同的异构协议中，这些协议与实际应用场景不符。我们介绍了RouterWorld，这是一个用于对话式生成式AI中LLM路由的全面基准。RouterWorld统一了37.1万个单轮响应和7.6万个多轮智能体轨迹，采用自然用户交互和标准化的LLM作为裁判协议，并通过硬件基础的延迟标注将效率与瞬时定价解耦。关键的是，RouterWorld通过两种设置形式化了在部分可观测性下的路由：冷启动，它将学习限制在稀疏的静态日志中；以及航海者，它模拟连续的数据流，其中路由决策塑造未来的训练分布。评估了13个路由基准，我们发现大多数路由器在部分可观测性下过度强调准确性而忽略了延迟。代码和基准数据公开可用。

articles.title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Preference Reward Models with Evolving Penalties
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning for language models has moved from preference reward models to verifiable rewards, which sustain much longer optimization. Preference models are prone to reward hacking: the policy raises their score without improving response quality, or even while degrading it. Yet for open-ended tasks, where quality can neither be verified nor fully written down as rubrics, they remain valuable. We introduce Dynalize, which mitigates reward hacking online, during policy training. Periodically and asynchronously, a language model analyzes training rollouts and writes penalties for undesirable behaviors that the reward model appears to reward; a judge applies them to every rollout. In clinical counseling and creative writing, training on the reward model alone raises its score continuously but ultimately leads to a decline in external benchmarks. Dynalize sustains longer training and results in improved downstream performance. For example, we find that our method suppresses patterns incentivized by preference models that, without penalties, spread to most responses, and even to the model's reasoning, which the reward model does not explicitly score. Furthermore, we show that its gains hold in multi-turn training, and even after we retrain the reward model on the discovered behaviors.
articles.titleCn: 在偏好奖励模型中通过动态惩罚减轻奖励攻击
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习在语言模型中的应用已从偏好奖励模型转向可验证奖励，后者能够支持更长时间的优化。偏好模型容易受到奖励攻击：策略会提高其得分而不改善响应质量，甚至可能使其下降。然而，对于开放式任务，其中质量既无法验证也无法完全以评分标准形式写明，它们仍然具有重要价值。我们介绍了Dynalize，它能够在策略训练期间在线减轻奖励攻击。语言模型会定期且异步地分析训练过程中的输出，并针对奖励模型似乎奖励的不良行为写入惩罚；裁判将这些惩罚应用于每个输出。在临床咨询和创意写作中，仅基于奖励模型进行训练会持续提高其得分，但最终会导致外部基准的下降。Dynalize能够支持更长时间的训练，并带来下游性能的提升。例如，我们发现我们的方法抑制了偏好模型所鼓励的模式，这些模式在没有惩罚的情况下会扩散到大多数响应中，甚至扩散到模型推理中，而奖励模型并未明确对其进行评分。此外，我们证明了这些收益在多轮训练中依然有效，甚至在我们在已发现的奖励行为上重新训练奖励模型之后也是如此。

articles.title: Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes
articles.abstract: Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion.
