Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.
articles.titleCn: 强度控制改变干预在稀疏自动编码器代码中的比较方式
articles.abstractCn: 改变稀疏自动编码器（SAE）编码可以改变干预方向和幅度，因此比较干预效果需要一种强度控制方法来指定保持不变的内容。范数匹配和输出校准提供了不同的控制方法，但强度匹配后干预效果是否因编码不同而有所差异尚不清楚。我们在Gemma和Llama的固定特征组中比较了这些控制下的干预效果，并观察到：(1) 整体块缩放。对于每个输入一个系数的完整输出Kullback-Leibler（KL）校准，与非负最小二乘（NNLS）重拟合的总范数匹配相比，其产生的平均效果差距小于基于编码的参考干预。在新的Llama输入上，总范数匹配丢失了11个参考转移，而完整输出校准则保留了所有转移决策。(2) 位置缩放。在小的匹配性别一致性子集上，位置范数匹配产生的观察平均差距小于完整输出校准。(3) 答案排除。与非缩放NNLS相比，排除答案的校准则减少了测量的主谓一致比较中的差距，但增加了性别重拟合中的差距。完整输出KL校准则也减少了范数匹配构建候选中的较大差距，尽管在几种情况下匹配覆盖率不完整。由于校准使用评估输入的输出，因此它可作为残余不一致的诊断工具。

articles.title: AfriGuard: Safety and Robust Refusal For African Languages
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) designed to interact with users are typically trained to respond appropriately to harmful or toxic content. However, ensuring appropriate responses becomes more challenging in diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, where safety risks may be expressed or interpreted differently. Building safe AI systems therefore requires detecting safety risks, understanding their nature, and responding appropriately, while accounting for linguistic and cultural variations that add complexity to each stage. In this work, we introduce AfriGuard, a culturally grounded multilingual dataset for studying harmful intent, safety-category understanding, and refusal behavior across 10 African languages and English. Our findings reveal that guardrail models underperform both open- and closed-source LLMs on safety-intent and safety-category classification, while models show limited understanding of appropriate safety behavior, scoring below 60% F1. We further find that models often fail to respond appropriately to unsafe prompts not because they explicitly refuse, but because they produce linguistically inadequate responses that result in incidental non-assistance rather than proper refusals. Finally, using AfriGuard, we develop efficient guardrail models that achieve performance competitive with models up to 30x larger, introduce refusal detectors that improve average performance by 43.9% over existing detectors, and demonstrate that supervised fine-tuning can substantially improve overall safety performance.
articles.titleCn: AfriGuard：为非洲语言提供安全和稳健的拒绝机制
articles.abstractCn: 为用户交互而设计的大型语言模型（LLMs）通常被训练以恰当回应有害或毒性内容。然而，在多元语言和文化背景下，确保恰当回应的难度加大，因为安全风险可能以不同方式表达或被理解。因此，构建安全的AI系统需要检测安全风险、理解其性质并恰当回应，同时考虑语言和文化差异给每个阶段带来的复杂性。在这项工作中，我们介绍了AfriGuard，一个基于文化背景的多语言数据集，用于研究10种非洲语言和英语中的有害意图、安全类别理解和拒绝行为。我们的研究发现，在安全意图和安全类别分类方面，防护栏模型的表现均不如开源和闭源LLMs，而模型对恰当安全行为的理解有限，F1分数低于60%。我们进一步发现，模型未能恰当回应不安全提示并非因为它们明确拒绝，而是因为它们产生了语言上不充分的回应，导致偶然不协助而非恰当拒绝。最后，我们使用AfriGuard开发出高效的防护栏模型，其性能可与规模高达30倍更大的模型相媲美，引入了拒绝检测器，使平均性能比现有检测器提高了43.9%，并证明了监督微调可以显著提升整体安全性能。

articles.title: Training Negatives Still Matter After Calibrating Answerability Readouts
articles.abstract: Answerability readouts predict whether a passage supplies an answer, but whether calibration can compensate for removing negative passages during training remains unclear. We present a controlled study of how training-negative construction affects calibrated prediction, ranking, and downstream answer retention. We compare native training, which retains negative passages, with empty training, which removes them, holding questions, labels, positive examples, and model weights fixed. Both are calibrated on the same labeled native examples. On SQuAD 2.0 and RepLiQA, native-trained logistic readouts at selected depths achieve lower Brier loss for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-it, with or without output scores. Native fusion also outperforms calibrated output alone. Post-hoc AUROC analysis shows better ranking under native training, beyond what threshold adjustment alone can explain. On the official SQuAD 2.0 development set, native readout policies improve F1 over empty policies but retain more answers to unanswerable questions. The advantage varies by estimator and depth, while RepLiQA's text shortcuts limit claims about contextual understanding. Unfinished generations prevent complete answer-level evaluation, although worst-case bounds preserve the native-empty F1 gains. Our findings show that training negatives affect ranking and downstream decisions even after common calibration, without establishing a universal advantage for native training.
articles.titleCn: 校准可回答性读数后，训练负样本仍然重要
articles.abstractCn: 可问责性读数可以预测一段文本是否提供答案，但校准是否能在训练中移除负面段落后得到补偿尚不明确。我们进行了一项受控研究，探讨训练中移除负面段落如何影响校准后的预测、排序和下游答案保留。我们将保留负面段落的原生训练与移除负面段落的空训练进行比较，同时保持问题、标签、正面示例和模型权重不变。两者均在相同的标记原生示例上进行校准。在SQuAD 2.0和RepLiQA上，选定的深度处原生训练的逻辑读数在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Gemma-2-9B-it上，无论是否包含输出分数，均实现更低的Brier损失。原生融合也优于单独的校准输出。事后AUROC分析显示，原生训练下的排序效果更好，这超出了仅通过阈值调整所能解释的范围。在官方SQuAD 2.0开发集上，原生读数策略在F1上优于空策略，但会保留更多无解问题的答案。这种优势因估计器和深度而异，而RepLiQA的文本快捷方式限制了关于情境理解的断言。未完成的生成阻止了完整的答案级评估，尽管最坏情况界限保留了原生-空F1的增益。我们的研究表明，训练中的负面段落即使在常见校准后也会影响排序和下游决策，但并未确立原生训练的普遍优势。

articles.title: TeleASR-Amharic: A Benchmark for Robust Amharic ASR in Realistic Telecommunication Conditions
articles.abstract: The real-world usability of ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages, where existing speech resources are often collected in clean studio environments. In this work, we introduce TeleASR-Amharic, a benchmark for evaluating Amharic ASR under various acoustic and telecommunication conditions. We analyze the major degradations observed in real telecommunications recordings and develop a benchmark that covers multiple channel conditions, environmental disturbances, and telecom-domain variations. Our results show that telecommunication degradation can substantially reduce recognition performance, making even high-performing ASR models impractical under severe conditions. For example, the WER of the best-performing model increases from 0.23 to 0.79 under severe telecommunication degradation, corresponding to a relative increase of 243% in recognition errors. We further investigate the effects of different noise and channel distortions and show that scaling training data and applying carefully designed telecommunication-aware augmentation substantially improve robustness. In particular, our best training configuration achieves a 23.6% relative WER reduction under extreme noise conditions. Together with the release of our telecommunications-domain data, these findings provide a reproducible benchmark for measuring progress in Amharic ASR while highlighting open challenges in developing robust speech technologies for real-world deployment.
articles.comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Workshop W8 TrustAudio: Workshop on Secure, Safe, and Privacy-Preserving Speech and Audio AI
articles.titleCn: TeleASR-Amharic：真实通信环境下的鲁棒阿姆哈拉语语音识别基准
articles.abstractCn: ASR模型在实际应用中的可用性仍然面临挑战，尤其是在低资源语言中，现有的语音资源通常采集于干净的专业录音室环境。在这项工作中，我们引入了TeleASR-Amharic，一个用于在不同声学及电信条件下评估阿姆哈拉语ASR的基准。我们分析了真实电信录音中观察到的主要退化现象，并开发了一个涵盖多种信道条件、环境干扰和电信领域变化的基准。我们的结果表明，电信退化会显著降低识别性能，使得高性能ASR模型在严苛条件下也难以实用。例如，在严苛电信退化下，最佳模型的词错误率（WER）从0.23增加到0.79，识别错误率相对增加了243%。我们进一步研究了不同噪声和信道失真的影响，并表明通过扩展训练数据和应用精心设计的电信感知增强技术，可以显著提高鲁棒性。特别是，我们最佳的训练配置在极端噪声条件下实现了23.6%的相对WER降低。随着我们电信领域数据的发布，这些发现为衡量阿姆哈拉语ASR的进展提供了一个可复现的基准，同时突出了在开发适用于实际部署的鲁棒语音技术方面存在的挑战。

articles.title: Label Authority in Speech Emotion Recognition: Intended and Perceived Ground Truth in Emozionalmente
articles.abstract: Ground truth in Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is often presented as a single categorical fact, yet an acted emotion and the emotion heard by listeners describe different aspects of the same recording. We examine this distinction in Emozionalmente, an acted Italian corpus that provides both an elicited production label and five listener judgements for every clip. Using frozen XLS-R, HuBERT, and WavLM representations with matched probes, we compare three label authorities: the expressed condition, the listeners' hard plurality, and their complete vote distribution. The results tell a consistent story. Recovering the expressed condition is easier than predicting a tie-broken listener plurality, but that gap compares two different questions rather than revealing a general loss of SER ability. As listener agreement weakens, the plurality becomes an increasingly brittle hard target. Training on the full vote distribution does not substantially change which class wins the model's hard decision, but it produces probability assignments that more closely follow the alternatives selected by listeners, especially for ambiguous clips. No authority therefore replaces the others. Expressed labels describe how speech was produced, pluralities provide an operational single-class decision, and vote distributions preserve perceptual uncertainty. For human-facing Internet of Sounds applications, evaluations should state which authority is being predicted, retain its aggregation rule and agreement information, and use distributional scores when disagreement is part of the target.
articles.titleCn: 语音情感识别中的标签权威：Emozionalmente中的意图与感知真实标签
articles.abstractCn: 在语音情感识别（SER）中，真实标签通常被呈现为单一类别的事实，然而表演出的情感和听众听到的情感描述了同一录音的不同方面。我们在Emozionalmente中考察了这一区别，这是一个表演意大利语语料库，它为每个片段提供了激发性产出标签和五个听众判断。使用冻结的XLS-R、HuBERT和WavLM表示，并匹配探针，我们比较了三种标签权威性：表达条件、听众的硬多数，以及他们完整的投票分布。结果讲述了一个一致的故事。恢复表达条件比预测打破僵局的听众多数更容易，但这种差距比较的是两个不同的问题，而不是揭示SER能力的普遍丧失。随着听众协议的减弱，多数变成了一个越来越脆弱的硬目标。在完整的投票分布上训练不会实质性地改变哪个类别赢得模型的硬决策，但它产生的概率分配更接近听众选择的替代方案，特别是对于模糊的片段。因此，没有权威可以取代其他权威。表达标签描述了语音是如何产生的，多数提供了一个操作性的单类别决策，而投票分布保留了感知不确定性。对于面向人类的互联网声音应用，评估应说明正在预测哪种权威性，保留其聚合规则和协议信息，并在分歧是目标的一部分时使用分布分数。

articles.title: WenSight-Decision-1 for Direct Decisions under E-commerce Rules
articles.abstract: E-commerce decisions require applying natural-language rules to the available case evidence. We introduce WenSight-Decision-1, a shared model that scores supplied options directly from rules and case information for six operational tasks, with examples spanning six languages. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B with reference options as supervision, using the same option scores for training and inference. On 1,440 synthetic operational cases reserved for final evaluation, accuracy rises from 61.60% for Qwen3.5-9B to 92.92% for WenSight-Decision-1 under identical inputs and scoring. Joint fine-tuning improves all six tasks, bringing heterogeneous operational judgments under a common decision interface.
articles.titleCn: 基于电子商务规则的直接决策用WenSight-Decision-1
articles.abstractCn: 电子商务决策需要将自然语言规则应用于可用的案例证据。我们介绍了WenSight-Decision-1，这是一个共享模型，可以直接根据规则和案例信息对六项运营任务中提供的选项进行评分，示例涵盖六种语言。我们使用参考选项作为监督，对Qwen3.5-9B进行微调，并使用相同的选项评分进行训练和推理。在为最终评估保留的1,440个合成运营案例上，在相同的输入和评分条件下，准确率从Qwen3.5-9B的61.60%提升至WenSight-Decision-1的92.92%。联合微调改进了所有六项任务，将异构运营判断统一到一个决策界面下。

articles.title: The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits
articles.abstract: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a poster at the Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop version: https://openreview.net/forum?id=xP0xvmQZhB
articles.titleCn: 智能体记忆的几何学：预测与检索相关的记忆失败，并刻画其局限性
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了在生成答案之前，对话回合、记忆文本和查询之间的几何关系是否可以预测答案的正确性。我们评估了四种具有密集或混合检索的记忆实现方式，以及一种观察-总结比较器。我们将这些文本嵌入到一个共享空间中。一个逻辑分类器使用25个特征来描述查询的邻近性、记忆与对话的对应关系以及对话结构。在LongMemEval-small数据集上，池化AUROC在2,367个问题-系统对中为0.640，低于0.655的问题难度基线。性能因问题类型而异：几何关系在单会话助手问题中达到0.841，但仅系统身份就达到了0.826。在控制了难度和身份后，几何关系并未带来统计学上显著的池化改进（delta = +0.002，95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]）。一个固定存储上下文选择实验发现，与随机子集相比，邻近性排序的记忆具有更高的准确率，这与普通检索的相关性一致。在LoCoMo数据集上，最近回合的相似性对单跳问题具有适度的预测价值，而对其他几个类别则接近随机猜测。训练使用正确性标签，预测则使用预答案特征，且不进行额外的LLM生成调用。这些结果描述了记忆表示与正确性之间的关联，而不是建立一个可靠的部署诊断。特别是，嵌入的邻近性并不能验证事实覆盖范围，也无法区分记忆构建、检索和生成错误。

articles.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
articles.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.
articles.titleCn: HarnessRL：借助即时训练框架协同进化开放式RL策略
articles.abstractCn: 基于标准的强化学习（RL）使用自然语言标准作为奖励来训练开放式生成策略，但这些奖励在训练过程中可能会变得无效。我们识别出两种失效模式。在非区分性奖励下，由于探索不足或任务难度与策略能力不匹配，分数会崩溃到均匀的低值或高值。在虚假奖励下，更高的分数并不对应更好的响应。这两种情况都反映了训练配置在策略演变过程中，任务采样、探索和评估保持固定。我们引入了HarnessRL，这是一种在训练时使用的框架，通过三个接口与策略共同进化：任务采样、部署指导和标准标准。HarnessRL维护一个训练时记忆，框架进化器从中检索任务内历史记录和跨任务证据。利用这些证据，进化器将每个奖励失效归因于可以解决该问题的接口更新。然后，它运行一个提议者和即时评论员循环，评论员只有在测量其对当前冻结策略的影响后才会接受候选更新，并返回被拒绝的候选者以供修改。我们还策划了Rubric-Mix-10k，这是一个跨医学、科学、写作、角色扮演和指令跟随任务的开放式RL五域训练和评估套件。在Rubric-Mix-10k上，HarnessRL在4B和9B模型规模上均优于最强的基线，提高了2.8到3.1分，并将训练步骤减少近一半以达到最佳检查点。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL获取。

articles.title: SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge
articles.abstract: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.
articles.titleCn: SNO-PI：基于预训练编码器和精选术语知识的标签稀缺SNOMED CT实体链接
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了SNO-PI，截至2026年10月18日，在SNOMED国际的SNOMED CT实体链接基准测试中表现最佳的提交系统。SNO-PI实现了宏观字符IoU 0.5387，相较于组织者的参考系统（0.4582；基于2024年挑战赛冠军的方法）相对提升了18%。将临床提及与SNOMED CT链接是一个在极大规模标签空间中的零样本和少样本问题：272份标注的MIMIC-IV出院记录仅覆盖了约21.9万个合格概念中的6,595个，其中三分之一仅出现一次。这促使我们设计了一个基于预训练模型迁移和人工编辑知识的方法。SNO-PI结合了高召回率跨度提议、SapBERT候选检索和列表式集成重排序，并使用了三种BERT家族编码器，每个编码器都进一步在未标注的MIMIC-IV记录上进行了掩码语言建模预训练，然后在SNOMED CT同义词和层次结构上进行预训练，最后进行任务微调。我们发现，人工编辑知识在从未在训练中见过的概念上帮助最大，但这些概念仍然是主要的错误来源。

articles.title: Governing the Rule Space. Ruliology, Computational Irreducibility and Anticipatory Governance of Quantum Technologies
articles.abstract: The regulation of emerging technologies is often conceived as a strategy of catching up, because legislators arrive too late. Yet gathering signals, constructing scenarios and adapting rules to an anticipated future are fundamental tasks for those entrusted with governance, including the governance of rules themselves. The literature on so-called future law has already shown that anticipation means building institutional capabilities rather than predicting outcomes precisely (anticipatory governance). Taking this premise as its starting point, this article proposes to understand regulation as an exploration of the transformations that may occur. The Ruliological Framework for Anticipatory Regulation distinguishes rules, transformations and trajectories, assessing alternatives and possible developments. Within this approach, computational irreducibility is adopted conditionally, not as a demonstrated property of legal systems. The Quantum Europe Strategy provides a case study and further grounds for reflection.
articles.comment: English translation of an article originally published in Italian in Rivista della Corte dei conti, no. 4 (2026), pp. 27 - 41. Published with the journal's permission
articles.titleCn: 治理规则空间。规则学、计算不可约性与量子技术的预期治理
articles.abstractCn: 新兴技术的监管通常被视为一种追赶策略，因为立法者往往为时已晚。然而，收集信号、构建情景以及根据预期的未来调整规则，是那些负责治理的人的基本任务，包括对规则本身的治理。关于所谓的未来法的文献已经表明，预期意味着构建制度能力，而不是精确预测结果（预期治理）。本文以这一前提为出发点，提出将监管理解为对可能发生的转型的探索。预期监管的鲁里学框架区分了规则、转型和轨迹，评估了各种选择和可能的发展。在这种方法中，计算不可约性是条件性采用的，而不是作为法律系统已证明的特性。量子欧洲战略提供了一个案例研究和进一步的反思基础。

articles.title: Self-Consistency of Entity Sets and Citations in a Deep Research System under Repeated Prompting
articles.abstract: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.
articles.titleCn: 在深度研究系统中，实体集和引文在重复提示下的自洽性
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理（DRA）通常用于开放式合成任务，而封闭世界问答基准则不适合表征相关性能方面。我们研究了一个商业深度研究系统在重复相同提示下的自洽性，通过将每个报告表示为提及的命名实体集合（按自定义模式分类）以及检索到的引文集合来代表。在针对单个开放式网络安全相关提示的重复运行中，我们量化了成对重叠度以表征在重复相同提示下检索和合成输出结构的稳定性。在十次运行中，成对实体Jaccard结果的中位数为0.12，成对引文Jaccard低于0.02，且发现曲线没有明显饱和。实体集之间（不）一致的程度和结构因实体类别而异，这表明DRA中的自洽性应更好地理解为是底层实体空间的函数，而非系统的稳定属性。

articles.title: Co-Evolving Policy and Reward for Code Generation: A Mechanistic Study of Single-Adapter Drift
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is particularly well suited to code generation because generated programs can be objectively evaluated through execution. Execution also provides behavioral information that can be reused as additional supervision. The Synergistic Policy and Reward Co-Evolving Framework (SPARK), originally proposed for reasoning tasks, exploits this idea by recycling training rollouts and their evaluation results to train a model not only to generate solutions but also to evaluate and improve them. We investigate whether this policy-reward co-evolution approach transfers effectively to code generation and whether execution-grounded reflection provides an additional source of self-improvement. We compare SPARK-style rollout recycling with execution-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct. Our results do not support either hypothesis under the configuration tested. Although co-evolution improves training performance, these gains do not generalize to held-out problems. Compared at the same stage of training, rollout recycling produces roughly 34x greater KL divergence from the reference policy than execution-only GRPO. Over training, trained tokens per GRPO sequence fall from 185 to 86 as training pass rate increases, while held-out performance declines or fails to sustain early gains. We characterize these patterns as single-adapter policy drift: the shared trainable parameters increasingly depart from pretrained code-generation behavior without corresponding gains in generalization. The results show that higher training reward alone is not evidence of generalizable code self-improvement and highlight the importance of held-out evaluation and drift diagnostics.
articles.titleCn: 协同进化代码生成中的策略与奖励：单适配器漂移的机制研究
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）特别适用于代码生成，因为生成的程序可以通过执行进行客观评估。执行还提供了行为信息，这些信息可以重复用作额外的监督。协同策略与奖励共同进化框架（SPARK）最初是为推理任务提出的，它通过循环训练 rollout 及其评估结果来训练模型，使模型不仅能够生成解决方案，还能评估和改进它们。我们研究了这种策略-奖励共同进化方法是否能够有效地迁移到代码生成，以及基于执行的反思是否提供了额外的自我改进来源。我们使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct 比较了 SPARK 风格的 rollout 循环与仅基于执行的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。我们的结果在测试的配置下不支持任何假设。尽管共同进化提高了训练性能，但这些提升并未泛化到未见过的任务上。在相同训练阶段比较时，rollout 循环产生的参考策略的 KL 散度比仅基于执行的 GRPO 大约高出 34 倍。在训练过程中，随着训练通过率的提高，GRPO 序列中每个训练 token 从 185 降至 86，而未见过的任务性能下降或无法维持早期收益。我们将这些模式描述为单适配器策略漂移：共享的可训练参数越来越多地偏离预训练的代码生成行为，而泛化能力并未得到相应提升。结果表明，仅靠更高的训练奖励并不能证明代码自我改进具有泛化能力，并突出了未见过的任务评估和漂移诊断的重要性。

articles.title: Where Does Rhetorical Distortion Live? A Multi-Platform, Multi-Language Measurement of Influencer Content
articles.abstract: Much of the manipulation in online influencer content is not false but disproportionate: an accurate fact is framed as historic, urgent, or catastrophic. Fact-checking and clickbait detection are not designed to capture such framing, and little is known about where it originates: with the creator, the topic, the platform, or the audience that replies. We operationalize rhetorical distortion through five literature-grounded dimensions (Significance Inflation, Anxiety Manufacturing, Novelty Claims, Loaded Language, and Temporal Distortion) and measure it with a three-tier pipeline in which bilingual lexical rules propose candidates, negative filters cancel known false-positive contexts, and an LLM verifies or relabels the candidates. Applying the pipeline to 13,060 posts from 330 accounts on six platforms (RSS/newsletters, YouTube, Bluesky, Reddit, Weibo, and X/Twitter), we find that platform is far more strongly associated with account-level distortion than content category (Kruskal-Wallis $\varepsilon^2=0.33$; two-way ANOVA $η_p^2=0.49$ for platform vs. $0.09$ for category). X/Twitter scores highest (DI 7.74 vs. 0.78 for RSS). Classifying tweets and their replies separately shows where this comes from: the reply layer readers see under a post (its top-5 replies) carries 3.5x the distortion of the tweet it answers (7.65 vs. 2.17, $p<10^{-6}$, 36 of 43 accounts), driven by Loaded Language. At equal text length the gap shrinks to 1.5x but remains significant, and creator tweets alone are statistically indistinguishable from YouTube and Bluesky. Two independent human annotators confirm the reply gap, and the platform ordering and the reply gap replicate with GPT-4o as a second classifier. On threaded platforms, measured distortion thus lives largely in the audience layer, which motivates measurement that separates creator and reply text.
articles.titleCn: 修辞扭曲住在哪里？一项跨平台、多语言的网红内容测量研究
articles.abstractCn: 在线影响者内容中的许多操控并非虚假，而是比例失调：一个准确的事实被包装成具有历史意义、紧急性或灾难性。事实核查和标题党检测并非旨在捕捉这种框架，且对其来源知之甚少：是创作者、主题、平台还是回复的受众。我们通过五个基于文献的维度（重要性夸大、焦虑制造、新颖性声称、负载语言和时序扭曲）来操作化修辞扭曲，并使用一个三层管道进行测量，其中双语词汇规则提出候选，负面过滤器取消已知的假阳性上下文，并由大型语言模型验证或重新标记候选。将管道应用于来自六个平台（RSS/新闻简报、YouTube、Bluesky、Reddit、微博和X/Twitter）的330个账号的13,060篇帖子，我们发现平台与账号层面的扭曲关联远强于内容类别（Kruskal-Wallis $\varepsilon^2=0.33$；双向方差分析 $η_p^2=0.49$ 对平台而言，而类别为 $0.09$）。X/Twitter得分最高（DI 7.74 对 RSS 的 0.78）。分别对推文及其回复进行分类显示其来源：推文下读者看到的回复层（其前5条回复）比它所回复的推文扭曲程度高出3.5倍（7.65 对 2.17，$p<10^{-6}$，43个账号中有36个），主要由负载语言驱动。在等文本长度下，差距缩小到1.5倍但仍具显著性，而创作者的推文与YouTube和Bluesky在统计上无显著差异。两名独立的人工标注者确认了回复差距，平台排序和回复差距在以GPT-4o作为第二分类器时得以复制。因此，在串行平台上测量的扭曲主要存在于受众层，这促使我们进行区分创作者和回复文本的测量。

articles.title: Expert L2 English Speech Evaluation on a Gaming PC: Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody with XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus
articles.abstract: oollim is a locally executable system for evaluating L2 English pronunciation accuracy, fluency, and prosody on a consumer computer. The system combines pretrained XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus representations with reference-text features and ridge regressions trained on SpeechOcean762, the Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus (English), J-AESOP, and their combinations. On 305 independently held-out recordings assessed by three expert raters, several ridge configurations substantially outperform archived Azure API scores obtained in January 2026 in both Spearman correlation and quadratic weighted kappa across all three constructs. These results support expert speech evaluation on consumer hardware using pretrained representations and construct-specific regressions, without neural-model fine-tuning or calibration on the private evaluation data.
articles.comment: 19 pages, including appendices. Code and trained weights: https://github.com/cburst/oollim
articles.titleCn: 在游戏电脑上进行专家级L2英语口语评估：准确性、流利度和韵律度，使用XLS-R、XEUS和PhoneticXeus
articles.abstractCn: oollim是一个可在消费型计算机上本地执行的系统，用于评估L2英语发音准确性、流利度和韵律。该系统结合了预训练的XLS-R、XEUS和PhoneticXeus表示，以及参考文本特征和基于SpeechOcean762（韩国学习者L2英语语音语料库）、J-AESOP及其组合训练的岭回归。在由三位专家评估的305个独立保留录音中，几种岭配置在Spearman相关性和二次加权kappa方面均显著优于2026年1月获得的存档Azure API分数，涵盖了所有三个结构。这些结果支持在消费型硬件上使用预训练表示和特定结构回归进行专家语音评估，无需在私有评估数据上进行神经模型微调或校准。

articles.title: LaMER: Language-Conditioned Multi-Expert Routing for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
articles.abstract: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) localizes the image region described by a natural language expression, underpinning applications such as autonomous navigation, human-robot interaction, and medical image analysis. Under weak supervision, REC is challenged by the visual-linguistic semantic gap and the difficulty of inferring region-text correspondences from coarse image-level signals alone. Moreover, no single visual encoder captures all complementary properties---semantic alignment, fine-grained texture, and boundary awareness---while naively fusing multiple pretrained encoders yields heterogeneous, hard-to-reconcile representations. We propose LaMER, a weakly supervised REC framework that dynamically aggregates four frozen expert encoders through a language-conditioned Cross-Modal Routing Fusion module, adapting expert selection to each referring expression without instance-level bounding-box supervision. A Cell-Text Matching Head with Negative Anchor Augmentation, trained with a multi-objective loss combining contrastive, reconstruction, alignment, and load-balancing terms, further stabilizes optimization. LaMER achieves 77.67\%, 62.81\%, and 69.49\% Acc@IoU\(\geq 0.5\) on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg, surpassing DViN and WeakMCN by up to 16.49 and 14.49 points, with ablations validating each component.
articles.titleCn: LaMER：语言条件多专家路由用于弱监督指代表达理解
articles.abstractCn: 指代表达理解（REC）旨在定位自然语言表达所描述的图像区域，为自动驾驶导航、人机交互和医学图像分析等应用提供支持。在弱监督条件下，REC面临着视觉-语言语义鸿沟以及仅从粗糙的图像级信号中推断区域-文本对应关系的困难。此外，单一视觉编码器无法捕捉所有互补属性——语义对齐、细粒度纹理和边界感知——而盲目融合多个预训练编码器会产生异构且难以协调的表示。我们提出了LaMER，一个弱监督REC框架，通过语言条件下的跨模态路由融合模块动态聚合四个冻结专家编码器，无需实例级边界框监督即可自适应选择专家。带有负样本锚点增强的单元-文本匹配头，通过结合对比损失、重建损失、对齐损失和负载均衡损失的多目标损失进行训练，进一步稳定优化。LaMER在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg上实现了77.67%、62.81%和69.49%的Acc@IoU≥0.5，比DViN和WeakMCN分别提高了16.49和14.49个百分点，消融实验验证了每个组件的有效性。

articles.title: How Benchmark Graph Construction Shapes Multi-Hop KG Navigation: A Controlled Audit of PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large
articles.abstract: Multi-hop knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) benchmarks are often treated as fixed language-and-reasoning tasks, but for navigation-based methods, difficulty also depends on the graph in which those tasks are instantiated. This makes graph construction a consequential but often entangled part of the navigation task. To isolate this effect, we audit PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL) as graph-navigation benchmarks under a controlled intervention: we hold questions, topic entities, released answers, released path annotations, and family-level splits fixed while replacing each released task-filtered graph with the larger source KG distributed with the benchmark. Source restoration expands the effective navigation search space and graph-consistent answer and path multiplicity while sharply reducing unguided reachability to released answers. We evaluate whether these structural changes persist across navigation policies using structural references, frozen small-language-model navigation policies, and trained MINERVA policies. Across both frozen and trained policies, restoration substantially reduces released-answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity, while graph-consistent evaluation recovers only part of the loss. These results show that benchmark graph construction is part of the navigation task specification rather than merely an implementation detail and can materially shape measured behavior even when the released QA task is held fixed.
articles.comment: 17 pages. PQ/PQL reconstruction code available at https://github.com/HalcyonSolutions/PathQuestion-Family
articles.titleCn: 基准图构建如何影响多跳知识图谱导航：对PathQuestion和PathQuestion-Large的受控审计
articles.abstractCn: 多跳知识图谱问答（KGQA）基准测试通常被视为固定的语言和推理任务，但对于基于导航的方法而言，难度还取决于这些任务实例化的图谱。这使得图谱构建成为导航任务中一个重要但往往相互交织的部分。为了分离这种影响，我们通过受控干预审计PathQuestion（PQ）和PathQuestion-Large（PQL）作为图谱导航基准测试：我们保持问题、主题实体、已发布的答案、已发布的路径标注和家庭级划分固定，同时将每个已发布的任务过滤图谱替换为基准测试随附的更大源知识图谱。源恢复扩展了有效的导航搜索空间，增加了图谱一致的答案和路径多样性，同时显著降低了无引导可达已发布答案的能力。我们使用结构参考、冻结的小语言模型导航策略和训练的MINERVA策略评估这些结构变化是否跨导航策略持续存在。在冻结和训练策略中，恢复显著降低了已发布答案的准确性和轨迹保真度，而图谱一致的评估仅恢复了一部分损失。这些结果表明，基准图谱构建是导航任务规范的一部分，而不仅仅是实现细节，即使已发布的QA任务保持固定，它也能实质性地影响测量行为。

articles.title: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation can transfer the reasoning capabilities of a strong teacher to a smaller student. However, distillation from a stronger teacher model faces two mismatches: its solutions may be difficult for a smaller student to imitate, and its token-level probabilities may be incompatible with, or even unavailable to, the student. Existing methods handle these settings through different forms of supervision. To this end, we propose Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces. The model to be distilled from, termed the external teacher, first provides a reasoning trace as privileged context, which can be generated in an offline fashion. The student generates rollouts without this context, while a copy of the student conditioned on it, serving as the self-teacher, scores the same rollouts in the student's own token space. BSD uses the resulting token-level guidance to adjust updates on unsuccessful rollouts, with a verifier providing the outcome signal. As the external teacher is queried only to produce text, the same training procedure applies to all teacher scenarios: shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers. Across these scenarios, BSD improves over the base model and outperforms baselines tailored to each scenario, offering a novel and unified pathway for distillation. Code is available: https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation
articles.titleCn: 策略在线学习中的桥接自蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏可以将强教师的推理能力迁移到更小的学生模型上。然而，从更强的教师模型进行蒸馏面临两个不匹配问题：其解决方案可能难以被更小的学生模仿，且其标记级概率可能与学生不兼容，甚至对学生不可用。现有方法通过不同形式的监督来处理这些情况。为此，我们提出了桥接自蒸馏（BSD），这是一个用于从任何提供推理轨迹的教师模型进行蒸馏的统一框架。待蒸馏的模型称为外部教师，它首先以特权上下文的形式提供推理轨迹，该轨迹可以离线生成。学生在不使用该上下文的情况下生成行为轨迹，而学生在该上下文条件下的副本作为自教师，在学生的标记空间中对相同的行为轨迹进行评分。BSD使用生成的标记级指导来调整不成功行为轨迹的更新，并使用验证器提供结果信号。由于外部教师仅用于生成文本，因此相同的训练过程适用于所有教师场景：共享分词器、跨分词器和封闭API教师。在这些场景中，BSD优于基础模型，并超越了针对每个场景定制的基线，为蒸馏提供了一种新颖且统一的途径。代码已开源：https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
articles.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.
articles.titleCn: 专家混合语言模型参数高效微调的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法对于在资源受限环境下适配大型模型至关重要。然而，随着提供高效推理的专家混合（MoE）架构在社区中日益普及，由于缺乏将PEFT应用于MoE模型的系统性方法，存在一个关键性差距。为缩小这一差距，我们进行了一项大规模系统性研究，探究了一系列基本设计方法，包括哪些模块应进行适配、适配MoE模块的粒度、应使用哪种PEFT方法，以及负载均衡目标应使用到何种程度，这些研究覆盖了三个MoE主干网络在下游任务和通用知识任务上的表现。我们的实验得出了一些关键性见解。首先，仅适配MoE专家在可比参数预算下实现了最高的下游性能，并保持了具有竞争力的通用能力。其次，原生专家权重更新相较于绕过专家或整个MoE模块的适配器，提供了更好的下游保留权衡。第三，LoRA和DoRA共同定义了在所评估的PEFT方法中实现高下游精度的最强操作区域。第四，没有非零的负载均衡系数能支配零基线。最后，我们在Qwen3上评估了MoE^2-LoRA的权重级重新设计。将其模块级绕过池移入原生专家权重，使得所有四个上游指标提升了2.4到17.9分，同时训练参数减少了17%，平均下游成本降低了3.2分。

articles.title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.
articles.titleCn: VibeTraining-Bench：数据-训练-框架协同设计，用于迭代系统改进
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体诊断系统瓶颈，并在训练和推理过程中协调改进。我们将智能体联合优化训练数据、训练器和推理框架的能力称为跨组件协同设计。我们介绍了VibeTraining-Bench，这是一个用于评估该能力跨任务的基准，涵盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具使用和数学推理。在每个任务中，研究智能体在固定的资源预算下从一个相同的初始智能体系统开始。在验证反馈的指导下，它们迭代地优化数据、训练器和推理框架，然后选择并提交最终的智能体系统用于测试集上的评估。为防止奖励攻击，我们实施了三项安全措施：测试数据隔离、独立的研究和评分容器，以及研究智能体的网络限制。我们的评估结果表明，前沿研究智能体显著提高了目标智能体系统的性能。例如，在SWE-bench Verified上，GPT-6-Astra将目标智能体系统的性能从32.9%提高到53.7%，与人类开发的指令模型的55.4%相当。然而，它们在协同设计以及迭代优化数据、训练器和框架以实现累积性能提升方面的能力仍有提升空间。我们希望VibeTraining-Bench能成为推进RSI的统一平台，加深我们对智能体系统跨组件优化的理解。代码和数据可在https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench获取。

articles.title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs
articles.abstract: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved three of four model configurations across the external benchmarks, with mean gains of up to 9.6 percentage points, and improved all four configurations on the held-out test set by 10.2-30.3 points. Abstract retrieval performed best when reference evidence was abstract-aligned, whereas full-text representations were generally more effective when richer evidence was needed. Hierarchical representation matched or outperformed flat full-text retrieval in most end-to-end comparisons while requiring 67% fewer indexed units and 44-56% less storage. These findings show that corpus scale should be treated as an explicit evaluation variable in biomedical RAG, and that the most appropriate design depends on evidence format, model behavior, and operational constraints.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, plus 11 pages of supplementary material. Preprint submitted to Elsevier. Code: https://github.com/hitz-zentroa/biomedical-rag-scaling and https://github.com/hitz-zentroa/qa-to-mcqa
articles.titleCn: 大规模生物医学RAG：语料库扩展、文档表示与效率权衡
articles.abstractCn: 我们进行了一项受控的大规模评估，研究语料库规模、文档表示和重新排序如何影响生物医学检索增强生成（RAG）系统的有效性和效率。在保留相关源文档的同时，逐步扩展检索集合，从而能够在不同语料库规模之间进行一致的比较。我们在第一阶段检索、重新排序和端到端多项选择题回答中比较了摘要、扁平全文和层次全文表示。在开发数据上选择的配置在五个外部生物医学基准和一个保留的测试集上进行了评估，同时测量了检索延迟和索引存储以量化运营成本。随着集合的增长，在小型或受控集合中观察到的性能模式并不始终如一地持续存在，重新排序的实用性取决于语料库和检索设置。RAG在外部基准上改进了四个模型配置中的三个，平均提升高达9.6个百分点，并在保留的测试集上改进了所有四个配置，提升了10.2-30.3个百分点。当参考证据与摘要对齐时，摘要检索表现最佳，而需要更丰富证据时，全文表示通常更有效。层次表示在大多数端到端比较中与扁平全文检索相当或表现更优，同时索引单元减少了67%，存储减少了44-56%。这些发现表明，在生物医学RAG中，语料库规模应被视为一个明确评估变量，而最合适的设计取决于证据格式、模型行为和运营约束。

articles.title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors
articles.abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.
articles.comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Code, protocol and per-example outputs: https://github.com/AbdulRahmanIqbal/tdm-prevalence-shift
articles.titleCn: 在流行率偏移下的参数化决策模型：决策训练、校准和隐式先验
articles.abstractCn: 类型化决策模型（TDMs）返回调用者定义选项的概率，而Jev由其供应商描述为校准的。但在部署中类别频率会变化，因此固定测试集上的校准测量不一定适用于应用阈值的地方。现有评估留下了两个空白：供应商决策训练的收益尚未与相同读取方式下骨干网络的收益分离，且TDM仅在测试集的类别分布下进行了测试。我们询问决策训练是否能在模型自身骨干网络上改进模型，以及TDM的校准和阈值是否像微调分类器一样能够承受流行度（标签）的偏移。我们比较了三个TDM（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）、它们的基座模型和两个在五个公共数据集上基于相同决策进行训练的分类器，在模拟偏移下进行35对测试，并在计算任何测试之前固定。首先，决策训练并不总是有益的：与Qwen3.5-9B仅相差一个LoRA适配器的Nimble-9B，在意图任务上校准更好，但在金融情感上差12.0个宏观F1点。其次，在中等偏移下，Jev的预期校准误差（ECE）和阈值风险在金融情感上显著增长，比微调的DeBERTa多1.7和2.5个百分点；在2000个偏移场景（探索性）上的平均值，每个数据集上的差距最多为1点。第三，使用模型的平均发展预测作为其先验的EM先验校正无需标签，并在两个ECE最高的数据集上将Jev的ECE在偏移下降低了2.7和1.8点，尽管标记重新校准降低了它更多。我们测试的三个TDM既不总是比它们的骨干网络更好，也不在偏移下特别脆弱；在校准方面，它们的主要弱点是即使在没有偏移的情况下它们已经存在的误校准。我们发布了所有输入、代码和输出。

articles.title: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
articles.abstract: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.
articles.titleCn: 调度器是一个隐藏的检索器：异步性如何塑造搜索代理中的证据获取
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理正越来越多地通过并行推理和异步信息收集来处理复杂任务。在两个模型系列和三个基准测试中的受控重放实验表明，尽管初始证据相同，交付时间会改变在所有结果到达之前做出的搜索决策。获取分歧高达同序重复变化的24个百分点以上。这种依赖性在所有初始证据到达后以及第二次搜索中仍然存在，将代理所看到内容的暂时差异转化为他们获取内容的持久差异。一个匹配结构的获取悔恨界限表明，在固定的早期到达计数下的不变性可以限制已接收证据的使用。我们引入了汇聚证据获取（CEA），它会在每个子问题的证据完整时释放局部推理，并独立于完成顺序分配共享搜索。对于固定的计划和稳定的条件响应法则，我们证明了决策、获取和答案的联合不变性。在三个基准测试中仅使用问题的计划中，CEA将获取分歧控制在重复变化的1.0个百分点以内，并实现了与完整输入控制相当的正确率，比早期承诺提高了12.6个百分点。在竞争条件下用CEA的固定分配替换为最先可用分配，获取分歧增加了21.6个百分点，而局部查询目标分歧仍接近重复变化。计时比较表明，CEA比等待所有初始证据的相同程序更快地做出决策和响应。

articles.title: Answering While You Type: Optimizing Time-to-Answer with Streaming Generation
articles.abstract: Work on efficient large-language-model inference has concentrated almost entirely on reducing the cost of decoding once a request is complete. The quantity a user experiences, however, is the interval between submitting a request and receiving a usable response, and that interval can be shortened without making decoding itself faster. While a request is being composed it is already partially specified, yet conventional deployments begin no computation until submission. We propose and study streaming generation, a decoding regime in which the model begins producing a response from an incomplete request and revises it as the remaining input arrives, so that only a small residue of the answer remains to be computed once the request is submitted. We evaluate the regime on autoregressive and diffusion language models, characterise the conditions under which it reduces user-visible latency, and analyse the mechanism responsible.
articles.titleCn: 实时回复：通过流式生成优化回复时间
articles.abstractCn: 针对高效大型语言模型推理的研究几乎完全集中在请求完成后如何降低解码成本上。然而用户实际体验的是从提交请求到收到可用响应之间的时间间隔，这个间隔可以在不加快解码速度的情况下缩短。在请求正在被编写时，它已经部分确定，但传统的部署方式直到提交才开始计算。我们提出并研究流式生成，这是一种解码模式，模型从不完整的请求开始生成响应，并在剩余输入到达时进行修订，以便在请求提交后只需计算少量剩余答案。我们在自回归和扩散语言模型上评估了这种模式，描述了它减少用户可见延迟的条件，并分析了负责该机制的原理。

articles.title: Decomposed Relation Extraction from Aviation Accident Narratives: Evaluating Transformer-Based Safety Knowledge Discovery under Relational Sparsity
articles.abstract: Relation extraction from aviation accident narratives is challenging because genuine safety relations are sparse among possible concept pairs. This study evaluates a decomposed framework separating relation classification from concept identification. A benchmark of 300 National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) narratives containing 2,524 unique concept-text nodes was expanded into 21,038 ordered candidate pairs, with only 248 (1.18%) representing RESULTS_IN or CONTRIBUTES_TO relations. A TF-IDF Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) and weighted RoBERTa classifier were developed using an independent graph-annotated resource with hard-negative sampling and frozen before sealed evaluation. Development Macro-F1 scores of 0.4738 (SVM) and 0.4809 (RoBERTa) declined to 0.2741 and 0.2420 under exhaustive evaluation, with Matthews correlation coefficients of 0.0128 and 0.0197. False positives dominated: the SVM recovered 96 reference relations but generated 7,018 false positives, while RoBERTa recovered 125 but generated 9,824. Post-test diagnostics revealed overlapping RoBERTa confidence distributions and false positives even within valid relation-category directions. Complementary end-to-end SmolLM2 evaluation identified missed and unsupported relations alongside malformed outputs. These findings demonstrate that known concept endpoints do not guarantee reliable relation extraction and that sampled-negative development performance may poorly reflect exhaustive evaluation. Controlling false positives and managing candidate-space sparsity remain essential for aviation safety knowledge extraction.
articles.titleCn: 从航空事故叙述中分解关系抽取：评估基于Transformer的安全知识发现方法在关系稀疏性下的表现
articles.abstractCn: 从航空事故叙述中提取关系是一项挑战，因为在可能的概念对中，真实的安全关系非常稀疏。本研究评估了一个将关系分类与概念识别分离的分解框架。一个包含300份美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）叙述的基准，其中包含2,524个独特的概念-文本节点，被扩展为21,038个有序候选对，其中仅248对（1.18%）代表“导致”或“促成”关系。我们使用一个独立的图标注资源开发了TF-IDF线性支持向量机（SVM）和加权RoBERTa分类器，并在密封评估前进行硬负采样并冻结。开发阶段的宏观F1分数从0.4738（SVM）和0.4809（RoBERTa）下降到0.2741和0.2420，Matthews相关系数分别为0.0128和0.0197。假阳性占主导地位：SVM恢复了96个参考关系，但生成了7,018个假阳性，而RoBERTa恢复了125个，但生成了9,824个。后测试诊断显示RoBERTa置信度分布重叠，甚至在有效的关系类别方向中也存在假阳性。互补的端到端SmolLM2评估识别了遗漏和支持不足的关系以及格式错误输出。这些发现表明，已知的概念端点并不能保证可靠的关系提取，且采样负样本的开发性能可能无法反映全面评估。控制假阳性和管理候选空间稀疏性仍然是航空安全知识提取的关键。

articles.title: AudioScorer: Learning Question-Aware Token Relevance for Large Audio Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) reason over speech, environmental sounds, music, and other acoustic information. However, their audio encoders produce dense token sequences that make long-form audio costly to process. Existing audio pruning methods reduce this cost using heuristics such as attention, representation similarity, or temporal sampling, but do not explicitly learn which tokens are most useful for a given question. We propose AudioScorer, a lightweight model that scores audio tokens according to the user question. It is trained by distilling the ranking of audio tokens under the frozen LALM's answer-gradient saliency, together with downstream answer supervision. Compared with other pruning methods, AudioScorer achieves the best or tied-best result at 10% token retention on 7 of 10 semantic and acoustic tasks, including speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio-scene classification.
articles.titleCn: AudioScorer：学习针对大型音频语言模型的问答感知词元相关性
articles.abstractCn: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）对语音、环境声音、音乐及其他声学信息进行推理。然而，它们的音频编码器会产生密集的token序列，导致长音频处理成本高昂。现有的音频剪枝方法通过注意力、表征相似性或时间采样等启发式方法来降低这种成本，但并未明确学习哪些token对特定问题最有用。我们提出了AudioScorer，一种根据用户问题对音频token进行评分的轻量级模型。该模型通过在冻结的LALM的答案梯度显著性和下游答案监督下蒸馏音频token的排名进行训练。与其他剪枝方法相比，AudioScorer在10% token保留率下，在10个语义和声学任务中的7个任务（包括语音识别、情绪识别和音频场景分类）中取得了最佳或并列最佳结果。

articles.title: Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law
articles.abstract: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.
articles.titleCn: 保罗尼安机械：荷兰破产法中保罗尼安行为能力神经符号方法
articles.abstractCn: 应用一项法律条款通常需要结构化的基于规则的推理以及对判例法中形成的开放性术语的敏感性。荷兰破产法第42条的actio pauliana（允许破产管理人撤销损害债权人交易的行为）就要求这两种能力。我们提出了一个关于第42条Faillissementswet（Fw）的神经符号模型。其符号核心采用Catala语言以文献化风格编写，保持了法规与形式化的一致性，并通过结对编程开发，其中开放性术语被表示为布尔输入，神经组件与符号求解器相耦合。神经例程将案例的自然语言事实结构化为布尔和日期输入。神经子例程通过基于案例的推理来解析开放性术语，相关荷兰民事判决通过一个管道检索，该管道根据待解析的要求进行过滤，并沿着案例的程序链扩展。对这些判决进行分段和标注，在100个手动标注的黄金标准案例上达到了高精度和召回率。在十个手动标注的案例上，神经符号模型合理地处理了大多数标准，但在知识要求方面存在困难。检索深度没有显示出明显的定量效应，尽管检索到的判决为先前案例法提供了明确的依据。

articles.title: Shaping the Document, Not the Model: Optimized Suffixes for Context Following
articles.abstract: When a user supplies a document and wants the answer drawn from it, a language model is expected to follow it even when it contradicts its parametric knowledge. Prior work has focused on making the model rely on context by steering activations, contrasting logits during decoding, or instructing it in plain language. We ask whether the document alone, with no instruction written into it and no access to the model at inference time, is enough. We optimize a document suffix by discrete token search, starting from the answer to a single question and extending the objective to a set of passages, to multi-hop questions that follow from the planted fact, and to later turns of a conversation. On counterfactual passages that contradict parametric knowledge of the model, the suffix flips nearly all items the model resists across three instruction-tuned model families, in most settings outperforms the decoding baseline and the strongest instruction we could write, and matches activation steering. Controls show that the suffix largely acts through the passage rather than injecting the answer, and a single suffix per model transfers to unseen passages. Each extended objective carries the effect to its target, so the objective, not only the document, sets how far the effect reaches.
articles.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://context-gcg.github.io
articles.titleCn: 塑造文档，而非模型：优化上下文跟随的后缀
articles.abstractCn: 当用户提供文档并希望答案源自该文档时，语言模型被期望遵循文档内容，即使其参数化知识与之矛盾。以往的研究侧重于通过引导激活、解码时对比logits或用平实语言指导模型来使其依赖上下文。我们探究仅凭文档本身，无需其中写入指令且在推理时无法访问模型，是否足够。我们通过离散标记搜索优化文档后缀，从单个问题的答案开始，将目标扩展到一系列段落、由植入事实引出的多跳问题，以及对话的后续回合。在违背模型参数化知识的反事实段落中，该后缀几乎翻转了模型在三个指令调优模型家族中抵抗的所有项目，在大多数情况下优于解码基线和最强的指令，并匹配激活引导效果。控制实验表明，后缀主要通过段落起作用而非直接注入答案，且每个模型的单个后缀可迁移到未见过的段落。每个扩展目标将其效果传递到目标，因此不仅文档，目标本身决定了效果的影响范围。

articles.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
articles.abstract: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.
articles.titleCn: 心跳思维：实时语音代理中的推测推理与工具执行
articles.abstractCn: 使用工具的语音代理在语音结束后常常让用户等待，即使可操作的指令信息在请求中更早出现。推测性方法在语音期间开始工作，但基于块或更新时中断的生成可能会在工具参数完成前截断工具调用。这使计算时间与语音更新耦合，限制了在语音更新前完成的有用工作。我们引入了心跳思维（Heartbeat Thinking），它通过新的思维者（Thinker）调用处理更新输入，同时允许正在进行的调用和已分发的工具完成。周期性调用读取最新的部分文本转录和共享的推理完成记录及工具结果。这些结果有助于解决缺失的参数并启动依赖调用，允许准备工作跨语音更新推进。在SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG上，心跳思维（Heartbeat）在SHANKS风格的窗口化基线之上提高了推测性工具覆盖或检索重用的总体表现，对最终任务质量的影响取决于基准测试。在FDBench v3上，它将工具覆盖率提高了16个百分点，并将平均最终响应延迟降低了36.4%。结果表明，在语音期间保留正在进行的计算的心跳思维范式可以将听音时间转化为可重复的准备，从而实现更快、更强大的语音代理响应。

articles.title: Rethinking BPE: Merge Selection as Model Selection
articles.abstract: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) are a core component of modern language models; yet, tokenizer capacity remains typically determined by a fixed merge budget, chosen heuristically. Since larger vocabularies increase memory usage and computational cost, selecting compact and effective token inventories is essential for efficient language modeling. We study the optimization of a BPE merge budget as a statistical model selection problem and investigate information-theoretic criteria for \emph{computing optimal merge sets} directly from corpus statistics. To further improve the merge selection in limited data conditions, we augment the BPE training corpora with synthetic texts generated from the original data, providing estimates for the unigram and bigram distributions. Experiments across multiple corpora and downstream tasks show that using a principled vocabulary selection technique reduces model size, with little degradation in performance. We further observe that synthetic data can yield better tokenizers, especially in low-resource settings.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考BPE：合并选择作为模型选择
articles.abstractCn: 子词分词方法，如字节对编码（BPE），是现代语言模型的核心组成部分；然而，分词器的容量通常由一个固定的合并预算决定，该预算是启发式选择的。由于更大的词汇量会增加内存使用和计算成本，因此选择紧凑且有效的标记库对于高效的语言建模至关重要。我们研究BPE合并预算的优化，将其视为一个统计模型选择问题，并研究从语料库统计中直接计算最优合并集的信息论标准。为了在有限数据条件下进一步改进合并选择，我们通过从原始数据生成合成文本来扩充BPE训练语料库，提供了一元和二元分布的估计。跨多个语料库和下游任务的实验表明，使用一种基于原则的词汇选择技术可以减小模型大小，且性能几乎没有下降。我们进一步观察到，合成数据可以生成更好的分词器，尤其是在低资源环境下。

articles.title: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
articles.abstract: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.
articles.comment: Content warning: this paper discusses suicide, self-harm, and distressing language
articles.titleCn: 隐语表达自我伤害数据集（通过间接语言评估漏洞表达）
articles.abstractCn: AI系统可能会忽略间接的、具有文化背景的痛苦表现，或者提供与应用场景不匹配的支持。现有的基准未能同时解决文化差异、应用场景和从业者意见不一致的问题。我们介绍了VEILED-SH，这是一个用于评估针对自杀、自残和痛苦间接表达的单一回合响应的基准和构建方法。其10,003个提示涵盖了咨询聊天、论坛帖子、平台搜索和分诊，并基于新加坡本土来源和公共数据集。一个由专家验证的多标签分类法区分了意图、交际功能和响应行为。六个自动化的配置文件，分别针对三个同伴支持从业者和三个临床医生进行单独校准，为代理对齐评分保留独立的参考策略。在覆盖范围增强的样本上评估五个系统显示，即使在相同的系统响应中，不同配置文件生成的参考策略在代理对齐方面也存在差异。

articles.title: Reading Time Modeling with Pixel-Based Language Models
articles.abstract: Tokenization-free, pixel-based language models (PLMs) have recently been proposed as an alternative to conventional token-based language models (TLMs), typically motivated by practical considerations, e.g., the flexibility to support new languages or vocabularies. Nevertheless, PLMs also have the potential to serve as infrastructure for computational (psycho)linguistics, where tokenization has been a source of bias in estimating information-theoretic values, such as surprisal, and has pushed the bottom-up visual orthographic features outside the scope. In this study, we first integrate PLMs into the modeling of naturalistic human reading and, in particular, examine their use to estimate next-word predictability, which can also integrate orthographic and parafoveal information. Our results demonstrate that next-word prediction difficulty, computed in pixel space, has strong predictive power for gaze duration and word skipping behavior across various languages. In particular, their advantage is complementary to existing token-level surprisal and entropy estimates. Cross-lingual analyses with script variations also clarify their distinctive visual processing biases, facilitating research into how bottom-up visual information is incrementally integrated into expectation-based reading.
articles.titleCn: 基于像素的语言模型进行阅读时间建模
articles.abstractCn: 无分词、基于像素的语言模型（PLMs）近来被提出作为传统基于分词的语言模型（TLMs）的替代方案，这通常源于实际考虑，例如支持新语言或词汇的灵活性。然而，PLMs也有潜力作为计算（心理）语言学的基础设施，其中分词一直是估计信息论值（如意外性）时产生偏见的来源，并将自下而上的视觉正字法特征排除了范围。在本研究中，我们首先将PLMs整合到自然人类阅读的建模中，并特别考察了它们在估计下一词可预测性方面的应用，这也可以整合正字法和周边视野信息。我们的结果表明，在像素空间中计算的下一词预测难度对跨多种语言的注视时长和跳词行为具有强大的预测能力。特别是，它们的优势与现有的分词级意外性和熵估计互补。包含文字变化的跨语言分析也阐明了它们独特的视觉处理偏见，促进了研究自下而上的视觉信息如何逐步整合到基于预期的阅读中。

articles.title: Conditional information Retrieval for Longitudinal Survey Harmonisation
articles.abstract: Identifying conceptually equivalent questions across different surveys is a challenging information retrieval task where surface-level textual similarity is insufficient. Two questions may be lexically similar yet assess entirely different sociological sub-concepts, or lexically different yet conceptually equivalent. We introduce a conditional information retrieval framework that addresses this by decomposing the task into two steps: concept extraction, which identifies the underlying sociological concept of a survey question using a fine-tuned generative model, and concept-aware retrieval, which augments question representations with the extracted concept as an explicit conditioning signal for finer-grained alignment. To reflect the realistic data scarcity conditions of specialised social science annotation, we use CLOSER as a case study. Our framework consistently outperforms baselines by 2-3 points in both MAP and Recall. We further analyse fine-tuning strategies including SFT, DPO, and dynamic DPO, finding that SFT delivers the most stable gains while dynamic DPO interacts differently with instruction-tuned versus distilled reasoning backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that a model fine-tuned on a general social science thesaurus (ELSST) transfers robustly to task-specific survey data, offering a practical solution under data scarcity.
articles.titleCn: 纵向调查数据整合的条件信息检索
articles.abstractCn: 跨不同调查识别概念上等价的问题是一项具有挑战性的信息检索任务，仅靠表面文本相似性是不够的。两个问题可能在词汇上相似，但评估的是完全不同的社会学子概念，或者词汇不同但概念上等价。我们引入了一个条件信息检索框架，通过将任务分解为两个步骤来解决这一问题：概念提取，它使用一个微调的生成模型来识别调查问题的潜在社会学概念；概念感知检索，它将提取的概念作为显式的条件信号来增强问题表示，以便进行更细粒度的对齐。为了反映专业社会科学标注的现实数据稀缺条件，我们以CLOSER为例进行研究。我们的框架在MAP和召回率方面始终比基线高出2-3个百分点。我们进一步分析了微调策略，包括SFT、DPO和动态DPO，发现SFT提供了最稳定的增益，而动态DPO与指令微调的推理主干和蒸馏推理主干相互作用不同。最后，我们证明在通用社会科学主题词表（ELSST）上微调的模型能够稳健地迁移到特定任务的调查数据中，为数据稀缺情况提供了一种实用解决方案。

articles.title: VISAGENT: An Agent-Based End-to-End Voice Interaction System
articles.abstract: Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness. More broadly, this work advocates a shift from isolated voice assistants toward agent-centric conversational infrastructures, providing a general blueprint for building extensible voice-agent systems in public services and beyond.
articles.titleCn: VISAGENT：一种基于智能体的端到端语音交互系统
articles.abstractCn: 基于语音的公共服务已从人工交换台发展到智能平台，以满足现代用户需求。然而，当前系统仍受限于刚性菜单式交互、垂直服务碎片化以及扩展性有限等问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出了VISAGENT，一个基于代理的端到端语音交互系统，用于大规模公共服务，该系统集成了端到端语音交互、分层代理路由、可扩展的语音代理市场以及用户记忆支持。该系统用自然语音取代了菜单式工作流程，并通过双层路由范式动态地将用户请求分配给通用对话模型或专业领域代理，该范式在数百个代理上实现了亚秒级的意图到代理选择。用户记忆会提供偏好感知的代理选择，并向选定的代理提供相关的偏好和上下文信息，支持个性化任务执行，减少用户重复提供先前信息的需求。一个语音代理注册机制将任务代理转换为对话实体，实现动态接入和生态系统级别的扩展性。我们通过在中国114热线多个服务领域进行实际部署来验证VISAGENT。实验结果表明，系统具有低延迟的全双工交互、稳健的路由可扩展性以及具有竞争力的语音自然度。更广泛地说，这项工作倡导从孤立的语音助手转向以代理为中心的对话基础设施，为构建可扩展的公共服务语音代理系统提供了通用蓝图。

articles.title: DeepSEA: A Multilingual Evaluation Benchmark for Southeast Asia
articles.abstract: While language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their performance remains disproportionately skewed towards high-resource languages. This disparity is particularly acute for the 700 million inhabitants of Southeast Asia, where vast linguistic diversity remains under-represented in existing benchmarks, often suffering from limited language coverage or narrow task scopes. To address this, we introduce DeepSEA, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from established datasets through professional human translation into 12 Southeast Asian languages, spanning both high-resource (e.g., Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese) and low-resource (e.g., Burmese, Khmer, Lao) tiers across five distinct tasks: mathematical reasoning, scientific reasoning, question answering, abstractive summarization, and machine translation. Extensive evaluation of frontier proprietary and open-weights models reveals that while frontier models like Gemini-3.7-Flash maintain robustness across resource tiers, smaller models face severe performance degradation on low-resource languages. Crucially, models perform better in reasoning and summarization when pivoted through English rather than target languages, exposing a critical dependency on English representations, especially for low-resource languages. Beyond these observations, we provide a cross-lingual error analysis and a cross-script tokenizer fertility analysis. We hope these findings shed light on the development of next-generation inclusive multilingual models.
articles.comment: For the codebase and dataset, see https://github.com/google-research/deep-sea
articles.titleCn: DeepSEA：东南亚多语言评估基准
articles.abstractCn: 尽管语言模型已展现出卓越的能力，但它们的性能仍不成比例地偏向于高资源语言。这种差距在东南亚7亿居民中尤为突出，因为现有基准中存在大量语言多样性，这些语言往往受到语言覆盖范围有限或任务范围狭窄的影响。为解决这一问题，我们引入了DeepSEA，这是一个通过专业人工翻译将现有数据集转化为12种东南亚语言（涵盖高资源语言，如印尼语、泰语、越南语，以及低资源语言，如缅甸语、高棉语、老挝语）的综合基准，涉及五个不同任务：数学推理、科学推理、问答、抽象摘要和机器翻译。对前沿专有和开源权重模型的广泛评估表明，虽然像Gemini-3.7-Flash这样的前沿模型在资源层级上保持稳健，但小型模型在低资源语言上的性能严重下降。关键在于，当通过英语而非目标语言进行推理和摘要时，模型表现更佳，这揭示了对英语表示的严重依赖，尤其是对低资源语言而言。除此之外，我们还提供了跨语言错误分析和跨文字分词器丰度分析。我们希望这些发现能为下一代包容性多语言模型的发展提供启示。

articles.title: Evaluating Tibetan Speech Recognition Across Dialects and Adaptation Regimes: A Multi-Granularity Analysis
articles.abstract: Tibetan speech recognition is usually evaluated with character or syllable error rates because the writing system does not mark word boundaries. These metrics can rank systems differently and respond differently to adaptation failures. We combine character error rate, syllable error rate, and segmented word error rate in one evaluation framework. We use dictionary-based, neural, and language-model-based segmentation and compare their boundaries with expert annotations. We evaluate five ASR architectures on Lhasa Tibetan, then test zero-shot transfer and target-corpus adaptation on five additional corpus subsets. We also vary LoRA rank and training-data size to examine adaptation failure. The results show that a lower character error does not always lead to a lower syllable or segmented-word error. These ranking differences persist across corpora. Metric correlations also weaken in some unsuccessful adaptation settings. Higher LoRA ranks improve syllable and segmented-word scores but remain worse than full fine-tuning in the tested range. A standardized phonological representation provides another view of spelling errors. These findings support evaluation at several linguistic levels and motivate better segmentation and adaptation methods for low-resource ASR.
articles.titleCn: 跨方言和适应模式下的藏语语音识别评估：一种多粒度分析
articles.abstractCn: 藏语语音识别通常使用字符或音节错误率进行评估，因为其书写系统没有标记词边界。这些指标可能对系统产生不同的排名，并对适应失败做出不同的反应。我们将字符错误率、音节错误率和分词错误率结合在一个评估框架中。我们使用基于词典、神经网络和基于语言模型的分词方法，并将它们的边界与专家标注进行比较。我们在拉萨藏语上评估了五种语音识别架构，然后在另外五个语料库子集上测试了零样本迁移和目标语料库适应。我们还改变了LoRA秩和训练数据大小，以检验适应失败。结果表明，较低的字符错误率并不总是导致较低的音节或分词错误率。这些排名差异在不同的语料库中都持续存在。在某些不成功的适应设置中，指标的相关性也减弱。较高的LoRA秩可以提高音节和分词得分，但在测试范围内仍不如全量微调。标准化的语音表示提供了另一种拼写错误的视角。这些发现支持在多个语言层面上进行评估，并激励为低资源语音识别开发更好的分词和适应方法。

articles.title: Honeyed Words, Hidden Daggers: Benchmarking and Training LLMs to See Through Mock Politeness
articles.abstract: The Chinese idiom "kou mi fu jian" ("honeyed words, hidden daggers") names speech that is polite in form but hostile in function. We present ZhenhuanBench, a 1,592-item benchmark built from expert commentary on Empresses in the Palace, covering speaker intent, emotion-language mismatch, and per-listener uptake. Text-only evaluation covers 34 LLMs. GPT-6 Astra leads the leaderboard at 73.48% overall, while its listener-reaction score is 58.37%. The annotations also supply supervised traces and string-verifiable training rewards. With 338 gold traces, an 8B model outperforms teacher distillation on identical items. Subsequent RL saturates, and chance correction reduces the estimated recoverable performance gap by a factor of 7.5. Our CPR-GRPO loop (Compress-Probe-Replenish) uses this estimate to weight gold supervision, reaching 67.0 on public multiple-choice tasks and 74.5 under the training-matched hidden protocol. Without target-task training, CPR outperforms Base, SFT, and GRPO across six Chinese and English pragmatic and sarcasm evaluations. On three external datasets, training with CPR yields higher mean Macro-F1 than SFT and GRPO.
articles.titleCn: 蜜语藏刀：基准测试和训练大型语言模型以识破伪装的礼貌
articles.abstractCn: 中国成语“口蜜腹剑”形容形式上礼貌但功能上具有敌意的言语。我们提出了ZhenhuanBench，这是一个包含1,592个项目的基准，由《宫斗》专家评论构建，涵盖说话者意图、情感与语言的错配以及针对每个听众的接受度。仅文本评估覆盖了34个大型语言模型。GPT-6 Astra在排行榜上以73.48%的总分领先，而其听众反应得分为58.37%。这些注释还提供了监督轨迹和可验证字符串的训练奖励。拥有338个黄金轨迹时，一个8B模型在相同项目上的表现优于教师蒸馏。后续的强化学习趋于饱和，而机会校正将估计的可恢复性能差距缩小了7.5倍。我们的CPR-GRPO循环（压缩-探测-补充）利用这个估计来加权黄金监督，在公开多项选择题任务上达到67.0，在训练匹配的隐藏协议下达到74.5。在没有目标任务训练的情况下，CPR在六个中文和英文的语用和讽刺评估中均优于Base、SFT和GRPO。在三个外部数据集上，使用CPR训练的平均宏F1得分高于SFT和GRPO。

articles.title: Balance-Aware Pivot Selection for Parallel Diffusion LLM Decoding
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a promising alternative to sequential autoregressive decoding. Existing acceleration methods use predictive confidence to enable parallel token commitment while preserving generation quality. However, confidence-based selection prioritizes reliable token predictions without explicitly considering how token positions shape the remaining decoding schedule. Moreover, such ordering does not always reflect inter-token dependencies, suggesting that confidence need not be the sole criterion for token selection. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding (BPD), which favors central pivots within contiguous masked intervals and decodes the selected positions in parallel. Balanced pivots yield logarithmic decoding depth in the interval length. Our practical method accounts for model uncertainty by combining confidence-based prefilling with confidence-thresholded center selection. We evaluate the resulting quality-efficiency tradeoff on LLaDA and Dream across five mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction-following benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLM_random_pivot-EE62/
articles.titleCn: 平衡感知的并行扩散LLM解码枢轴选择
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型支持并行标记生成，为顺序自回归解码提供了有前景的替代方案。现有的加速方法利用预测置信度实现并行标记确定，同时保持生成质量。然而，基于置信度的选择优先考虑可靠的标记预测，而未明确考虑标记位置如何影响剩余的解码调度。此外，这种排序并不总是反映标记间的依赖关系，表明置信度不应该是标记选择的唯一标准。基于这一局限性，我们提出了平衡感知枢轴解码（BPD），该解码器倾向于选择连续掩码区间内的中心枢轴，并并行解码选定位置。平衡枢轴在区间长度上产生对数的解码深度。我们的实用方法通过结合基于置信度的预填充和基于置信度阈值的中心选择来考虑模型的不确定性。我们在LLaDA和Dream上对生成的质量-效率权衡进行了评估，涵盖了五个数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随基准。我们的实现可在以下链接获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLM_random_pivot-EE62/

articles.title: Decision4Rec: A Jev-Inspired Framework of Decision Models on Knowledge and Active Graphs for Multi-Agent Recommender Systems
articles.abstract: Decision models, such as the commercial Jev, are language models that return one probability for each option of a question instead of generating text. We present Decision4Rec, an open and modular framework that makes decision models useful for recommendation. A knowledge graph writes the logs of each recommendation scenario as short statements on a defined scale, such as "sold: top 10%". A pool of agents, proposes candidates, and a residual ranker keeps the best 30. A decision model, trained once on real choices of three scenarios, reads them through one interface of typed questions, and a fusion step combines its answers with the score of the ranker. Any model with this interface can be used, and we run the commercial Jev, the released open Kev and Kev models trained by us on recommendation requests. The framework with a trained 4B decision model is 25 to 36% above the best trained baseline in NDCG@10 in three sparse Amazon catalogues, one of them never used to train the decision model, and almost tie with baselines on the dense Steam dataset. Most of the gain comes from the pool, and with a trained recommender it comes from what the agents know about its candidates rather than from new candidates. The 27B decision model adds to the pool 5 to 6% above the 0.8B model in three of four domains. A trained 0.8B open model beats the released Jev in eleven of fifteen settings and is never worse. On MovieLens-1M, a dense domain never seen in training, the gain is 5 to 7%. Code, configurations and trained models are available at https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec and https://huggingface.co/m-polignano.
articles.titleCn: 决策4推荐：一个受杰夫启发、基于知识和主动图的多智能体推荐系统决策模型框架
articles.abstractCn: 决策模型，如商业Jev，是一种为每个问题选项返回一个概率的语言模型，而不是生成文本。我们提出了Decision4Rec，一个开放且模块化的框架，使决策模型适用于推荐。知识图谱将每个推荐场景的日志记录为定义好的短句，例如“销售：前10%”。一个代理池提出候选，残差排序器保留最佳30个。决策模型通过一个类型化问题的接口在三个真实场景的选择上训练一次，融合步骤将其答案与排序器的分数相结合。任何具有此接口的模型都可以使用，我们运行了商业Jev、发布的开源Kev以及我们训练的Kev模型在推荐请求上。在三个稀疏的亚马逊目录中，带有训练的4B决策模型的框架在NDCG@10上比最佳训练基线高出25%至36%，其中一个是从未用于训练决策模型的，并且在密集的Steam数据集上几乎与基线持平。大部分增益来自代理池，而使用训练好的推荐器时，增益来自代理对其候选的了解，而不是新的候选。在四个领域中的三个领域，27B决策模型比0.8B模型增加了5%至6%。训练的0.8B开源模型在十五个设置中的十一个上优于发布的Jev，并且从未表现更差。在MovieLens-1M上，一个训练中从未见过的密集领域，增益为5%至7%。代码、配置和训练模型可在https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec和https://huggingface.co/m-polignano获取。

articles.title: Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt
articles.abstract: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. We test replication across two reasoning-native target-serving configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar and Qwen3.8-27B through LM Studio. For each target, we evaluate the same held-out tasks and four conditions - minimal baseline, GEPA prompt, SkillOpt skill, and manually engineered prompt - on HotpotQA (n=500 per condition) and MATH-500 (n=250). In the primary Qwen v2 rerun under the same frozen protocol, GEPA selects the HotpotQA seed and exactly reproduces baseline behavior, whereas SkillOpt's validation gain reverses into held-out degradation. On MATH-500, GEPA raises exact match from 0.828 to 0.904 while reducing latency but increasing token consumption, so lower response time does not imply lower token cost. DeepSeek likewise shows its strongest GEPA effect on MATH-500 (0.852 to 0.908). Across both targets, GEPA's strongest gains occur on MATH-500, while neither optimizer improves the HotpotQA baseline. Optimization is therefore task- and method-dependent, and validation gains may reverse on held-out evaluation. An earlier Qwen run is retained as serving-sensitivity evidence. These results suggest that textual headroom for a model-task pair and the observed effect of a text-space optimizer are more informative when decomposed into content/reasoning, answer-realization/evaluator alignment, and serving-completion/reliability. The cross-benchmark pattern further suggests that optimization may benefit from low-ambiguity, actionable evaluation signals.
articles.titleCn: 理解反射性提示和技能优化何时有助于本地服务的推理模型：一项针对GEPA和SkillOpt的双模型研究
articles.abstractCn: 反射式文本-空间优化器如GEPA和SkillOpt在边界和中等规模模型上已报告了显著的增益。我们测试了在两个推理原生目标服务配置中的复制：DeepSeek V4 Flash通过DwarfStar和Qwen3.8-27B通过LM Studio。对于每个目标，我们在HotpotQA（每条件n=500）和MATH-500（n=250）上评估相同的保留任务和四个条件——最小基线、GEPA提示、SkillOpt技能和手动设计的提示。在相同冻结协议下的主要Qwen v2重跑中，GEPA选择了HotpotQA种子并精确地复制了基线行为，而SkillOpt的验证增益逆转为保留集退化。在MATH-500上，GEPA将精确匹配从0.828提高到0.904，同时降低延迟但增加token消耗，因此较低响应时间并不等同于较低token成本。DeepSeek同样在MATH-500上展示了其最强的GEPA效果（0.852到0.908）。在两个目标上，GEPA的最大增益出现在MATH-500上，而两个优化器都没有改善HotpotQA基线。因此，优化是任务和方法相关的，验证增益在保留集评估中可能会逆转。保留了一个早期的Qwen运行作为服务敏感性证据。这些结果表明，模型-任务对的文本余量以及文本-空间优化器观察到的作用在分解为内容/推理、答案实现/评估器对齐和服务完成/可靠性时更具信息量。跨基准模式进一步表明，优化可能受益于低歧义、可操作的评估信号。

articles.title: Accelerated Drift of Scientific Prose in the LLM Era: Evidence from an Interrupted Time-Series Analysis
articles.abstract: Every scientific text is embedded in the writing norms of its time: it reflects earlier publications while also shaping the texts that follow. The growing use of LLM-based writing tools introduces a new factor in this evolving system, but the linguistic changes coinciding with their emergence remain insufficiently understood.
