We investigate whether the trajectories of scientific-preprint writing changed in rate or direction after conversational LLMs became publicly accessible, using the release of ChatGPT in November 2022 as the observational breakpoint. We compare pre- and post-2022 trajectories across vocabulary, punctuation, readability, and syntax in abstracts from arXiv's artificial intelligence, statistics, and quantitative biology categories and from medRxiv. Using interrupted time-series regression, we find substantial post-2022 changes across multiple feature families and research domains, including increases in average word length, reduced formula-based readability, and declines in maximum dependency-tree depth and sentence-level depth variation. Individual features follow different dynamics: some lexical markers accelerate persistently, while others rise and then recede. Our findings show that isolated marker frequencies capture only part of the shift: changes in the rate, direction, and structure of linguistic trajectories provide complementary evidence of broader post-2022 change in scientific-preprint writing. More broadly, these findings motivate monitoring scientific writing as a multidimensional, evolving system rather than through a fixed set of LLM-associated markers.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, including references and appendices
articles.titleCn: LLM时代科学散文的加速漂移：中断时间序列分析的证据
articles.abstractCn: 每篇科学文本都嵌入在其时代的写作规范之中：它既反映了早期的出版物，也塑造着后续的文本。基于大型语言模型（LLM）的写作工具的日益普及为这一不断演变的系统引入了新的因素，但与其出现相伴的语言变化仍未能得到充分理解。我们研究了在对话式LLM公开可访问后，科学预印本写作的轨迹是否在速率或方向上发生了变化，并以2022年11月ChatGPT的发布作为观察性断点。我们比较了2022年前后在词汇、标点、可读性和句法等方面的轨迹，数据来源于arXiv的人工智能、统计学和定量生物学类别以及medRxiv的摘要。通过中断时间序列回归分析，我们发现2022年后在多个特征家族和研究领域出现了显著变化，包括平均词长增加、基于公式的可读性降低、最大依赖树深度和句子级深度变异下降。不同特征呈现出不同的动态变化：某些词汇标记持续加速，而另一些标记则先升后降。我们的研究表明，孤立标记的频率只能捕捉到部分变化：语言轨迹速率、方向和结构的改变为2022年后科学预印本写作的更广泛变化提供了互补证据。更广泛地说，这些发现促使我们将科学写作视为一个多维度的、不断演变的系统，而不是通过一套固定的LLM相关标记来监测。

articles.title: Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs
articles.abstract: Building capable language models for India requires scalable multilingual data and robust evaluation. We introduce Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1, a synthetic pretraining corpus of approximately 2.83 trillion tokens covering all 22 scheduled Indian languages in native script and twelve in romanized form. It is the largest openly released Indic pretraining corpus. Using our GPU-accelerated pipeline, we translate curated English documents, assess translation quality, and repair low-quality outputs while preserving technical content and document structure and maintaining source traceability. Through continued-pretraining experiments across twelve languages, we show that combining our synthetic corpus with natural Indic text improves knowledge and reasoning over a public-corpus baseline. Additional experiments show how data volume, script coverage, and Indic training share affect English performance. We also introduce the Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite, a multilingual benchmark suite for evaluating Indic language models across chat, instruction following, reasoning, knowledge, code, and translation. The suite combines existing Indic benchmarks with task-aware translations of English benchmarks, using automated quality assessment, targeted correction, and native-speaker review in a human-in-the-loop pipeline. We use the suite to comprehensively benchmark contemporary open-weight Indic and multilingual models across capabilities and languages, revealing substantial variation across tasks and languages. Together, these resources provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating more capable Indic language models.
articles.comment: 44 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and references
articles.titleCn: 为印地语大型语言模型进行合成预训练数据的扩展和评估
articles.abstractCn: 为印度构建强大的语言模型需要可扩展的多语言数据和稳健的评估。我们介绍了Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1，这是一个包含约2.83万亿个token的合成预训练语料库，涵盖了印度全部22种法定语言的原生文字和12种罗马化形式。这是目前最大公开发布的印度语预训练语料库。通过我们的GPU加速流程，我们翻译精选的英文文档，评估翻译质量，并修复低质量输出，同时保留技术内容和文档结构，并确保源可追溯性。通过在12种语言上进行的持续预训练实验，我们证明将我们的合成语料库与自然印度语文本结合，在知识推理方面优于公共语料库基准。额外的实验展示了数据量、文字覆盖范围和印度语训练比例对英语性能的影响。我们还介绍了Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite，这是一个用于评估印度语言模型在聊天、指令遵循、推理、知识、代码和翻译等方面的多语言基准套件。该套件结合了现有的印度语基准和针对任务的英文基准翻译，采用自动化质量评估、目标修正和人工审核的人机交互流程。我们使用该套件对当代开放权重的印度语和多语言模型进行全面基准测试，揭示了不同任务和语言之间的显著差异。这些资源共同为开发和评估更强大的印度语言模型提供了可扩展的基础。

articles.title: TempoMoE: Identifying and Steering Fast-Slow Thinking Experts for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) for complex tasks, yet often overthink easy inputs, increasing token cost and latency, and sometimes degrading accuracy. Existing methods optimize reasoning length during training or impose external control at inference, but leave the underlying reasoning mechanism a black box. We find that fast and slow thinking exhibit distinct expert-routing patterns: holding the input fixed and varying only the prompted reasoning tempo produces stable routing shifts. Suppressing slow-thinking experts shortens the reasoning chain, whereas suppressing fast-thinking experts lengthens it, providing causal evidence that these experts influence reasoning depth. Based on this finding, we propose TempoMoE, a training-free, two-stage framework. It identifies fast- and slow-thinking experts via tempo-contrastive routing analysis and redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty. It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones, enabling difficulty-adaptive control over reasoning depth. We evaluate TempoMoE on Kimi-VL, Qwen3-VL, and ERNIE-4.5-VL across six benchmarks. Compared with Vanilla, TempoMoE consistently improves accuracy while reducing output tokens, with accuracy gains of up to 2.6 points and token reductions of up to 35.4%.
articles.titleCn: TempoMoE：识别与引导快慢思维专家以实现高效多模态推理
articles.abstractCn: 多模态专家混合（MoE）推理模型依赖于长链式思维（CoT）来处理复杂任务，但往往对简单输入过度思考，增加了token成本和延迟，有时还会降低准确性。现有方法在训练过程中优化推理长度或在推理时施加外部控制，但将底层的推理机制作为一个黑盒。我们发现快速思考和慢速思考表现出不同的专家路由模式：固定输入并仅改变提示推理节奏会产生稳定的路由变化。抑制慢速思考的专家会缩短推理链，而抑制快速思考的专家则会延长推理链，提供了因果证据表明这些专家影响了推理深度。基于这一发现，我们提出了TempoMoE，一个无需训练的两阶段框架。它通过节奏对比路由分析识别快速思考和慢速思考的专家，并根据样本难度在原始top-k集中重新分配路由权重。它在简单输入上增强快速思考的专家并抑制慢速思考的专家，而在困难输入上则相反调整，从而实现对推理深度的难度自适应控制。我们在Kimi-VL、Qwen3-VL和ERNIE-4.5-VL上对TempoMoE进行了评估，涵盖六个基准测试。与Vanilla相比，TempoMoE始终在提高准确性的同时减少输出token，准确率提升最高达2.6个百分点，token减少最高达35.4%。

articles.title: Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.
articles.titleCn: 基于正确性的非对称目标分布用于自蒸馏策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 自蒸馏策略优化通过反馈驱动的自教师为LLM的后续训练提供密集的token级监督。然而，直接匹配自教师可能会在正确执行时破坏成功行为，同时在错误执行时提供不足的纠正。我们提出了通过自蒸馏的自对称策略优化（APSD），该方法通过混合学生和自教师分布来构建与正确性相关的目标：插值保留了正确执行时的成功行为，而超出自教师的插值则增强了错误执行时的纠正。我们通过散度分解、反向KL巴氏几何和梯度分析来分析APSD，突出了通过学生相关目标进行梯度流动的重要性。在具有可验证奖励和丰富反馈的强化学习实验中，APSD在强化学习和自蒸馏基线方面实现了优异的整体性能，并且在Qwen3模型规模上平均减少了2.6倍的训练步数，与SDPO性能相当。

articles.title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.
articles.titleCn: 基于几何的在线行为早期退出方法：通过单位球轨迹
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）推理能够提升问题解决能力，但模型常常在正确答案已可达时仍持续生成；这些额外步骤会增加服务成本，并可能用错误的结果替换正确的中途结果。我们提出了GLOBE（基于几何引导的在线行为早期退出）算法，这是一种在线、无需训练的算法，可提前终止模型的CoT过程。GLOBE将每个完成的推理片段嵌入为单位球上的一个点，并读取由此产生的语义轨迹的形状。GLOBE首先应用一个试验阶段，在单独的分支中生成短试验答案，在检查置信度是否达到阈值后，停止主流程。如果生成继续，轨迹阶段会在该路径反复反转方向且几乎没有净进展时停止流。在包括数学推理、工具调用和代理记忆在内的五个基准测试中，GLOBE使两个模型的输出token减少了49.7%，主动端到端墙时间（E2E）减少了51.0%，并在五个任务上达到了80.58%的平均分，与完整CoT相当。

articles.title: Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation
articles.abstract: We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.
articles.comment: NeurIPS 2026 VLM4RWD Workshop. 21 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/Kesav2k04/ugaa-research
articles.titleCn: 基于Token集选择的混淆因素：对VLM幻觉评估中是/否提取的系统审计
articles.abstractCn: 我们旨在在POPE基准上复现最近一项缓解幻觉的结果。我们测量的LLaVA-1.5-7B基线在对抗性划分上达到了82.21的F1值，比我们计划对比的对抗性基线（81.00、79.30和73.54）高出1.21至8.67个百分点。我们检查了评估代码，发现一个读出选择会单独影响F1值。一个两词元的logit读出通过比较两个词汇ID（3582代表"yes"，1217代表"no"）来决定"是"或"否"。在涵盖所有三个划分的9,000个贪婪解码问题中，这两个ID均未生成一次。模型输出"Yes"（词元3869）和"No"（词元1939），因为SentencePiece在提示后缀"ASSISTANT:"后添加了一个空格字节。使用一个包含空格前缀表面形式的八词元查找，LLaVA-1.5-7B在对抗性、流行性和随机划分上的F1得分分别为0.8221、0.8498和0.8713。对抗性提升的6.13个百分点超过了我们调查的六篇论文中五篇报告的对抗性增益。它们均未说明其读出方式，且我们的参考模型在4位NF4量化下运行，因此无法说明匹配评估会保留多少报告增益。这一比较在读出和精度匹配前仍悬而未决。在固定基线上，我们运行了九个推理时校正（均未超越基线），并分析了对抗性划分为何抗拒logit级干预。在一个包含3,000个问题的探测中，错误预测比正确预测吸引更多图像注意力（Cohen's $d=-0.46$，$p=1.4\times10^{-24}$），这与基于 grounding 的校正假设相反。对另外四个来自三个分词器家族的VLM进行的四读出审计证实，这种混杂效应是协议级别的，而非模型特定的：直接移植LLaVA-1.5 ID会导致两个词汇集分离模型的F1降至0.00，而分词器派生的读出则在0.80至0.92之间保持稳定。

articles.title: How to get the best and fairest performance out of your ASR system using activation steering
articles.abstract: Activation steering for ASR systems is an underexplored technique in improving both ASR performance and demographic fairness. We investigate two forms of activation steering: paired activation subtraction, and supervised optimization. We find the former to be ineffective at ameliorating ASR performance whatsoever, while the latter is quite effective at deriving steering vectors (SVs) that improve at once overall ASR performance and demographic fairness along such diverse axes as gender, age, and dialect. We also explore what types of data---from the most to the least personal---are necessary for calculating or training SVs. First, we show significant performance in performance from training SVs using an eclectic group of speakers from the same dataset. Furthermore, we find that vectors trained using acoustically similar speakers leads to ASR performances that are competitive or superior to vectors trained on the same speaker, or speakers from the same labeled demographic group. This finding shows that we can harness activation steering for few-shot adaptation given access to a speaker's demography, or zero-shot adaptation to unseen speakers without the need for any labels at all.
articles.titleCn: 如何通过激活引导获得 ASR 系统的最佳和最公平性能
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导是提升语音识别（ASR）系统性能和群体公平性的一个尚未充分探索的技术。我们研究了两种形式的激活引导：配对激活相减和监督优化。我们发现前者在改善ASR性能方面完全无效，而后者在引导向量（SVs）的生成上非常有效，这些向量能同时提升整体ASR性能和群体公平性，例如在性别、年龄和方言等多样化维度上。我们还探讨了计算或训练SVs所需的数据类型——从最个人化到最不个人化——的必要性。首先，我们展示了使用同一数据集中多样化说话人群体训练SVs时显著提升性能的效果。此外，我们发现使用声学相似说话人训练的向量，其ASR性能与使用同一说话人或同一标记群体说话人训练的向量相比具有竞争力或更优。这一发现表明，在已知说话人群体特征的情况下，我们可以利用激活引导进行少样本自适应；或者在无需任何标签的情况下，对未见过的新说话人进行零样本自适应。

articles.title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.
articles.titleCn: AdaExploreBench：评估在动态环境中进行主动探索和测试时适应的LLM代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地部署在陌生且不断变化的环境中，要求它们主动探索、理解并适应环境动态。然而，现有的基准很少测试代理是否能主动发现环境的工作原理并随着其演变进行适应。为填补这一空白，我们引入了AdaExploreBench，这是一个用于在动态变化环境中进行主动探索和测试时适应的基准。通过将环境动态实例化为隐藏规则，AdaExploreBench要求代理主动获取证据并推断规则。在隐式规则漂移下，潜在规则发生变化而不宣布，要求代理从性能退化中检测到先前知识已过时并重新探索。在八种领先的LLM上的实验表明，主动和适应性探索仍然具有挑战性：GPT-6 Sol仅实现了61.9%的校准准确率，而提供充分证据或消除规则漂移可显著提高平均性能近10%。这些结果表明当前LLM代理存在一个关键瓶颈：它们一旦获得信息丰富的证据就能有效推理，但难以主动获取正确的证据并识别先前获取的证据何时已不再有效。

articles.title: TRACE: Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation for Text-Vision Embedding Models
articles.abstract: Existing benchmarks for text-vision embedding models report aggregate scores that obscure whether performance comes from general capabilities, task-specific adaptation, or robustness to challenging tasks. We introduce TRACE, a Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation framework that reorganizes 168 tasks from various sources of datasets into three categories: General, Adaptability, and Challenge. Through controlled experiments on two text-vision embedding models, we show that combining general and adaptation data improves Adaptability performance by 7.67 and 7.09 points, respectively, while largely preserving General performance. However, Challenge performance remains below 5.0, with limited improvements from additional training data. Further analysis identifies multilingual and visual-document tasks as major weaknesses. Our findings demonstrate that data adaptation alone is insufficient to address these challenges, highlighting the need for methodological advances beyond data-centric improvements.
articles.titleCn: 感知训练感知的鲁棒性和挑战评估
articles.abstractCn: 现有的文本-视觉嵌入模型的基准测试报告了综合评分，这些评分掩盖了性能提升是由于通用能力、特定任务适应还是对挑战性任务的鲁棒性。我们引入了TRACE（Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation）框架，该框架将来自不同数据集源的168项任务重新组织为三类：通用、适应性和挑战性。通过对两个文本-视觉嵌入模型进行受控实验，我们表明，结合通用和适应数据分别将适应性性能提升了7.67和7.09分，同时基本保持了通用性能。然而，挑战性性能仍低于5.0，且通过增加训练数据获得的改进有限。进一步分析发现，多语言和视觉文档任务是主要弱点。我们的研究结果表明，仅靠数据适应不足以解决这些挑战，凸显了需要超越数据中心改进的方法论进步。

articles.title: Speech LLMs That Breathe: Modeling Non-Verbal Vocalizations in Dialogue
articles.abstract: The user experience of speech interaction models has improved, benefiting from the modeling of paralinguistic attributes and advances in speech reconstruction paradigms. However, human communication follows extensive norms regarding non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) spanning respiratory, affective, and discourse. The omission of these events imposes inherent limitations on the naturalness of current approaches. In this work, we cover 13 major types of NVVs and construct a natural dialogue dataset that conforms to human conversational norms through an automated synthesis pipeline. We enhance the ability of speech interaction models to generate contextually appropriate NVV events through multi-stage fine-tuning and NVV-aware GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization). Based on distinct modeling paradigms, we substantially improve the expressiveness of VocalNet and VITA-Qinyu in empathy interactions and role-play dialogues, and further discuss the architectural necessity for achieving high-quality natural speech generation.
articles.titleCn: 会呼吸的对话式语言模型：对非言语发声进行建模
articles.abstractCn: 语音交互模型的使用体验得到了提升，这得益于对副语言属性建模以及语音重建范式的进步。然而，人类交流遵循着广泛的非言语发声（NVV）规范，涵盖呼吸、情感和话语等方面。这些事件的缺失对当前方法的自然性构成了固有局限。在这项工作中，我们涵盖了13种主要的NVV类型，并通过自动化合成流程构建了一个符合人类对话规范的自然对话数据集。我们通过多阶段微调和NVV感知的GRPO（组相对策略优化）增强了语音交互模型生成情境适宜的NVV事件的能力。基于不同的建模范式，我们在共情交互和角色扮演对话中显著提升了VocalNet和VITA-Qinyu的表达能力，并进一步探讨了实现高质量自然语音生成所需的架构必要性。

articles.title: MITRA-lexicon: Lexica of attested translations from Sanskrit into English, Tibetan and Chinese
articles.abstract: The standard Sanskrit lexica are monumental and indispensable, but they cite their attestations as abbreviated references to editions, without links to the digitized texts now widely available and without a translation of the passage, and they naturally do not reflect translations made after them. To address these gaps, we present MITRA-lexicon, a family of corpus-grounded lexica based on span annotations of translation equivalents with Sanskrit as the pivot: Sanskrit-English, derived from the Mitrasamgraha corpus, as well as Sanskrit-Tibetan and Sanskrit-Chinese, derived from the MITRA-parallel corpus of Buddhist literature. In total, the resource comprises 2.18 million headword entries in six directional lexica. Headwords are lemmas and compounds from silver annotations that follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS). Senses are ranked by frequency, and each of the 10.4 million attestations includes its sentence pair, with character offsets of the word and its equivalent. We propose a multi-step pipeline based on grammatical annotation models, fine-tuned large language models, and a teacher-student setup to produce the alignments. We evaluate the lexica against reference dictionaries and manually corrected gold alignments. We release the lexica and the fine-tuned span annotation model, together with a web interface for looking up headwords and their attested senses.
articles.titleCn: MITRA-lexicon：已证实从梵语翻译成英语、藏语和汉语的词汇库
articles.abstractCn: 标准的梵语词典是 monumental 和 indispensable 的，但它们将它们的使用证据作为对版本的缩略参考来引用，而没有链接到现在广泛可用的数字化文本，也没有提供段落的翻译，而且它们自然不会反映它们之后的翻译。为了解决这些差距，我们提出了 MITRA-lexicon，这是一个基于翻译等价物的跨度标注、以梵语为枢纽的语料库词典系列：梵语-英语，源自 Mitrasamgraha 语料库，以及梵语-藏语和梵语-中文，源自佛教文献的 MITRA-平行语料库。总共，该资源包含六个方向词典中的 2.18 万词条。词条是遵循梵语数字语料库（DCS）的银标注中的词干和复合词。意义按频率排序，每个 10.4 万条使用证据都包括其句子对，以及单词及其等价物的字符偏移。我们提出了一种基于语法标注模型、微调大型语言模型和师生设置的多步骤管道来生成对齐。我们使用参考词典和人工校正的金标准对齐来评估词典。我们发布了词典和微调的跨度标注模型，并提供了一个用于查找词条及其使用证据意义的网络界面。

articles.title: Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding
articles.abstract: Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.
articles.titleCn: 保持谱系延续：用于扩散式LLM解码的多样性保护SMC
articles.abstractCn: 推理时序蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码无需后训练即可通过根据奖励对部分生成群体的重采样来提高掩码扩散语言模型（diffusion LLMs）的推理准确率。因此，其有效性取决于重采样步骤，该步骤必须将计算集中于有潜力的候选者，同时保留足够的多样性以探索替代的推理路径。奖励可以是内部的，即解码器对自己已确定前缀的置信度，也可以是外部的，即一个过程奖励模型对前缀进行评分。在任一奖励下，多项式重采样都可能通过复制高权重粒子并丢弃可能仍能找到正确解的谱系来破坏这种平衡。有效样本量（ESS）并未记录这种损失：多项式重采样即使不同谱系消失时，也会将其重置为其最大值。为保留此类谱系，我们引入了谱系保留SMC（LP-SMC），它结合了Chopthin重采样和输入权重下限。Chopthin不是均衡权重，而是限制其返回的最大权重与最小权重的比率，并将不等的权重传递下去。下限限制了重采样前权重低于最大值的程度，以便早期权重较低的谱系有机会恢复。在两个基础模型上的数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，LP-SMC在所有设置中都将预言覆盖率（至少有一个正确粒子的题目比例）提高了1.8到25.6个百分点，并在常见的奖励模型选择器下，在十二个设置中的十一个设置中提高了端到端准确率，在LLaDA-1.5上提高了高达7.9个百分点，在Dream-7B上提高了18.3个百分点。覆盖率提升在外部奖励模型下仍然存在，这表明多样性保留重采样和引导信号分别对推理时搜索做出了贡献。

articles.title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
articles.abstract: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch. We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. With fine-grained ground truth, EvoSkill v2's skills raised the held-out pass rate above the stronger of SkillOpt and SkillBoost by 7.7 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and by 5.4 on $τ^3$-bench banking. In both benchmarks and both feedback settings, EvoSkill v2's evolver cost less per percentage point of held-out pass rate gained than either baseline's optimizer. EvoSkill v2 also enables a less capable model to improve its own skills, demonstrated by a gain of up to 21.5 percentage points in the $τ^3$-bench banking experiment where Claude Haiku 5.5 powers both solver and evolver.
articles.titleCn: EvoSkill v2：从基准适应到状态化进化器，实现完全自主技能进化
articles.abstractCn: EvoSkill v2 是一个三智能体系统，它编辑智能体所接收的指令（技能），同时保持其模型和适配器不变。用户通过描述基准测试并提供评分器来启动运行，基准适配器将评分器转换为特定于基准的插件。求解器尝试执行任务，进化器读取求解器的训练轨迹，并在每个纪元重新编写技能。我们将进化器实现为一个具有状态编码智能体，并使用 bash 工具进行整个运行，这与我们调查的技能优化器中最常见的两种设计不同：SkillOpt 中的单个模型调用序列，以及 SkillBoost 中每轮重新开始的智能体。我们还测量了求解器轨迹在不同尝试之间的变化程度，为进化器在每个训练任务中提供多次尝试，并接受每个纪元的技能，而不是在嘈杂的评分中选择它们。在 SpreadsheetBench v2 上，EvoSkill v2 的技能使保留通过率提高了 7.7 个百分点，超过了 SkillOpt 和 SkillBoost 中较强的那个；在 $τ^3$-bench banking 上提高了 5.4 个百分点。在两个基准测试和两种反馈设置中，EvoSkill v2 的进化器每提高一个百分点的保留通过率所花费的成本都低于基线的优化器。EvoSkill v2 还使较弱的模型能够改进自身的技能，这在 Claude Haiku 5.5 同时为求解器和进化器提供动力的 $τ^3$-bench banking 实验中证明了，该实验中技能提升了高达 21.5 个百分点。

articles.title: LEAPS: Long-context Evaluation of Adaptive Pattern Learning and State Tracking
articles.abstract: Long-context language models (LCLMs) power agents that act over long trajectories, from improving a codebase to running research experiments to forecasters that condition on lengthy histories. These applications draw on three distinct long-context capabilities: recall, where the answer is a fact present in the context; state tracking, where the outcome can be computed by performing a series of transformations to a specified state; and pattern learning, where the goal is to make a prediction by sampling from a distribution inferred from many observations. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on the first capability. In this work, we introduce LEAPS (Long-context Evaluation of Adaptive Pattern learning and State tracking), a collection of 12 novel datasets, spanning agentic workflows, behavioral modeling, and forecasting of market and world events. By construction, LEAPS is resistant to data contamination, extends to millions of input tokens, and uses reliable metrics. We evaluate 30 API and open models from 8K to 512K input tokens. LEAPS distinguishes models that perform near perfectly on recall tasks, finding that such models' state tracking and pattern learning abilities can vary significantly and degrade much more dramatically with increasing input lengths--even for pattern learning, where more observations should make learning a theoretically easier task. Moreover, thinking models often underperform their base counterparts, exhausting their generation budget or oversimplifying the task. We hope LEAPS can guide the development of the next generation of LCLMs.
articles.comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/howard-yen/LEAPS
articles.titleCn: LEAPS：长上下文自适应模式学习和状态跟踪评估
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文语言模型（LCLMs）赋能在长时轨迹中行动的智能体，从改进代码库到运行研究实验，再到基于长时间历史的预测器。这些应用依赖于三种不同的长上下文能力：回忆，其中答案是一个存在于上下文中的事实；状态跟踪，其中结果可以通过对指定状态执行一系列转换来计算；以及模式学习，其目标是通过从根据多次观察推断出的分布中进行采样来做出预测。现有基准主要关注第一种能力。在这项工作中，我们引入了LEAPS（长上下文自适应模式学习和状态跟踪评估），这是一个包含12个新数据集的集合，涵盖了智能体工作流程、行为建模以及市场和世界事件的预测。根据设计，LEAPS能够抵抗数据污染，扩展到数百万个输入标记，并使用可靠的指标。我们评估了30个API和开源模型，输入标记从8K到512K不等。LEAPS区分了在回忆任务上表现近乎完美的模型，发现这类模型的状态跟踪和模式学习能力差异很大，并且随着输入长度的增加而退化得更加剧烈——即使对于模式学习来说，更多的观察应该使学习在理论上成为一个更容易的任务。此外，思考模型通常表现不如其基础模型，要么耗尽其生成预算，要么过度简化任务。我们希望LEAPS能够指导下一代LCLM的发展。

articles.title: FisherEdit: Fisher Information Guided Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Sequential knowledge editing in Large Language Models (LLMs) often leads to a degradation of general capabilities due to cumulative parameter interference. In this paper, we revisit prominent projection-based methods like AlphaEdit and reveal a surprising mismatch: their robustness is primarily driven by update regularization rather than the intended null-space projection. Based on this insight, we propose FisherEdit, a theoretically grounded method built on Fisher geometry, which replaces coarse activation-space projections with importance-aware regularization in parameter space. It penalizes changes to sensitive parameters more strongly while retaining flexibility for new facts, and admits an efficient row-wise closed-form solution. Experiments on Llama-3, Qwen2.5, and Olmo-3 across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FisherEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance while better preserving model stability and downstream task accuracy.
articles.titleCn: FisherEdit：基于Fisher信息引导知识编辑的大语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）中的顺序知识编辑通常由于累积参数干扰导致泛化能力下降。在本文中，我们重新审视了AlphaEdit等著名的基于投影的方法，并揭示了一个令人惊讶的矛盾：它们的鲁棒性主要是由更新正则化驱动的，而非预期的零空间投影。基于这一见解，我们提出了基于Fisher几何理论的FisherEdit方法，该方法用参数空间中的重要性感知正则化替代了粗糙的激活空间投影。它对敏感参数的变化施加更强的惩罚，同时保留了对新事实的灵活性，并允许一个高效的按行闭式解。在Llama-3、Qwen2.5和Olmo-3等多个基准测试上的实验表明，FisherEdit在保持模型稳定性和下游任务准确性的同时，实现了最先进的性能。

articles.title: CALM: Consistency-Aware Logit Masking in Decoding Space for Mitigating Overthinking of Large Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance on challenging mathematical and scientific tasks through long chain-of-thought reasoning, but they often suffer from overthinking with unnecessary reasoning steps. Existing truncation-based methods typically detect consecutive trial-answer agreement and force early exit, yet such local stopping signals do not necessarily indicate final-answer stability and can disrupt useful subsequent reflection or verification, potentially leading to performance degradation. We propose consistency-aware logit masking (CALM), a training-free decoding intervention for mitigating overthinking in LRMs. CALM first monitors trial answers at step boundaries and then applies logit masking to action transition point (ATP) tokens such as "Wait", "Alternatively", and "Hmm", suppressing redundant transitional reasoning while allowing the model to continue its thought process more naturally. Experiments across four advanced LRMs and five benchmarks show that CALM reduces token consumption by 18.6%-25.0% compared with full CoT reasoning while maintaining performance, and can even improve accuracy by 0.07%-1.48% by reducing redundant reasoning. LLM-as-a-Judge results also demonstrate that CALM provides more coherent and concise results.
articles.titleCn: CALM：解码空间中的一致性感知逻辑掩码，用于缓解大型推理模型的过度思考
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过长链式思维推理，在具有挑战性的数学和科学任务上取得了优异表现，但它们常常因不必要的推理步骤而陷入过度思考。现有的基于截断的方法通常检测连续的尝试答案一致性并强制提前退出，然而这种局部停止信号并不一定表明最终答案的稳定性，并可能破坏后续有用的反思或验证，从而可能导致性能下降。我们提出了感知一致性的逻辑掩码（CALM），这是一种无需训练的解码干预措施，用于缓解LRMs中的过度思考。CALM首先在步骤边界监控尝试答案，然后对动作转换点（ATP）标记（如"Wait"、"Alternatively"和"Hmm"）应用逻辑掩码，抑制冗余的过渡推理，同时允许模型更自然地继续其思维过程。在四个先进的LRMs和五个基准测试上的实验表明，与完整的CoT推理相比，CALM将标记消耗降低了18.6%-25.0%，同时保持了性能，甚至通过减少冗余推理将准确率提高了0.07%-1.48%。LLM作为判官的结果也表明，CALM提供了更连贯和简洁的结果。

articles.title: SWE-Residual: Evaluating Starting-State Robustness of Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Software engineering (SWE) benchmarks are the primary way to measure the capabilities of coding agents: an agent is placed in a code repository or machine environment, given a request, and judged by hidden tests. These benchmarks almost always start the agent from a clean state that contains no earlier work on the task. In practice, however, agents often continue work that a developer or another agent has already done and reported as complete, with no indication of what remains incorrect or missing. We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness: the ability to maintain performance on a task when the starting state already contains earlier work on that task. SWE-Residual contains 198 Residual States drawn from 111 tasks in DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench, where the earlier work modifies a code repository or a whole machine environment. Each Residual State is the state a predecessor agent left behind after submitting its work as complete, although the hidden tests still fail. The evaluated agent receives only the original request and this state, without the predecessor's trajectory or any sign that the attempt failed; because the request and hidden tests are unchanged, the starting state is the only difference from the source benchmark. Across five frontier agents, success drops by 20.6--53.5 percentage points on DeepSWE and 20.6--34.9 points on Terminal-Bench relative to a Clean Start, and agent rankings on DeepSWE reverse. Failed continuations show a pattern we call acceptance bias: agents treat the inherited work as the definition of what remains to be done instead of checking it against the request. On DeepSWE, in 58.9--88.2% of failed runs, they submit with exactly the same tests failing, although they pass most of these tests from a Clean Start. SWE-Residual thus exposes a capability gap that clean-start evaluation does not capture.
articles.titleCn: SWE-Residual：评估编码代理的起始状态鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 软件工程（SWE）基准测试是衡量编码代理能力的主要方法：将代理置于代码库或机器环境中，给出一个请求，并通过隐藏测试进行评判。这些基准测试几乎总是从干净的状态开始，该状态不包含先前任务的任何工作。然而在实践中，代理经常继续开发者或其他代理已经完成并报告为完成的任务，而没有任何关于剩余错误或缺失内容的指示。我们介绍了SWE-Residual，这是一个用于起始状态鲁棒性的基准测试：当起始状态已经包含先前任务的工作时，代理保持任务性能的能力。SWE-Residual包含从DeepSWE和Terminal-Bench中的111个任务中抽取的198个残差状态，其中先前的工作修改了代码库或整个机器环境。每个残差状态是前一个代理提交其工作为完成后留下的状态，尽管隐藏测试仍然失败。被评估的代理只收到原始请求和这个状态，而没有前一个代理的轨迹或任何关于尝试失败的迹象；由于请求和隐藏测试保持不变，起始状态是相对于源基准测试的唯一差异。在五个前沿代理中，与干净启动相比，DeepSWE上的成功率下降了20.6--53.5个百分点，Terminal-Bench上下降了20.6--34.9点，DeepSWE上的代理排名也发生了逆转。失败的继续显示出一种我们称为接受偏见的模式：代理将继承的工作视为剩余待做工作的定义，而不是将其与请求进行核对。在DeepSWE中，在58.9--88.2%的失败运行中，他们提交的测试与干净启动时完全相同的测试失败，尽管他们从干净启动时通过了这些测试。因此，SWE-Residual揭示了一个干净启动评估未能捕捉的能力差距。

articles.title: Budgeted Attack Scheduling for LLM Red-Teaming: The Roles of Static Priors, Semantic Guidance, and Online Feedback
articles.abstract: As jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) become increasingly diverse, red-teaming has come to rely on large libraries of jailbreak prompts and attack strategies to evaluate the robustness of victim models and their defense settings. However, attack effectiveness is highly condition-dependent: an attack that succeeds under one victim-defense setting may fail under another, while exhaustively evaluating the full attack library for each setting incurs substantial token and monetary costs. This motivates studying how jailbreak attacks should be prioritized under a limited attempt budget for efficient robustness evaluation. In this work, we formalize this problem as budgeted attack scheduling over a fixed attack library and investigate three complementary signals under a fixed victim-defense condition: (1) static historical attack success rate (ASR) priors; (2) semantic guidance from LLMs; and (3) online feedback from earlier queries. Building on these signals, we design four scheduling strategies and evaluate them across three victim models and three defense settings on GPT-5.2. Extensive experiments clearly characterize the conditions under which each signal is most effective. Historical ASR provides a strong initialization, but its reliability degrades under defense-induced distribution shifts. Semantic guidance consistently improves or matches static prior-based scheduling in the cold-start regime, while online feedback becomes particularly valuable when transferred priors become stale. Semantic guidance and online feedback can also partially compensate for missing historical priors. Taken together, these findings characterize budgeted red-teaming as an attack scheduling problem in which historical priors, semantic guidance, and online feedback play complementary roles.
articles.titleCn: 面向大型语言模型红队演练的预算攻击调度：静态先验、语义引导和在线反馈的作用
articles.abstractCn: 随着针对大型语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击变得越来越多样化，红队测试开始依赖大量越狱提示和攻击策略来评估目标模型的鲁棒性和其防御设置。然而，攻击效果高度依赖于具体条件：在一种目标防御设置下成功的攻击可能在另一种设置下失败，而针对每种设置穷尽评估整个攻击库会带来巨大的token和货币成本。这促使我们研究在有限的尝试预算下如何优先级排序越狱攻击以实现高效的鲁棒性评估。在这项工作中，我们将该问题形式化为固定攻击库上的预算攻击调度，并在固定的目标防御条件下研究了三种互补信号：（1）静态历史攻击成功率（ASR）先验；（2）来自LLM的语义指导；（3）早期查询的在线反馈。基于这些信号，我们设计了四种调度策略，并在GPT-5.2上针对三个目标模型和三种防御设置进行评估。大量实验清晰地刻画了每种信号在何种条件下最为有效。历史ASR提供了强大的初始化，但在防御引起的分布偏移下其可靠性会下降。语义指导在冷启动状态下始终改进或匹配基于静态先验的调度，而在线反馈在先验知识过时的情况下变得尤为有价值。语义指导和在线反馈也能部分弥补缺失的历史先验。综合来看，这些发现将预算红队测试刻画为一种攻击调度问题，其中历史先验、语义指导和在线反馈发挥着互补作用。

articles.title: Learning to Reason Efficiently with Interventional Step Credit
articles.abstract: Large reasoning models often produce lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) traces mixing useful intermediate steps with unnecessary ones. Recent methods explore step-level signals such as attention mass and step entropy to identify and suppress unnecessary steps. Despite their effectiveness, such signals reflect the model's behavior at a step rather than that step's contribution to the answer. To address this, we propose the interventional step credit (ISC), which takes a causal-intervention view and assesses step importance to the reasoning through targeted parameter-level interventions. Building on ISC, we further propose IGPO, which uses ISC to guide fine-grained advantage rescaling in reinforcement learning, reducing redundant steps while preserving the important ones. Experiments across two model scales and nine benchmarks show that IGPO achieves up to 62% average token reduction and better overall performance among compared methods.
articles.titleCn: 通过干预步骤信用高效地学习推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型常生成冗长的思维链（CoT）轨迹，其中混合了有用和多余的中间步骤。近期方法探索了步骤级信号，如注意力质量和步骤熵，以识别和抑制多余步骤。尽管这些方法有效，但信号反映的是模型在步骤层面的行为，而非该步骤对答案的贡献。为解决此问题，我们提出了干预步骤信用（ISC），它采用因果干预视角，通过目标参数级干预评估步骤对推理的重要性。基于ISC，我们进一步提出了IGPO，该模型使用ISC指导强化学习中的细粒度优势重缩放，减少冗余步骤的同时保留重要步骤。在两个模型规模和九个基准测试上的实验表明，IGPO在比较方法中实现了高达62%的平均token减少和更好的整体性能。

articles.title: Arabic Financial NLP
articles.abstract: Financial communication connects numerical accounts of economic activity with explanations of performance, responsibility and future expectations. Arabic financial natural language processing offers methods for studying these connections across corporate reports, market disclosures, journalism and banking interactions. Its contribution to digital humanities depends on retaining the relationship between a computational representation and the document from which it was made. This chapter follows that relationship from source collection and Arabic text processing to the analysis of vocabulary, evaluation, entities, causal attribution and multilingual reporting. It then examines what financial summaries and retrieval-grounded answers preserve or lose, and how dialectal intent detection changes the perspective from institutions speaking to institutions listening. Published Arabic resources are discussed in relation to the questions they were designed to answer, with a distinction between financial pretraining corpora, annotated datasets and evaluation benchmarks. A running constructed example connects the methodological discussion without presenting illustrative analysis as empirical findings. The chapter argues for an account of Arabic financial NLP in which linguistic context, documentary provenance and interpretive judgement remain part of the evidence throughout the analytical process.
articles.titleCn: 阿拉伯金融自然语言处理
articles.abstractCn: 金融沟通将经济活动的数字记录与绩效、责任和未来预期解释相连接。阿拉伯金融自然语言处理提供了研究这些联系的方法，这些联系贯穿于企业报告、市场披露、新闻和银行互动中。其对数字人文的贡献取决于保持计算表示与原始文档之间的关系。本章从源收集和阿拉伯文本处理开始，遵循这种关系，直到词汇分析、评估、实体识别、因果归因和多语种报告分析。接着，本章探讨了金融摘要和基于检索的答案保留或丢失的内容，以及方言意图检测如何改变机构间对话的视角。本章讨论了已发布的阿拉伯资源，根据其设计要回答的问题进行了区分，包括金融预训练语料库、标注数据集和评估基准。一个持续构建的示例连接了方法论讨论，但并未将说明性分析作为实证结果呈现。本章主张，在分析过程中，语言环境、文献来源和解释性判断应始终作为证据的一部分，以构建阿拉伯金融自然语言处理的框架。

articles.title: Measurement Validity and Representation Dynamics of Confidence Signals in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Whether a language model "knows what it knows" matters for trustworthy deployment and for deciding when it should abstain. Prior work usually measures this through one channel: verbalized confidence, a linear probe on hidden states, or agreement among sampled answers (semantic entropy), and often treats these as interchangeable. We compare all three in a pre-registered audit of five Qwen2.5 models (0.5B-7B, including a base/instruct pair at 7B) on factual retrieval (PopQA, SimpleQA) and multi-step reasoning (GSM8K, MATH). First, probes trained on prefill states to predict whether sampled answers will disagree become informative earlier for retrieval (about 7% of layer depth on average) than for reasoning (about 28%). The pre-registered five-layer test supported this only marginally; a finer 21-layer follow-up, designed after those results, supports it more clearly. In most retrieval cells, however, a prompt-only TF-IDF classifier matches the probe, so the early signal may reflect surface features of the question. Second, verbalized confidence is unstable: slightly different prompt templates yield scores that barely correlate. Third, Expected Calibration Error is misleading: verbal confidence looks well calibrated because it clusters near the base rate while discriminating poorly, whereas sampling agreement has worse ECE but about twice the resolution. Of five pre-registered hypotheses, two were falsified, one was partly supported, one was not supported, and one could not be tested because the base model's verbal confidence was degenerate.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中置信度信号的测量有效性与表征动态
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型是否“知道自己所知道的内容”对于可信赖的部署和决定其应何时保持沉默至关重要。以往的研究通常通过一个渠道来衡量这一点：口头表达的置信度、对隐藏状态的线性探测，或样本答案之间的一致性（语义熵），并且经常将这些视为可互换的。我们在一项预先注册的审计中比较了这三种方法，审计对象包括五个Qwen2.5模型（0.5B-7B，包括7B位的基础/指令对），这些模型在事实检索（PopQA、SimpleQA）和多步推理（GSM8K、MATH）任务上进行了测试。首先，在预填充状态上训练的探测器用于预测样本答案是否会不一致，在检索任务中（平均约7%的层深度）比在推理任务中（平均约28%）更早地变得具有信息量。预先注册的五层测试仅勉强支持这一观点；一个更精细的21层后续测试（在那些结果之后设计），则更清晰地支持了这一点。然而，在大多数检索单元中，仅使用提示的TF-IDF分类器与探测器的表现相匹配，因此早期信号可能反映了问题的表面特征。其次，口头表达的置信度是不稳定的：略微不同的提示模板会产生几乎不相关的分数。第三，预期校准误差具有误导性：口头置信度看起来校准良好，因为它在基准率附近聚集，但区分能力差，而样本答案的一致性具有更差的ECE，但分辨率大约是其两倍。在五个预先注册的假设中，有两个被证伪，一个部分得到支持，一个未得到支持，一个由于基础模型的口头置信度退化而无法测试。

articles.title: Where RL Breaks: Localizing and Repairing Failures via Targeted Continued Pretraining
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in language models, yet growing evidence suggests that it mostly sharpens what the base model can already do. This raises a practical question: when RL fails, what is the base model missing? We look inside the RL policy's own rollouts and find that failures are localized: whether a rollout fails is strongly predicted by a small set of characteristic n-grams, ranging from reflection phrases such as "let's recheck" to specific operations such as "the inverse of A". These failures persist throughout RL training, although they are not beyond the model's reach: other sampled answers to the same question are often correct. Building on this observation, we use the failure $n$-grams to retrieve text from the pretraining corpus and continue pretraining the base model on it before RL. The resulting corpus has only 35M tokens, 3--4 orders of magnitude smaller than typical mid-training. We evaluate this approach on OLMo2 and Qwen3 models trained with RL on (1) GSM8K; (2) a mixture of math, commonsense, and knowledge questions; and (3) general math and science reasoning. Despite its size, the corpus yields consistent gains: our approach outperforms continued pretraining on the same amount of text sampled from the pretraining corpus across 10 out of 11 settings, including by $2.0$ points on GSM8K when inserted before mid-training. The retrieved text also transfers across model families: text retrieved for OLMo2-1B's failures improves Qwen3-4B on the mixture by $1.9$ points over the same baseline. Together, our results suggest that where RL fails is a cheap and effective signal for selecting pretraining data.
articles.titleCn: RL的局限性：通过目标持续预训练定位和修复故障
articles.abstractCn: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被广泛用于提升语言模型的推理能力，但越来越多的证据表明，它主要是在磨砺基础模型已经具备的能力。这引发了一个实际问题：当强化学习失败时，基础模型缺失了什么？我们深入分析了强化学习策略自身的执行过程，发现失败是局部的：一个执行过程是否失败，可以由一小部分特征n-gram强烈预测，这些n-gram范围从反思性短语如“让我们再检查”到特定操作如“A的逆”。这些失败在整个强化学习训练过程中持续存在，尽管它们并不超出模型的范围：对于同一个问题，其他采样的答案通常是正确的。基于这一观察，我们使用失败的n-gram从预训练语料库中检索文本，并在强化学习之前继续在基础模型上进行预训练。最终形成的语料库只有3500万个token，比典型的中训练阶段小3到4个数量级。我们在使用强化学习训练的OLMo2和Qwen3模型上评估了这种方法，分别针对（1）GSM8K；（2）数学、常识和知识问题的混合；（3）通用数学和科学推理。尽管规模较小，该语料库仍带来了持续的提升：我们的方法在11个设置中的10个上优于从预训练语料库中采样相同数量的文本进行的持续预训练，包括在强化学习进行到中段之前插入时，在GSM8K上提升了2.0分。检索到的文本也能跨模型家族迁移：为OLMo2-1B检索的失败文本使Qwen3-4B在混合问题上的表现相对于相同基线提升了1.9分。综合来看，我们的结果表明，强化学习失败的位置是选择预训练数据的廉价且有效的信号。

articles.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend. Two outputs of the same token length can therefore vary a lot in cost. To understand the underlying factors of this cost variation, we analyze two diffusion models across 10 tasks. We find that the number of forward passes per token depends heavily on the task. Text copied or lightly edited from the input is cheap, while open-ended writing is costly. In DiffusionGemma, generating a token for story writing requires more than three times as many forward passes as for grammar correction. Two output properties explain much of this gap: how much of it is new relative to the input, and how rare its words are within the task. The same holds within a single response when thinking is involved. The final answer is cheap when it repeats the model's reasoning trace and costly when it adds something new. In multilingual generation, we find that highly tokenized languages also require more passes per token, adding to the cost they already pay with more tokens. Finally, cost tracks correctness: on the same math problem, wrong answers take more passes per token than correct ones, and weighting candidate answers by decoding speed beats majority voting by up to 4.2 points at no extra cost. Taken together, our results show that diffusion's computational advantage depends on how much of the output is already determined, while its decoding effort offers a practical signal for making inference more efficient and reliable.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型在不同任务和语言中的速度变化
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型可以在一次前向传递中生成多个token，并在生成过程中决定需要多少次传递。因此，相同长度的两个输出在成本上可能差异很大。为了理解这种成本差异的潜在因素，我们对两个扩散模型在10个任务上进行了分析。我们发现，每个token的前向传递次数很大程度上取决于任务。从输入中复制或轻微编辑的文本成本较低，而开放式写作成本较高。在DiffusionGemma中，生成故事写作的token需要比语法纠错多出三倍以上的前向传递次数。两个输出属性解释了大部分这种差距：相对于输入的新内容比例，以及其在任务中的词语稀有度。在涉及思考的单个响应中，情况也是如此。当最终答案重复模型的推理轨迹时，成本较低；而当它添加新内容时，成本较高。在多语言生成中，我们发现高度分词的语言同样需要更多的token传递次数，增加了它们已经支付的更多token的成本。最后，成本与正确性相关：在相同的数学问题中，错误答案比正确答案需要更多的token传递次数，并且通过根据解码速度对候选答案进行加权，可以在不增加额外成本的情况下，比多数投票高出4.2个百分点。综合来看，我们的结果表明，扩散的计算优势取决于输出中有多少内容已经确定，而其解码工作为提高推理效率和可靠性提供了实用信号。

articles.title: When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. After a relevant skill has been selected, the model may need to apply its governing procedure together with retrieved task context. When the retrieved context is useful but contains cues that violate the skill, the model must retain compatible information while rejecting the conflicting cues. We study failures in which the model adopts such cues and produces a retrieval-supported but skill-invalid answer, which we call procedural hallucination. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.
articles.titleCn: 当检索部分与技能冲突时：理解语言模型中的程序性幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地使用能够提供可重用指令和执行步骤的技能。在选定相关技能后，模型可能需要结合检索到的任务上下文来应用其控制程序。当检索到的上下文虽然有用但包含违反技能的线索时，模型必须保留兼容信息，同时拒绝冲突的线索。我们研究模型采用此类线索并产生检索支持但技能无效的答案的情况，称之为程序性幻觉。我们引入了SourceClash，这是一个包含1271个组合和6355个提示的匹配基准，涵盖十个程序性领域。每个组合固定任务、技能规范和答案空间，同时变化技能与检索之间的关系。在九个模型中，冲突检索下的有效答案率平均为25.7%，而两种支持性检索设置下分别为78.2%和72.8%。对开放权重模型的分析表明，答案偏好差异通常在生成开始后不久达到最大。残差替换使模型更接近有效答案，而注意力分解将大部分修复归因于值向量。在识别的值路径上进行干预也能提高最终答案的有效性。这些结果描述了部分冲突检索如何改变技能引导的生成过程。

articles.title: Modal Sense Disambiguation in Language Models: The Role of Context, Training Domain, and Input Frequency
articles.abstract: Modals such as may and must can take on different senses depending on discourse context, alternating between root interpretations (e.g., permission, obligation) and epistemic interpretations (e.g., knowledge, belief). While modals are known to be notoriously difficult for children to acquire, limited research exists on whether language models (LMs) can reliably distinguish between different modal senses. We evaluate seven LMs that vary in architecture, size, and training data type using vector-based similarity and surprisal measures across four datasets. Specifically, we investigate whether LMs can leverage contextual information to disambiguate modal senses and whether their performance reflects the distribution of modal senses in their training data. We show that larger LMs trained on diverse text successfully leverage additional contextual information when available. In the absence of context, they tend to favor the dominant sense based on corpus statistics. Smaller developmentally plausible LMs, including those trained on child-directed language (CDL), fail to show consistent sensitivity to modal sense distinctions and do not benefit from context to the same degree.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中的模态语义消歧：上下文、训练领域和输入频率的作用
articles.abstractCn: 情态词如may和must根据语篇语境可以具有不同的含义，在基本解释（例如，许可、义务）和认知解释（例如，知识、信念）之间交替。虽然情态词被认为是儿童习得过程中极具挑战性的部分，但关于语言模型（LMs）是否能够可靠地区分不同情态词含义的研究却十分有限。我们使用基于向量的相似性和意外性度量，在四个数据集上评估了七个在架构、规模和训练数据类型上各异的LMs。具体而言，我们探究了LMs是否能够利用上下文信息消除情态词含义的歧义，以及它们的性能是否反映了其训练数据中情态词含义的分布。我们发现，在训练数据多样化的较大LMs在存在额外上下文信息时能够成功利用这些信息。在没有上下文的情况下，它们倾向于根据语料库统计数据选择主导含义。而规模较小且在发展上更合理的LMs，包括那些在儿童导向语言（CDL）上训练的模型，未能表现出对情态词含义差异的持续敏感性，并且它们从上下文中的获益程度也较低。

articles.title: Think Before You Transcribe: Context-Steered Reasoning for Hotword-Aware Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: Contextual automatic speech recognition (ASR) improves rare-entity recognition by supplying candidate hotwords, but retrieved candidates may be incomplete or incorrect. A reliable system must therefore exploit a relevant candidate without allowing unsupported alternatives to override the acoustic evidence. We propose a context-steered reasoning framework that generates a short, audio-grounded caption before transcription. This task-specific representation lets the model assess candidate relevance before making a lexical decision. Supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured caption-to-transcription behavior, while targeted trajectory injection strengthens group relative policy optimization when difficult utterances yield only unsuccessful rollouts. Experiments across diverse context conditions show that the proposed method consistently improves both transcription quality and hotword recognition while remaining robust to irrelevant candidates.
articles.titleCn: 在转录前思考：面向唤醒词感知语音识别的上下文引导推理
articles.abstractCn: 上下文自动语音识别（ASR）通过提供候选热词来提升罕见实体识别能力，但检索到的候选可能不完整或错误。因此，一个可靠的系统必须在避免不支持替代项覆盖声学证据的前提下利用相关候选。我们提出了一种上下文引导推理框架，在转录前生成一个基于音频的简短描述。这种特定任务的表示使模型能够在进行词汇决策前评估候选的相关性。监督微调建立了结构化的描述到转录行为，而目标轨迹注入则强化了当困难语音仅产生不成功的回滚时，群体相对策略优化。跨多种上下文条件的实验表明，该方法始终能提升转录质量和热词识别能力，同时保持对无关候选的鲁棒性。

articles.title: CoMem: Learning to Anticipate Failures from Retrieved Experience
articles.abstract: Reflection lets LLM agents improve from their own attempts, but the memory it builds is local to a single task, so an agent reflecting on its own tends to revisit the same explanation for failure. Cross-task reflective memory addresses this in two forms: retrieved memory keeps past experience explicit and looks up related cases, which is specific but bounded by the bank, and parametric memory internalizes experience into parameters, which generalizes but is grounded in nothing beyond the task description. When both are used, existing agents combine them additively, feeding their outputs to the solver side by side, so retrieved experience never changes what the learned memory produces. We introduce CoMem (Compounding Memory), which makes retrieved experience an input to the learned memory itself, at training and at inference. The agent builds a bank of its own successful and failed reflections, learns from retrieved cases to write failure hypotheses, candidate explanations of how an attempt is likely to go wrong, and at test time reasons from newly retrieved cases to guide each attempt. Varying the retrieved cases gives the memory different perspectives, yielding reflective diversity that is not merely sampled but also grounded in retrieved experience. Across two backbones and five benchmarks in math, code, and multi-hop QA, CoMem achieves strong overall performance. Additional evaluations show that it generalizes to out-of-distribution tasks and enables smaller models to provide effective guidance to stronger solvers.
articles.titleCn: CoMem：从检索到的经验中学习预见失败
articles.abstractCn: 反思使大语言模型代理能够从自身尝试中改进，但其构建的记忆仅限于单个任务，因此代理在反思时往往会重复相同的失败解释。跨任务反思记忆通过两种形式解决这个问题：检索记忆将过去的经验显式化并查找相关案例，这具有针对性但受限于记忆库；参数化记忆将经验内化到参数中，这具有泛化能力但仅基于任务描述。当两者同时使用时，现有代理将它们加性组合，将输出并排输入求解器，因此检索到的经验永远不会改变学习记忆产生的内容。我们引入了CoMem（复合记忆），它使检索到的经验成为学习记忆本身的输入，无论是在训练还是在推理时。代理构建自己的成功和失败反思记忆库，从检索到的案例中学习以编写失败假设，即尝试可能出错候选解释，并在测试时从新检索到的案例中推理，以指导每次尝试。改变检索到的案例为记忆提供不同视角，产生不仅采样而且基于检索经验的反思多样性。在数学、代码和多跳问答中的两个主干网络和五个基准测试中，CoMem实现了优异的整体性能。额外评估表明，它泛化到分布外任务，并使较小模型能够向更强求解器提供有效指导。

articles.title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills
articles.abstract: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Existing approaches improve their capabilities through computationally costly post-training or human-in-the-loop feedback that is difficult to scale. To transfer professional fact-checking expertise to LLM agents efficiently, we distill publicly available guidelines published by Agence France-Presse (AFP) Fact Check into a reusable, modular Professional Fact-Checking Skill (PFC-Skill). We then present SkillCheck, the first AFC system that gives LLM agents dynamic access to PFC-Skill to guide evidence retrieval and claim verification at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2--4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5--6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. To conclude, our work shows that LLM agents can "stand on the shoulders of giants" by drawing on the best practices of professional fact-checkers, substantially enhancing AFC performance without extra training or continuous human supervision.
articles.titleCn: 站在巨人的肩膀上：通过人类专业技能增强LLM代理进行自动化事实核查
articles.abstractCn: 由大型语言模型（LLM）代理驱动的自动化事实核查（AFC）系统在证据检索和声明验证方面仍面临挑战。现有方法通过计算成本高昂的离线训练或难以扩展的人工参与反馈来提升其能力。为了高效地将专业事实核查专业知识迁移到LLM代理，我们将法国新闻社（AFP）事实核查发布的公开指南提炼成一个可重用、模块化的专业事实核查技能（PFC-Skill）。随后，我们提出了SkillCheck，这是首个允许LLM代理在推理时动态访问PFC-Skill以指导证据检索和声明验证的AFC系统。大量实验表明，SkillCheck在多个LLM主干网络上优于无技能的DEFAME基线，在AVeriTeC基准测试中，准确率提升了2.2至4.8个百分点，宏观F1分数提升了1.5至6.3个百分点。值得注意的是，使用GPT-4o-Mini的SkillCheck在准确率上比使用GPT-4o的DEFAME高出3.4个百分点，同时推理成本降低了约61%。性能提升也扩展到了开放网络检索。消融实验表明，在证据检索阶段融入技能提供了大部分增益，而同时融入两个阶段则获得了最佳整体性能。案例研究表明，PFC-Skill能够实现更有针对性的搜索和对证据更仔细的审查。总之，我们的工作表明，LLM代理可以通过借鉴专业事实核查的最佳实践来“站在巨人的肩膀上”，在不进行额外训练或持续人工监督的情况下，显著提升AFC性能。

articles.title: Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-makers
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate more reasoning tokens than needed. Limiting the reasoning budget reduces cost, but forcing an answer from an incomplete trace can hurt accuracy. System-1 decision models select among candidate options without producing a reasoning response. We evaluate Jev as a decision reader of truncated reasoning across seven LLM reasoners and five multiple-choice benchmarks (35 pairs). Jev achieves higher mean accuracy than forced answering at tested budgets from 500 to 16,000 tokens, including the estimated costs of reasoning and answering. At a 1,500-token budget, it improves accuracy by 4.1 pp overall and 8.6 pp on truncated questions, with significant gains in 17 pairs under Holm-corrected bootstrap tests. Offline replay estimates 34.5% of the full-run cost, with a 1.13 pp accuracy loss. A policy selected on training folds saves 71.3% of the estimated full-run cost on held-out folds, with a 0.58 pp accuracy loss. We also find that Jev shows strong question-only accuracy, exceeding 500-token forced answering on average (68.0% vs. 65.5%), although this advantage varies by benchmark. These findings suggest that System-1 decision models can complement LLM reasoning and reduce the need for costly reasoning completion.
articles.titleCn: 预算下的截断推理：评估系统1模型作为决策者
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常会产生超出所需推理token的数量。限制推理预算可以降低成本，但强迫从不完整的推理轨迹中得出答案可能会损害准确性。系统-1决策模型在候选选项中进行选择，而不会生成推理响应。我们评估Jev作为截断推理的决策读取器，跨越了七个LLM推理器和五个多项选择题基准（35对）。Jev在500到16,000 token的测试预算范围内，包括推理和回答的估计成本，实现了比强迫回答更高的平均准确性。在1,500 token预算下，它总体上提高了4.1个百分点，在截断问题上有8.6个百分点的提升，在Holm校正的自举检验中有17对实现了显著提升。离线重放估计完整运行成本的34.5%，导致1.13个百分点的准确性损失。在训练折上选择的策略在保留折上节省了71.3%的估计完整运行成本，但准确性损失了0.58个百分点。我们还发现，Jev在仅针对问题的准确性上表现出色，平均而言超过了500 token的强迫回答（68.0% vs. 65.5%），尽管这种优势因基准而异。这些发现表明，系统-1决策模型可以补充LLM推理，并减少对昂贵推理补全的需求。

articles.title: Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.
articles.titleCn: 计算而非内存：大语言模型代理中的思维链与状态追踪
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理在行动之前通常会进行推理，而监控这种推理的价值取决于它与它们行动的关系。我们探讨当正确行动取决于变化状态时，代理的行动如何依赖于其推理。在一个小文件系统任务中，背景事件会宣布哪个文件的锁已被切换，但不会宣布其新值。因此，代理必须从其历史记录中重建当前锁才能安全地移动文件。使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.5-9B，我们将推理的两个角色分离出来：在每次行动前生成推理，以及在提示中保留早期的推理。违反锁命令的减少大部分来自行动时刻的推理。保留早期推理对规则遵循的增益不大，尽管它帮助一个模型完成了任务。这种增益取决于推理的内容。填充文本、为另一个历史记录编写的推理以及准确的状态表都无法重现它。当我们给代理一个与一个锁值不同的历史记录编写的推理时，代理会根据该推理行动，即使这与自己的历史记录相悖。没有推理的情况下，线性探测从模型激活中恢复状态的效果与文本分类器从记录中恢复状态的效果相当。然而，解码精度并不能预测哪些干预会改变代理的行动。在这个设置中，推理对规则遵循的增益主要来自每一步生成推理。无需推理即可解码的状态对代理行动的指导有限。

articles.title: A Calibrated Instrument for Detecting Disposition Drift in Language Models
articles.abstract: Before language models are released, they are tested for harmful traits such as willingness to carry out dangerous requests, deception, power seeking, and sycophancy. The safe behavior these tests certify may degrade as models are modified, by topical fine-tuning, new training data, or changes to settings such as the depth of their reasoning. Most work reports such drift as single summary rates scored by another AI model, without the error analysis needed to interpret them. We adapt a calibrated measurement methodology recently developed for assessing how inference optimizations affect the quality of model outputs. Applying it to several misalignment dimensions in two open-weight models, we first establish the instrument's precision, showing that shifts of a few percentage points can be reliably detected. We then induce drift deliberately by fine-tuning on correct and on subtly harmful medical and financial advice; harmful advice induces a far greater shift than correct advice. Most strikingly, a model that reasons before answering can conceal the shift almost entirely in its answers, even though a direct reading of its internal state shows that its disposition has moved. With reasoning switched off, the same model shifts steadily as the share of harmful advice in its training grows. These results demonstrate the importance of testing safety with reasoning turned both on and off.
articles.titleCn: 一种用于检测语言模型倾向漂移的校准仪器
articles.abstractCn: 在语言模型发布之前，会对其进行测试以评估其潜在的有害特性，例如执行危险请求的意愿、欺骗、权力寻求和谄媚。这些测试认证的安全行为可能会随着模型的修改而退化，例如通过主题微调、新的训练数据或推理深度等设置的变化。大多数研究仅报告由另一人工智能模型评分的单个汇总率，而缺乏必要的误差分析来解释这些结果。我们采用了一种最近开发的标准测量方法，用于评估推理优化如何影响模型输出的质量。将其应用于两个开放权重模型中的多个错位维度，我们首先验证了该仪器的精度，表明几个百分点的变化可以被可靠地检测到。然后，我们通过在正确的医疗和金融建议以及微妙有害的建议上进行微调来故意诱导这种变化；有害建议引起的偏移远大于正确建议。最引人注目的是，一个在回答前进行推理的模型几乎可以完全隐藏其回答中的变化，尽管直接读取其内部状态表明其倾向已经发生了变化。当推理功能关闭时，同一模型的偏移随着其训练中有害建议比例的增长而稳定变化。这些结果表明，在推理功能开启和关闭的情况下进行安全测试的重要性。

articles.title: Does Unlearning Survive Collaboration? Robust Unlearning for Shared-Model LLM Teams
articles.abstract: LLM unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or unwanted knowledge while preserving useful capabilities. As LLM teams are increasingly used to solve complex problems, forgetting must remain effective during collaboration. Despite advances in forgetting effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness to relearning, team deployment remains underexplored. We find that collaboration weakens forgetting: final-answer evaluations miss recoverable evidence in team messages, including complementary clues supporting joint recovery. We establish theoretically and confirm empirically that controlling final answers or individual messages does not ensure low recovery from their combination. To address this challenge, we propose Aggregation-Conditioned Unlearning (ACU). ACU trains a shared model using reconstruction feedback from individual and pooled messages, prioritizes views with higher recovery risk, and uses replacement-based credit assignment while protecting direct and collaborative utility. TOFU evaluates trajectory-level recovery, while WMDP-bio tests native forgetting and retained utility. On TOFU, ACU lowers full-trajectory recovery from 41.8% to 19.3% in ROUGE-L recall and factual recovery from 34.2% to 18.7% versus output-supervised training, with comparable retained-task performance. These results demonstrate that ACU curbs information leakage in LLM teams and generalizes across team sizes and readers.
articles.titleCn: 去学习是否能在协作中存活？共享模型大型语言模型团队的鲁棒去学习
articles.abstractCn: LLM去学习对于移除敏感或不必要知识的同时保留有用能力至关重要。随着LLM团队越来越多地用于解决复杂问题，遗忘必须在协作过程中保持有效。尽管在遗忘的有效性、效率和再学习鲁棒性方面取得了进展，但团队部署仍处于探索不足的阶段。我们发现协作会削弱遗忘：最终答案评估会忽略团队消息中可恢复的证据，包括支持联合恢复的互补线索。我们通过理论和实证证明，控制最终答案或单个消息并不能确保其组合的低恢复率。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了聚合条件去学习（ACU）。ACU使用来自单个和聚合消息的重建反馈来训练共享模型，优先处理具有更高恢复风险的视图，并在保护直接和协作效用时使用基于替换的信用分配。TOFU评估轨迹级别的恢复，而WMDP-bio测试原生遗忘和保留效用。在TOFU上，ACU将ROUGE-L召回的完整轨迹恢复率从41.8%降至19.3%，事实恢复率从34.2%降至18.7%，与输出监督训练相比，保留任务性能相当。这些结果表明ACU遏制了LLM团队中的信息泄露，并能在不同团队规模和读者中泛化。

articles.title: No Matter Who You Are: Addressivity and Sycophancy in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Sycophancy, where an LLM becomes overly agreeable, deferential, or flattering toward the user, has been identified as a major failure mode. While post-training has been implicated as a cause, how it internally gives rise to sycophantic behavior remains insufficiently understood. Post-training transforms the model's output from text completion into utterances directed toward an addressee, thereby giving the output \textit{addressivity}. We hypothesize that the accompanying pressure to follow the addressee's instructions and align with their preferences links this addressivity to sycophancy. To test this, we use Sparse Autoencoders to extract addressivity directions from pre-trained and post-trained models and examine their relationship with sycophancy. Steering models with addressivity directions can amplify or suppress sycophancy, and this effect is observed only in post-trained models. Furthermore, comparing the internal mechanisms of both model types confirms that the association between addressivity and sycophancy is strengthened through post-training. Finally, through a controlled post-training experiment, we find that models are sycophantic not toward a specific addressee but toward any recognized addressee, suggesting that the presence of an addressee, rather than the addressee's identity, is what elicits sycophancy.
articles.titleCn: 无论你是谁：大型语言模型中的称谓与谄媚
articles.abstractCn: 奉承，即大型语言模型对用户表现出过度顺从、谦卑或奉承的行为，已被识别为一种主要的失效模式。尽管训练后处理被指认为其原因，但其内部如何引发奉承行为仍未能得到充分理解。训练后处理将模型的输出从文本补全转变为针对特定对象的陈述，从而赋予输出以\textit{地址性}。我们假设，随之而来的遵循对象指令和与其偏好保持一致的压力，将这种地址性与奉承行为联系起来。为此，我们使用稀疏自动编码器从预训练和训练后模型中提取地址性方向，并检验其与奉承行为的关系。通过地址性方向引导模型可以放大或抑制奉承行为，而这种效应仅在训练后模型中观察到。此外，通过比较两种模型类型的内部机制，证实了地址性与奉承行为之间的关联是通过训练后处理强化的。最后，通过一项受控的训练后处理实验，我们发现模型奉承的对象并非特定对象，而是任何被识别的对象，这表明是对象的存在的存在，而非对象的身份，才是引发奉承行为的因素。

articles.title: Inside the Scorer: Mechanistic Evidence on Rubric Control in LLM-Based Automated Essay Scoring from 25 Base Models
articles.abstract: Automated essay scoring (AES) using large language models (LLMs) offers promising use cases for language assessment, yet high-stakes testing requires scores that are both controllable and verifiable, which current LLM-based scorers lack. Given that, we investigate whether LLM-based scorers form distinct internal representations for individual scoring rubrics and whether these representations can be independently controlled. Probing and steering 25 open-weight base LLMs (0.13B-10.31B parameters; 14 families) on human-scored BESTEP English writing tasks, we find that holistic scores are decodable from model activations for the longer tasks (Parts 2 and 3) and only weakly for the shortest (Part 1). Furthermore, scoring rubrics have partly separable directions in representation space for the longer tasks, though not for short responses (Part 1). However, causal steering reveals a critical limitation: applying a matching intervention (e.g., steering "grammar" on a grammar-degraded response) yields only a negligible advantage (about 2% of the effect) over a mismatched intervention (e.g., steering "vocabulary"), and none that is detectable in any of the 10 testable comparisons across reliably measured rubrics. Rather than controlling distinct evaluative dimensions, the rubric directions share a dominant lever whose rubric-specific parts are not selective, which may mirror the halo structure of human ratings. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we show that analytic scoring rubrics designed for human raters do not behave as independent controls in base LLMs, even among the seven models whose scores agree best with human raters ($r \geq 0.6$). Second, we establish a methodology that shows that score agreement and decodability do not imply rubric-level control in LLM-based assessment.
articles.comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted to PACLIC 40 (The 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation); to be presented in Taipei, Taiwan, December 10-12, 2026. Code at https://github.com/lopentu/inside-the-scorer-paclic2026
articles.titleCn: 评分器内部：基于25个基础模型的LLM自动评分中评分标准控制的机制证据
articles.abstractCn: 使用大型语言模型（LLM）的自动化作文评分（AES）为语言评估提供了有前景的应用场景，然而高风险测试需要可控且可验证的评分，而当前的基于LLM的评分器缺乏这些特性。鉴于此，我们研究了基于LLM的评分器是否为不同的评分标准形成独特的内部表征，以及这些表征是否可以被独立控制。通过对25个开放权重基础LLM（参数量0.13B-10.31B；14个系列）在人类评分的BESTEP英语写作任务上进行探测和引导，我们发现对于较长的任务（第二部分和第三部分），整体评分可以从模型激活中解码，而对于最短的（第一部分）则只有微弱的可解码性。此外，对于较长的任务，评分标准在表征空间中具有部分可分离的方向，但对于短回答（第一部分）则没有。然而，因果引导揭示了一个关键限制：应用匹配干预（例如，在语法退化的回答上引导“语法”）与不匹配干预（例如，引导“词汇”）相比，仅带来微不足道的优势（约2%的效果），并且在所有10个可测试的比较中，在可靠测量的评分标准下均未发现可检测到的优势。评分标准方向共享一个主导杠杆，其特定部分不具有选择性，这可能反映了人类评分的晕轮结构。我们的贡献有两个方面。首先，我们表明，为人类评分者设计的分析性评分标准在基础LLM中不会作为独立控制因素，即使在得分与人类评分者最为一致的七个模型中（$r \geq 0.6$）。其次，我们建立了一种方法，表明在基于LLM的评估中，得分一致性和可解码性并不意味着评分标准层面的控制。

articles.title: Whose Credential Is It? How Owner Attribution in Agent MemoryShapes Cross-User Account Misuse
articles.abstract: Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.
articles.titleCn: 这是谁的凭证？代理记忆形状中的所有者归属如何导致跨用户账户滥用
articles.abstractCn: 共享长期记忆允许为单个用户服务的LLM代理无意中检索到另一个用户的凭证，但尚不清楚这种暴露何时会导致实际损害。我们引入了一个三阶段审计，将三个事件分开：外部的凭证到达提示（暴露）、代理使用它（行为）以及另一个用户的账户发生变化（状态）。在AppWorld（一个混合了所有用户763个过去登录记录的商店）中，对于84.7%的所需应用，它检索到另一个用户的凭证，但代理很少采取行动。在压力测试中，当记忆中缺少用户自己的凭证并呈现一个外部的凭证作为用户记录时，出现滥用：七种代理中有80%至94%的运行使用它，并在高达43%的情况下更改受害者的账户，有时甚至通过官方检查。在凭证行的每行之前或内部命名所有者可以防止大多数此类滥用：在所有其他条件固定的情况下，滥用从92次降至305次配对运行中的1次，即使是无名的用户名也是如此，尽管与模型相关的注释每次成功任务成本3至5次。一个错误书写的所有者会大大恢复滥用；尾随所有者标签和添加的安全说明只帮助一些模型。代理记忆应始终记录它存储的是谁的凭证，评估不应仅测量暴露，还应测量行为。

articles.title: Cross-Pollination Retrieval: Finding Transferable Ideas Across Fields in Scientific Literature
articles.abstract: Many scientific advances come from cross-pollination, carrying an idea from one field over to a problem in another. Yet retrieving papers across fields remains underexplored, with existing benchmarks confined to a narrow range of fields. We study cross-pollination retrieval, the problem of identifying transferable ideas across research fields, and introduce CPR-Dataset, a large-scale dataset constructed by mining cross-topic citations. Its evaluation split CPR-eval has 1,300 queries in 26 fields, and its training split CPR-train has 10,573 pairs. On CPR-eval, the best of eleven existing retrievers reaches a Recall@10 of only 0.26, whereas an LLM reranker reaches 0.81. Standard contrastive fine-tuning on CPR-train raises Recall@10 to as high as 0.70. The gain carries over to domains held out from training and to analogy and reasoning-intensive retrieval. On AnaloBench, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 33% over the untrained retriever, whereas training on three existing retrieval datasets lowers it. On BRIGHT, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 70%, more than twice the gain from those datasets. CPR-Dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset, and the code at https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval.
articles.titleCn: 跨领域知识检索：在科学文献中寻找可迁移的思想
articles.abstractCn: 许多科学进步源于跨领域的思想传播，即将一个领域中的思想迁移到另一个领域的问题。然而，跨领域文献检索仍处于探索阶段，现有的基准测试仅限于狭窄的领域范围。我们研究了跨领域思想传播检索问题，即识别不同研究领域之间的可迁移思想，并引入了CPR-Dataset，这是一个通过挖掘跨主题引用构建的大规模数据集。其评估集CPR-eval包含26个领域的1,300个查询，其训练集CPR-train包含10,573对数据。在CPR-eval上，11个现有检索器中最好的仅达到Recall@10为0.26，而一个LLM重排序器达到了0.81。在CPR-train上进行标准对比微调可将Recall@10提高到高达0.70。这种提升也适用于训练集之外的领域，以及需要类比和推理的检索任务。在AnaloBench上，它使nDCG@10比未训练的检索器提高了高达33%，而在三个现有检索数据集上训练则降低了该指标。在BRIGHT上，它使nDCG@10提高了高达70%，超过了这些数据集带来的提升。CPR-Dataset可在https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset获取，代码在https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval。

articles.title: Consistency Training Suppresses Cue Following Without Teaching Cue Selectivity
articles.abstract: Language models often change answers because of a cue, a hint such as "I believe the answer is B" that gives no valid evidence. Consistency training (CT) trains a model to answer the same with and without the cue. Four CT methods apply this idea to output tokens (BCT), residual activations (ACT), attention patterns (AttCT) and sampled-answer rates (RMCT). Prior work suggests some learn different solutions. We train all four on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the same data. We test predictions written in advance and inspect the models with a known circuit that carries cues to the answer. All four make the trained cue less effective, and their fixes share three properties. First, correct cues lose about as much influence as wrong ones. Second, the fix is usually large for cues before the answer options, as in training, and much smaller after them. Llama RMCT depends least on position. Third, the circuit heads still carry most remaining cue-induced errors. Making BCT targets depend on the cue's correctness mostly weakens the fix. CT thus weakens the trained cue without teaching models when a cue is right. Evaluations with only wrong cues at the trained position miss the first two properties.
articles.titleCn: 一致性训练抑制了线索跟随，而无需教授线索选择性
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型常常因为一个提示而改变答案，这个提示例如“我认为答案是B”，但并没有提供任何有效的证据。一致性训练（CT）训练模型在有无提示的情况下给出相同的答案。四种CT方法将这一思想应用于输出标记（BCT）、残差激活（ACT）、注意力模式（AttCT）和采样答案率（RMCT）。先前的研究表明，有些方法学习到了不同的解决方案。我们在Gemma-2-2B-it和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上使用相同的数据训练了这四种方法。我们测试了预先写好的预测，并通过一个已知电路来检查模型，该电路将提示传递给答案。这四种方法都使训练的提示效果减弱，并且它们的修正措施具有三个共同特性。首先，正确的提示和错误的提示失去的影响大致相同。其次，修正措施通常在答案选项之前的提示中较大，类似于训练时的效果，而在之后则小得多。Llama的RMCT对位置依赖性最小。第三，电路头仍然携带了大部分剩余的提示诱导错误。使BCT目标主要依赖于提示的正确性会削弱修正效果。因此，CT削弱了训练的提示，但没有教会模型何时提示是正确的。仅在训练位置使用错误提示的评估会遗漏前两个特性。

articles.title: MapSteal: Map-based Autonomous Knowledge Stealing Attack Against Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Knowledge acquisition from black-box large language models (LLMs) offers a practical approach to adapting smaller student models. However, many existing methods rely on predefined queries or student feedback to guide acquisition, leaving autonomous expansion of knowledge targets an important challenge. We propose \textbf{MapSteal}, a student-independent framework for structured recursive knowledge acquisition. Starting from a small set of initial roots, MapSteal represents acquisition targets using structured states and recursively expands them through teacher-proposed directions. Question realization, proposal admission, and deduplication constrain the acquisition process, while root-aware scheduling organizes exploration under a fixed QA budget. The resulting question--answer pairs are used to adapt student models without requiring student feedback during acquisition. Experiments with Qwen3.5 students at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales show competitive downstream performance across six medical and cybersecurity benchmarks. On the 4B medical evaluation, Full MapSteal improves average accuracy by 1.17 percentage points over a simplified recursive acquisition variant. Cross-domain evaluations show that gains depend on the domain and evaluation panel. These results demonstrate the feasibility of structured, student-independent recursive acquisition while highlighting the distinction between generating acquisition targets and obtaining useful training supervision. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal} {https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal}.
articles.titleCn: 基于地图的自主知识窃取攻击：针对大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 从黑盒大型语言模型（LLMs）中获取知识为适配小型学生模型提供了一种实用方法。然而，许多现有方法依赖预定义查询或学生反馈来指导知识获取，使得知识目标的自主动态扩展成为一个重要挑战。我们提出了\textbf{MapSteal}，一个独立于学生模型的、结构化递归知识获取框架。从一组初始根开始，MapSteal使用结构化状态表示获取目标，并通过教师提出的方向递归地扩展它们。问题实现、提议接纳和去重约束了获取过程，而根感知调度在固定的问答预算下组织探索。生成的问答对用于适配学生模型，无需在获取过程中获取学生反馈。在2B、4B和9B规模的Qwen3.5学生上的实验表明，在六个医疗和网络安全基准测试中，下游性能具有竞争力。在4B医疗评估中，Full MapSteal比简化的递归获取变体平均准确率提高了1.17个百分点。跨领域评估表明，收益取决于领域和评估小组。这些结果证明了结构化、独立于学生的递归获取的可行性，同时突出了生成获取目标与获取有用训练监督之间的区别。我们的代码可在\href{https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal} {https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal}获取。

articles.title: Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit
articles.abstract: LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails.
