Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 课程学习教会大型语言模型长时程隐式推理，直至一定限度
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过思维链（CoT）将中间步骤外部化为标记来进行“推理”，然而即使是前沿推理模型在长时程任务上也会遭遇性能骤降。在CoT生成过程中，隐式推理（单次前向过程中的推理）很有用，因为模型可以“预判”来决定正确的下一步，而无需显式搜索。隐式推理能力较弱的模型更容易选择错误路径，并必须通过回溯尝试恢复，而隐式推理能力强的模型能直接识别正确的证明策略，从而缩短CoT。然而，已有研究表明LLMs在浅层深度之外难以进行隐式推理，且规模扩大也无法缓解这一问题。我们研究了课程学习是否可以通过在词汇量和预判步数（模型为识别正确下一步必须预判的步数）逐步增加的示例上进行微调来扩展这种深度。在匹配的计算资源下，课程学习训练的模型达到了无课程学习训练失败的预判步数。Qwen3-0.6B在课程学习下，对于预判步数高达256的问题达到了98%的准确率，而无课程学习时仅为45%。然而，随着微调的持续，进展逐渐放缓，遵循一个饱和的指数曲线，这表明模型可以学习到的最大隐式预判深度存在上限。更大的模型达到了更高的拟合上限，预训练模型的微调远超从头训练，而课程学习步数过大则会停滞进展。最后，在合成数据上获得的能力可以迁移到自然语言推理，课程学习训练的模型在匹配的计算资源下，在11个自然语言推理基准测试中优于无课程学习训练的模型。

articles.title: Text Dominance in Paralinguistic Conflict: Tracing Suppression Through Audio LLM Circuits
articles.abstract: Audio LLMs deployed in settings such as crisis hotlines and customer support are only useful beyond speech-to-text pipelines if they use acoustic cues rather than the transcript alone. We test whether they prioritise transcript content over paralinguistic cues (emotion, speaker identity, sarcasm) and trace the mechanism when they do. Across six audio LLMs under LISTEN-style conflict conditions, the mean text-dominance rate on mismatched text+audio items is 0.78 (0.86 excluding sarcasm). In the most text-dominant screened model, probing shows speaker identity remains linearly decodable at ceiling at the language model's input, so the failure is not perceptual. Back-patching, reported to repair lexical text dominance, has no measurable effect here; but it also fails on its own source task in our replication (n=300), so we treat its null as uninformative rather than as evidence of non-transfer. Attention knockout partially restores audio-grounded output by blocking the claim from propagating through intermediate tokens during open-ended generation, whereas blocking the answer position's direct connection to the conflicting claim has no effect. The claim's influence therefore travels through an intermediate relay rather than a single severable edge. The effect appears only in free-form generation and not in closed-set multiple choice, suggesting that benchmarks relying on that format may be systematically blind to interventions of this kind. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. Accepted at the InterpScience Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp
articles.titleCn: 副语言冲突中的文本主导性：通过音频LLM电路追踪压制过程
articles.abstractCn: 在危机热线和客户支持等场景部署的音频大型语言模型，若要超越语音转文本流程发挥作用，就必须利用声学线索而非仅依赖文本。我们测试了这些模型是否优先考虑文本内容而非副语言线索（情绪、说话人身份、讽刺），并追踪了它们优先考虑文本内容时的机制。在六种LISTEN式冲突条件下，不匹配的文本+音频项上的平均文本主导率高达0.78（排除讽刺时为0.86）。在筛选出的最文本主导模型中，探测显示说话人身份在语言模型的输入端保持线性可解码性，因此失败并非感知问题。所谓的回贴技术（用于修复词汇文本主导）在此处没有可测量的效果；但在我们复现的原始任务中（n=300）它也失败了，因此我们将其空效果视为无信息而非非迁移的证据。注意力阻断通过阻止断言在开放式生成过程中通过中间标记传播，部分恢复了基于音频的输出；而阻断答案位置与冲突断言的直接连接则没有效果。因此，断言的影响是通过一个中间中继而非单一可切断的边缘传播的。这种效应仅在自由形式生成中出现，而在封闭集多选题中不出现，这表明依赖该格式的基准测试可能系统性地忽视了此类干预。代码和数据公开可在https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp获取。

articles.title: Cognitive Map in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: It has long been proposed that animals construct cognitive maps to support flexible behavior in novel environments. We tested whether large language models form similar representations using relational reasoning tasks and causal "mosaic experiments" that manipulate internal activations in open-weight language models. Models beyond the ten-billion-parameter scale successfully inferred unstated relationships between entities and generalized to synthetic entity names. Across model and task families, models generated abstract representations of relational structure and combined them additively with representations of entity identity, binding entities to roles within that structure. Models stored observed relationships as pairwise links that they composed retrospectively when queried, rather than prospectively positioning each entity in a global coordinate system. Binding was mediated by a sparse, distributed set of key--value pairs; by perturbing these pairs, we implanted "false memories" that altered model behavior in predictable ways. Overall, our findings reveal an internal organization analogous to a cognitive map that explains how language models reason with limited information.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的认知地图
articles.abstractCn: 长期以来，人们一直提出动物通过构建认知地图来支持在陌生环境中表现出的灵活行为。我们通过关系推理任务和操纵开放权重语言模型内部激活的因果"马赛克实验"，测试了大型语言模型是否形成类似的表征。超过百亿参数规模的模型成功地推断出实体间未明确表述的关系，并能推广到合成实体名称。在模型和任务系列中，模型生成了关系结构的抽象表征，并将其与实体身份的表征加性结合，将实体绑定到结构中的特定角色。模型将观察到的关系存储为成对链接，并在查询时回顾性地组合它们，而不是前瞻性地将每个实体定位在一个全局坐标系中。绑定通过稀疏、分布式的键-值对对进行中介；通过扰动这些键-值对，我们植入了"虚假记忆"，以可预测的方式改变了模型的行为。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了类似于认知地图的内部组织结构，解释了语言模型如何利用有限信息进行推理。
